jobs.title: Tecnico di laboratorio-ricerca e sviluppo
jobs.description:
Molino Spadoni S.p.A ricerca un **tecnico di laboratorio-ricerca e sviluppo** per il potenziamento del team tecnico-scientifico.

La risorsa collaborerà con il gruppo di lavoro nelle attività di analisi, sperimentazione, controllo e sviluppo di farine, semilavorati e prodotti da forno, contribuendo all'innovazione e al miglioramento continuo dei prodotti e dei processi aziendali.

**Principali attività:**

* Eseguire analisi chimico-fisiche e tecnologiche su farine e materie prime
* Effettuare prove di laboratorio e test applicativi su farine e prodotti da forno
* Collaborare alle attività di ricerca, sviluppo e ottimizzazione di nuovi prodotti e formulazioni
* Supportare la valutazione delle caratteristiche qualitative e tecnologiche delle materie prime
* Effettuare prove di panificazione e/o di trasformazione degli sfarinati
* Raccogliere, elaborare e documentare i risultati delle prove e delle analisi
* Collaborare con i colleghi del team R&D e con le altre funzioni aziendali per la risoluzione di problematiche tecniche e qualitative
* Contribuire al miglioramento continuo delle metodologie di analisi e sperimentazione

**Requisiti:**

* Esperienza, anche breve, in laboratori alimentari o nel settore molitorio e della panificazione
* Diploma tecnico o laurea in ambito scientifico, preferibilmente in Scienze e Tecnologie Alimentari, Chimica, Biotecnologie o discipline affini
* Interesse e/o conoscenza del settore cerealicolo, molitorio e dei prodotti da forno
* Precisione, metodo e attenzione al dettaglio
* Attitudine al lavoro in team e alla collaborazione
* Flessibilità e disponibilità ad apprendere nuove metodologie di lavoro
* Conoscenza delle metodologie di controllo qualità delle materie prime e dei prodotti alimentari

**Luogo di lavoro:** Coccolia(RA)

**Inquadramento:** CCNL Alimentari Industria (impiegato/a- 5° livello)

**Orario:** full time (40h)- 08:00-18:00

Retribuzione: €28.000,00 - €32.000,00 all'anno

* tecnico di laboratorio-ricerca e sviluppo: 1 anno (Obbligatorio)

jobs.description:

jobs.description:

Descrizione della posizione

Siamo alla ricerca di un’analista di laboratorio chimico del settore farmaceutico da inserire nel team di analisti. Sotto la supervisione del CQ Manager e dei supervisori di laboratorio, secondo le norme di sicurezza e GMP, si occuperà di effettuare le analisi chimiche in modo di assicurare il corretto e continuo ciclo di produzione, nel completo rispetto delle procedure aziendali

Orario di lavoro: lunedì - venerdì 37.5 ore a settimana.  
Sede: Aprilia (LT)  
100% Onsite

Descrizione delle attività

* Supportare il supervisore per le attività di stesura, revisione e corretta archiviazione di tutta la documentazione di reparto, relativamente al solo laboratorio chimico (procedure operative standard, quaderni di laboratorio, log book, registri) e garantire la piena disponibilità in caso di richiesta in fase di ispezioni interne/esterne/regolatorie.

* Garantire il corretto approvvigionamento di tutti i materiali di consumo in uso nel laboratorio.

* Garantire la corretta applicazione delle Procedure Operative Standard.

* Supportare il proprio supervisore per la valutazione periodica degli indicatori di prestazione del sistema di gestione della qualità (SGQ), al fine di verificare la consistenza e la riproducibilità dei processi esistenti e permettere di individuare eventuali trend avversi e definire le azioni correttive/preventive necessarie

Competenze richieste:

jobs.title: Microbiology & Genetics lab technician
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

**Gnosis by Lesaffre** aims to raise the standard of human health and build a world where proactive health solutions empower people to live longer, happier lives.

By exploring the world of microorganisms, we tap into nature’s biological processes to develop solutions that address pressing health challenges while promoting positive impact on both human and planetary health.

Together with nutraceutical and pharmaceutical brands, we develop revolutionary products that help their customers thrive.

Our vision is a future where health is proactive, solutions are sustainable, and the timeless wisdom of nature guides every step forward.

**Think like Nature** to Raise human health.

 **Job Description**

**Mission/Purpose of the position**

The Microbiology Laboratory Technician supports the R&D Microbiology & Genetics team in executing laboratory activities related to microbial strain management, cultivation, characterization, enumeration and experimental testing. The role ensures reliable and efficient project execution through high-quality laboratory work, accurate documentation, proper culture maintenance, and adherence to internal procedures, quality standards, and safety requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Microbiological Analysis and Experimental Support**

* Perform microbiological analyses using standard techniques, including plating, enumeration, isolation and purity assessment.
* Conduct small scale fermentation of microbial strains.
* Conduct stability studies of probiotic strains
* Monitor experimental parameters and collect samples according to defined protocols.

**Laboratory Operations and Equipment Management**

* Operate and perform routine maintenance of laboratory equipment.
* Prepare culture media, solutions, reagents, and laboratory materials as required.
* Monitor and replenish stocks of media, reagents, and consumables in a timely manner.
* Maintain laboratory areas and equipment in clean and functional condition.

**Compliance and Safety**

* Ensure proper management, labeling, storage, and disposal of biological materials, reagents and laboratory waste.
* Adhere to laboratory safety protocols and contribute to a safe working environment.
* Collaborate effectively with researchers, scientists, and cross-functional R&D teams.

 **Qualifications**

**Education & Experience**

* Diploma or bachelor’s degree in microbiology, Biotechnology, Biology, Biological Sciences or a related scientific discipline.
* Previous laboratory experience in microbiology, biotechnology or a related field.
* Experience with bacterial and/or yeast cultures.

Technical Skills

* Good knowledge of basic microbiological techniques and aseptic practices.
* Familiarity with microbial cultivation, plating and enumeration techniques.
* Ability to prepare media, buffers and laboratory solutions.
* Basic knowledge of microbial growth and fermentation principles.
* Familiarity with laboratory equipment and good laboratory practices.
* Basic computer skills and ability to manage experimental data and laboratory documentation.

Key Competencies

* Accuracy and attention to detail.
* Strong organizational skills and reliability.
* Ability to follow experimental protocols and procedures.
* Practical and problem-solving mindset.
* Ability to work both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.
* Flexibility and willingness to learn new techniques and methodologies.
* Strong commitment to laboratory safety, quality and data integrity.

 **Additional Information**  

* The job is based in Desio (MB) - Italy
* outsourced contract, 6 months fixed term contract
* CCNL Chimico Farmaceutico
* Gross Salary Range : 32k€ - 36k€
* Ticket restaurant 10€
* Be part of a **growing company**
* Work in a **dynamic international environment**
* We promote a sense of fulfilment with a genuine mission: nourish and protect the planet, and Raise Human Health.
* An opportunity to work in a real international environment.

*At Lesaffre, diversity is a strength that enriches our culture and our teams. We are committed to offering you a work environment where you can thrive, regardless of your background, gender, age or abilities. We encourage all applications, as we believe that diverse perspectives strengthen our ability to innovate and meet the challenges of tomorrow.*

*FAO’s commitment to environmental sustainability is integral to our strategic objectives and operations.*

  

The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) contributes to the achievement of the 2030 Agenda through the FAO Strategic Framework by supporting the transformation to MORE efficient, inclusive, resilient and sustainable agrifood systems, for *better production*, *better nutrition*, *a better environment,* and *a better life*, leaving no one behind.

  

**Organizational Setting**

The Statistics Division (ESS) develops and advocates for the implementation of methodologies and standards for data collection, validation, processing, analysis and dissemination in the food and agriculture statistics domains. In these statistical domains, it also plays a key role in the compilation, processing and dissemination of internationally comparable data, and provides essential capacity building in support of member countries. The Division also disseminates publications, working papers and statistical yearbooks on various topics related to food and agriculture statistics, including food security and nutrition, prices, investments, production, trade and agri-environmental statistical data. Finally, as the ESS Director also plays the role of FAO Chief Statistician, the Division supports the various functions of the Chief Statistician, that is to ensure stronger governance of FAO's data and statistical system, foster consistency of FAO's Data and Statistical programme within the Strategic Framework, ensure statistical excellence through the implementation of statistical standards and quality assurance mechanisms, and position FAO's presence in data and statistical discussions at global level.
  
  
The position is located in the Statistics Division (ESS) at FAO headquarters in Rome, Italy.

  

**Main Purpose**

The Statistical/Research Assistant performs a variety of routine technical, procedural and record-keeping support duties contributing to statistical data collection and presentation.

  

**Supervision Received/Exercised**

The Statistical/Research Assistant works under direct supervision of the Senior Statistician/Team Leader of the Social and Economic Statistics Team and general supervision of the Director and/or Deputy Director, ESS. Supervision received provides for technical and procedural guidance and on-the-job learning opportunities.
  
Supervision received provides for technical and procedural guidance and on-the-job learning opportunities.

  

**Working Relationships**

The Statistical/Research Assistant engages with colleagues from within the work unit and with immediate clients supported, providing routine and standard services in assistance of data collection, analysis and presentation.

  

**Key Functions/Results**

* Compile data from source material such as questionnaires, publications, surveys, research projects, websites, reports, databases, etc.

• Verify completeness and accuracy of source data delivered to FAO by external stakeholder.
  
• Review specific indicators and apply routine statistical methods to check the validity and to identify any statistical discrepancies.
  
• Enter, retrieve and update data from existing databases.
  
• Process/compute statistical data according to formulae; assemble related outputs following prescribed procedures and instructions received; abstract and highlight specific features of data.
  
• Prepare standard statistical reports, tables and diagrams to show evidence and comparison of statistical information to facilitate further review and analysis.
  
• Prepare country notes on the availability and quality of national statistics and update internal metadata system.
  
• Perform other duties as required.  

**Impact of Work**

The Statistical/Research Assistant participates as part of a team in the provision of statistical and research support services. Actions reflect on the immediate and wider work unit.

  

**CANDIDATES WILL BE ASSESSED AGAINST THE FOLLOWING**

**Education:** Secondary School Education.
  
**Experience:** Two years of experience in administrative and/or data processing support work.

**Languages:** Working knowledge (proficiency - level C) of English.

**IT Skills:** Good knowledge of standard MS Office applications, Interne

Pisa, Italy | Part time | Field-based | R1578748

  

**Clinical Research Coordinator in Pisa**

  
  

**Working Hours:** 9 hours per week

**Start Date**: Immediately
  
**Duration**: Approximately 10-11 months

  
  

IQVIA is currently recruiting a dedicated Clinical Research Coordinator to support a clinical research site in Pisa. This **9h hour per week** role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to meaningful research in a collaborative and dynamic environment.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

As a vital member of the site team, you will help ensure the smooth execution of the clinical trial by performing a range of administrative and clinical support tasks, including:

* Prescreening and Screening tasks
* Review charts from the site data base
* Maintaining and updating study documentation, including protocols, case report forms (CRFs), Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems and eTMFs
* Supporting patient screening and enrollment, including handling informed consent and privacy documentation
* IP - site accountability including IP - patient compliance
* Use of IRT/IWRS systems for subject randomization, investigational product assignment, inventory management, and site-level clinical trial operations
* Processing and shipment of lab samples process
* Patient scheduling support
* Printing and certifying EMR
* Coordinating logistical activities for study procedures in line with the study protocol
* Communicating with study monitors and responding to study-related inquiries
* Carrying out general administrative tasks related to the study
  

  

**Your Profile**
  
We are looking for candidates who bring a combination of education, experience, and skills:

* Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or equivalent education and/or relevant experience in a clinical or medical setting (e.g., clinical research coordinator, research assistant, nurse, medical assistant)
* Solid understanding of clinical trials and familiarity with study protocols, consent forms, and schedules
* Experience with lap samples and IRT/IWRS systems
* Good knowledge of medical terminology
* Strong IT skills, including proficiency in MS Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel, Access)
* **Must have at least 2-3 years experience working as a Clinical Research Assistant, Research Nurse or Clinical Research Coordinator at a clinical trial site**
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Fluency in English
  

  

**Why Join IQVIA?**
  
At IQVIA, you will be part of a global team that is advancing healthcare through data, technology, and human science. We offer a supportive work environment, impactful projects, and the opportunity to make a real difference.

  
  

**Interested?**
  
If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we encourage you to apply today.

Field of work: Quality

Posting Date: 3 Nov 2026

**Application deadline:**  
**Location:** Segrate 20054, Lombardy, Italy  
**Contract type:** Permanent  
**Job ID:** 4758

  

**Role Description**
--------------------

**Bring your scientific skills to work where precision matters. Help ensure the quality of finished products and turn your passion for laboratory analysis into a meaningful contribution.**

  

**Join us in creating a future legacy in medical dermatology**

At LEO Pharma, we are global leaders in medical dermatology. We have 118 years’ experience in bringing innovation to healthcare. And we are eager to do much more. Each year, close to 100 million people have a better day because of our medicines.

This role combines hands-on finished product testing, analytical development and opportunities to support continuous improvement in our Quality Control Finished Product Laboratory.

  

At LEO Pharma, how we work matters. We build trusted relationships and deliver with impact. We focus on where we can make the greatest difference and have the courage to explore new possibilities. We collaborate across boundaries and take accountability for our part. Here, you can grow, contribute with confidence, and make a meaningful difference together with others.

  

**Your role**

As a Finished Product Laboratory Technician, you will perform analyses supporting finished product release and stability, while contributing to analytical development activities. Your focus will be on delivering timely, reliable results, maintaining data integrity and following local and global procedures. You will also help investigate quality issues and support improvements to formulations and production processes.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  

* Performing finished product analyses for release and stability testing, ensuring completion within the required timelines.
* Supporting process validation, cleaning validation and analyses related to complaints and production deviations.
* Contributing to analytical method validation for production process lifecycle management.
* Following local and global SOPs, ensuring data integrity and participating in GMP and health, safety and environment training.
* Supporting local and global performance indicators and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives in Quality Control.
  

This is an opportunity to apply your technical knowledge across routine testing, investigations and improvement activities, while collaborating with internal functions, global colleagues and external partners.

  

**Your qualifications**

**Job Description**

Join Us as a Research Scientist– Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation

**Team:** In-trial research team within the Patient-Centered Research group

**Location:** North America or Europe

**Patient-Centered Research, In-trial qualitative research**

Evidera’s Patient-Centered Research (PCR) group combines a unique portfolio of scientific disciplines, including health sciences, psychometrics, epidemiology, psychology, and many other social sciences. Our PCR staff conduct a variety of studies using quantitative and qualitative approaches to develop clinical outcomes assessments, evaluate patient preferences and utilities, execute various implementation science studies, conduct Delphi panels and do secondary data analysis using advanced statistical techniques.

Within the PCR group, the ITR team conduct qualitative (interviews) studies and/or surveys in the context of a clinical trial to obtain feedback from clinical trial participants (patient, caregiver, investigator or study staff) on various topics i.e., understanding patients’ experience with their condition, its impacts on their lives, exploring treatment benefit, describing trial participant experiences and identifying aspects of burden from their participation. ITR can be implemented using an embedded design (e.g., ITR is defined as clinical trial activity in the clinical trial study protocol and ICF) or associated design (ITR is covered under separate protocol, separate ICF, and IRB/EC approval, with separate site recruitment and contracting). ITR can be conducted at any trial phase and at any time in the trial (screening, mid-trial, exit). Over the past few years, there has been a growing interest in ITR studies by regulators to support relevance and interpretation of trial outcomes, meaningful change and/or meaningful treatment benefit.

**Position Overview:**

The ITR Research Scientist is the independent Principal Investigator of projects responsible for overseeing all aspects of project delivery; delegates project management tasks to more junior scientific staff. Takes scientific responsibility for project completion; responsible for strategic consultation and for use of best methods to address research needs. Able to oversee and participate in a large project portfolio. Innovates scientifically and produces output of high scientific quality. Assumes significant responsibilities for sales targets and client development.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities (other duties may be assigned):**

* Applies in-depth knowledge of scientific methods, mainly qualitative but also quantitative.

* Knowledge of regulatory requirements and guidelines.
* Scientific contributions may include:
* Development and delivery of scientific studies and results directly to clients.
* Assisting colleagues to optimize study design and implementation when scientist has specific areas of expertise.
* Non-project related publications, presentations, workshops, advisory boards, participation in FDA meetings, etc.

**Strategy/Consulting**

* Develops and maintains client relationships.
* Understands pharmaceutical industry/FDA structure.
* Identifies scientific methods/plans that help clients meet their goals as well as those that will not help clients meet their goals.
* Provides scientifically rigorous deliverables that best help clients meet their objectives.
* Helps clients prepare for regulatory meetings and attend regulatory meetings with clients as requested.

**Financial & Business Development**

* Brings in proposal leads.
* Writes proposals and managing proposal writing process.
* Closes sales.

**Project Management**

* Manages internal timelines to ensure that deliverables meet external client timelines.
* Manages internal budget/staff hours per project not to exceed contracted budget.
* Manages scope creep or out of scope work.
* Manages legal/contracting issues.

**PCR Operations Support**

* Develops and presents internal scientific trainings.
* Conforms to SOPs and other Evidera/PPD requirements.
* Actively supports new product development and scientific innovation.

**Hiring requirements:**

**Education requirements**

Doctorate in a life sciences or social sciences discipline (psychology, epidemiology, health services, public health, etc…) and more than 3 years’ experience in relevant field

Master’s degree in a life sciences or social sciences discipline (psychology, epidemiology, health services, public health, etc…) and more than 5-7 years’ experience in relevant field

*In some cases, an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.*

**Experienced requirements:**

Experience using Computer-Assisted Qualitative Data Analysis Software (CAQDAS), such as Atlas.ti, NVivo, MAXQDA, Dedoose, etc. is required

Experience analyzing patient experience data is required, such as interviews, surveys, COA (clinical outcome assessment).

Experience managing multiple projects is required.

Experience in pharma or consulting companies is preferred.

Familiarity working in a clinical research environment is preferred.

jobs.title: PhD Student Position in Cell Biology
jobs.description:
**Our Profile**
---------------

The Laboratory of Oral Cell Biology at the Department of Oral Surgery and Stomatology, University of Bern, Switzerland, investigates clinically oriented mechanistic questions in oral hard and soft tissue regeneration, including the functional characterization of autogenous bone, extraction socket soft tissue, peri-implant tissues, bioactive substances, and regenerative materials. Our laboratory contributes to the field of regenerative dental medicine, with a well-established record of research publications. We are located in the state-of-the-art sitem-insel building on the Insel Campus Bern, Switzerland, providing a collaborative research environment in close proximity to the University Hospital and the broader University of Bern network.

**The Challenge**
-----------------

We are offering a PhD position to a highly motivated student. The research project investigates the impact of biomechanical stimulation, recreating the mechanical environment of bone tissue under physiological and dental surgical conditions, on cell-cell and cell-matrix interactions involved in early bone healing events. The project will utilize a variety of cell and molecular biological techniques to investigate molecular interactions that provide instructive cues for osteogenesis and osseointegration, with the aim of supporting personalized treatment approaches in dental implantology.

**Your Profile**
----------------

* Master's degree in Cell or Molecular Biology. Candidates with a Master's degree in Dental Medicine will also be considered.
* Previous experience in cell culture techniques (primary and immortalized cells), as well as cell and molecular biological methods, is a strong asset.
* Additional experience in genomics, bioinformatics, imaging, and related image-analysis technologies is advantageous but not required.
* Excellent command of written and spoken English.
* Ability to work both under supervision and independently, while contributing to a collaborative team environment.

We offer

* A full-time PhD position funded according to SNSF regulations. Candidates who already hold an external scholarship providing financial support for their PhD studies will have an advantage.
* The successful applicant will join a small research team within a collaborative research environment and will be enrolled in the Graduate School for Cellular and Biomedical Sciences (www.gcb.unibe.ch). This will complement the laboratory training with opportunities for further academic education.
* Access to modern laboratory infrastructure and central university core facilities.
* The opportunity to contribute to highly translational research projects and to produce results of interest to a broad audience, ranging from basic researchers to clinicians in the fields of dental implantology, oral and maxillofacial surgery, and orthopedics.

  

**Bewerbung und Kontakt**
-------------------------

Application process

* Applicants should be able to attend an in-person interview in Bern, Switzerland.

jobs.title: Intern, Molecular Biology
jobs.description:
**Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.**

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

**About the Role**
------------------

This is an internship for an exceptional molecular biologist who wants to do the most serious work of their life so far. You won't shadow people or run busywork — you'll own real production workflows: cloning, protein expression, purification, and characterization, on the systems that serve our customers every day.

We run a high-throughput, heavily automated lab, and we hold interns to the same bar as the rest of the team. We'll give you hard problems and a senior person to learn from, and expect you to make a real dent. For us, an internship is also the best way to find people we want to keep — do great work, and we'll want to bring you on full-time afterwards.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Run molecular cloning and protein production end to end: PCR, assembly, transformation, expression (bacterial and/or mammalian), and purification.
* Execute and improve QC on constructs and proteins (capillary electrophoresis, sequencing, SDS-PAGE) and characterization assays (binding, expression, stability).
* Take a workflow that's flaky or slow and make it reliable and faster — better protocols, better automation, fewer failures.
* Work hands-on with liquid handlers and lab automation, and help push manual protocols toward automated ones.
* Bring rigor to your data: document precisely, track samples, and make your results reproducible and traceable.
* Diagnose failures across biology, reagents, and instruments — and fix them, not just flag them.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* **Strong hands already.** You've done real molecular biology — PCR, cloning, transformation, electrophoresis, ideally protein expression and purification — through research, a project, or a prior internship, and you're good at it. Protocols don't intimidate you.
* **BSc / MSc student or recent graduate** in molecular biology, biochemistry, or a relevant field.
* **Automation- and software-curious.** You'd rather automate a tedious step than repeat it 200 times. Comfort with scripting (Python) or liquid-handling automation is a strong plus.
* **Self-starter.** You see what needs doing and do it, without waiting for someone to hand you the next step.
* **AI-native.** It's 2026 — you use AI tools as a default to learn faster and work smarter.
* **High standards and high drive.** You care that the experiment is right, you move fast, and you're excited that the robots run real customer experiments.

**Details**
-----------

* **Location:** Lausanne, Switzerland (on-site)
* **Type:** Full time
* **Start date:** Flexible
* **Duration:** Minimum 6 months

**Application deadline**

We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.

This is a hands-on research role in our biology and production team. You'll work on the science that underpins everything Adaptyv does: developing and optimizing protein expression systems, running molecular biology workflows, and pushing the boundaries of what we can produce and characterize at scale.

We express proteins at high volume across cell-free and cell-based systems, run DNA synthesis and assembly at high throughput, and characterize binding, stability, and function using BLI, SPR, and enzymatic assays.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Develop and optimize protein expression workflows — cell-free expression (PURE, lysate-based), E. coli, and potentially mammalian systems. Troubleshoot when proteins don't express, misfold, or aggregate.
* Design and execute DNA synthesis and assembly protocols: PCR, Golden Gate, Gibson. Improve yield, fidelity, and throughput.
* Develop new assays or adapt existing ones for the platform — thermostability, developability, enzyme activity, or whatever the next customer need demands.
* Run experiments yourself. This is not a project management role. You'll be at the bench doing molecular biology, analyzing data, and iterating on protocols.
* Work with the automation team to translate your methods into automated workflows. You develop the protocol that works; they make the robots run it.
* Analyze experimental data, identify failure modes, and improve methods systematically. When 20% of constructs in a batch fail to express, you figure out why.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* **MSc / PhD in molecular biology, bioengineering, or a relevant field.** Hands-on depth matters most — years at the bench doing real molecular biology counts more than the degree title.
* **Practical protein expression and purification skills.** You've expressed recombinant proteins and know what it takes to get them soluble, folded, and functional.
* **Experience with DNA synthesis, cloning, or assembly methods** (PCR, Golden Gate, Gibson). High-throughput experience is a plus.
* **Comfortable with data analysis** — you interpret chromatograms, binding curves, and expression gels without hand-holding.
* **Rigorous experimentalist.** You keep detailed notes, design proper controls, and understand why reproducibility matters when you're running hundreds of experiments a month.
* **Interested in automation.** You don't need to program robots, but you should want your protocols to become automated workflows rather than staying manual forever.
* **Independent and resourceful.** You troubleshoot using literature, first principles, and experimentation — not by waiting for someone to tell you what to try next.

**About us**
------------

The ARTORG Center for Biomedical Engineering Research, the Center for Space and Habitability at the University of Bern, and the Department of Emergency Medicine at Inselspital are looking for a motivated Research Assistant (50%) to join the interdisciplinary research project HALO-Space for a period of 24 months. The position is particularly suitable for a student enrolled in a relevant Master's programme who is interested in combining their studies with hands-on research at the intersection of biomedical engineering, extended reality, emergency medicine, human factors, and space exploration.
  
  
**Project background:**
  
HALO-Space investigates how extended reality (XR) and complementary medical technologies can support emergency care during future exploration missions to the Moon and other remote environments. In such settings, communication with Earth may be delayed or interrupted, evacuation may be impossible, and crew members with limited medical expertise may need to manage time-critical emergencies independently.
  
The project therefore focuses on developing safe and usable human-XR workflows for emergency medical support under such constraints. You will be a central member of the project team and support the core project activities from requirements analysis and system development to simulation-based evaluation and scientific dissemination.

--------------

* Reviewing research and existing technologies in space emergency medicine, XR-supported care, and human-XR interaction.

* Contributing to the adaptation and further development of the existing HALO-Assist XR platform.
* Supporting the design and implementation of XR guidance and clinical data visualisation.

jobs.description:
**Teaching and Research Assistant (3 positions)**
=================================================

#### **40%, Zurich, fixed-term**

The Department of Architecture (D-ARCH) at ETH Zurich is among the world’s leading schools of architecture, known for its teaching as much as for its research. The Chair of Architectural Behaviorology, led by Prof. Momoyo Kaijima, is looking for new members to join its team. The following positions are open:

* Teaching Assistant, 40%, starting January 2027
* Research Assistant, 40%, starting January 2027
* Teaching Assistant, 40%, starting August 2027

**Project background**
----------------------

Since 2017, the Chair of Architectural Behaviorology has been investigating architectural form through the lens of behaviors: the behavior of climate and materials, of humans and non-humans, and of architectural typologies. This approach aims to understand architecture within ecological networks, creating better accessibility to resources and finding shared commons. We see practice, research, and education as one integrated, cyclical activity in which theory and practice inform and shape one another.

Because architecture is grounded in specific places, we explore its relationship to regional lifestyles, including urban, mountainous, and agricultural contexts. In doing so, we address gaps in architectural discourse, particularly the divide between areas of consumption and production.

Our research projects include, for example, *Swiss Window Journey*, a study of window typologies across Switzerland, or *Valley Section*, a study of Swiss industrial heritage through territorial cross-sections. We also work on Housing, Shelter, and Care Behaviorology, which address domestic, post-disaster, and healthcare environments. Together with other ETH chairs, we have developed structural and spatial experiments rooted in Behaviorology.

In teaching, the Chair leads a second-year Design Studio, where around 70 students are introduced to the methodologies of Architectural Behaviorology and Actor Network Theory, as tools both for designing architecture and for understanding our built, lived, and social environment. Students gain hands-on experience in designing and drawing architectural projects, doing research, working in teams, building 1:1 structures, and presenting and defending their ideas.

You can find more information about the chair and the students’ work on our website.

**Job description**
-------------------

As a teaching assistant (40%), you teach a combination of architectural design and research within the framework of Architectural Behaviorology. You understand students' ideas and help them develop their projects further. Your knowledge of structure, construction, and detailing lets you support them in these matters too, and your research-based thinking helps them find good, workable solutions to design problems. Studio days are Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Your tasks include:

* Preparation of materials and documents for the design studio
* Supporting the students in developing their projects
* Evaluating and grading student projects
* Holding short input lectures and workshops for the studio

As a research assistant (40%), you conduct research within the framework of Architectural Behaviorology. You work across a broad range of ongoing research projects on Window Behaviorology, Urban-Rural Commons, Housing in Switzerland, Architecture for Care, and others. Among other tasks, you organize workshops and seminar weeks, help edit and publish books, and arrange exhibitions.

Teaching and research assistant contracts are limited to one year, and can be renewed annually for up to 6 years.

**Profile**
-----------

You have

* A master’s degree in architecture
* Good knowledge of English and (Swiss) German: the design studios and research are mostly taught and led in English, while German is needed to work with local collaborators
* Solid knowledge of the Swiss architectural landscape, including construction, detailing, and the most common regulations
* A good understanding of architectural design practice, and of Swiss socio-economic, cultural, historical, and political context
* Residence in Switzerland, ideally in the Zurich area

Ideally, you also have

* 2-3 years of professional experience, including work on execution plans
* Knowledge of French or Italian

**Workplace**
-------------

------------

* Your job with impact: Become part of ETH Zurich, which not only supports your professional development, but also actively contributes to positive change in society
* You can expect numerous benefits, such as public transport season tickets and car sharing, a wide range of sports offered by the ASVZ, childcare and attractive pension benefits

**We value diversity and sustainability**
-----------------------------------------

In line with our values, ETH Zurich encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, value diversity and nurture a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of all our staff and students are respected. Visit our Equal Opportunities and Diversity website to find out how we ensure a fair and open environment that allows everyone to grow and flourish. Sustainability is a core value for us – we are consistently working towards a climate-neutral future.

jobs.description:
**Research Scientist in Scientific AI and Geotechnical Engineering**
====================================================================

#### **100%, Zurich, fixed-term**

The Chair of Geotechnical Engineering at ETH Zurich, part of the Institute for Geotechnical Engineering (IGT), focuses its teaching and research on foundation engineering, soil mechanics and natural hazards. Our objective is to combine theoretical knowledge with experiments and numerical simulations to develop new methods for understanding and predicting the behaviour of soils, foundations and infrastructure.

We are opening a position in our research group at ETH Zurich, focusing on developing and integrating modern Artificial Intelligence (AI) methods into geotechnical engineering research, while maintaining a strong connection to the underlying physics and mechanics. We do not aim to develop a new AI model or replace physics-based engineering with purely data-driven AI. Instead, we want to use AI to transform the way research itself is performed—from numerical model generation and experimental data acquisition to analysis, visualization and communication.

For this purpose, we are looking for a **Research Scientist in Scientific AI and Geotechnical Engineering,** who will work across the research group, collaborating with PhD students, postdoctoral researchers and senior scientists.

The role combines scientific research, computational engineering, research automation, data science and the development of reusable AI-enabled tools. A central objective is to identify new opportunities where AI can enable research that would otherwise be difficult or impossible, and to develop capabilities that can be used across the entire group.

**Job description**
-------------------

The job will interconnect several different areas of our activity:

**Scientific AI and physics-informed modelling**

* Develop and apply AI and machine-learning approaches to challenging problems in geotechnical engineering and computational mechanics, with particular emphasis on approaches that combine data with physical knowledge, rather than relying exclusively on black-box, data-driven models.
* Explore topics including physics-informed and physics-guided machine learning, hybrid physics–ML constitutive modelling, surrogate and reduced-order models, inverse problems and parameter identification, uncertainty quantification, and AI-assisted scientific discovery.
* Apply these methods to problems involving soil behaviour, soil–structure interaction, liquefaction, natural hazards, foundations and infrastructure resilience.

**AI-enabled numerical modelling**

* Develop tools for automating and accelerating numerical modelling workflows, including finite element (FE) and potentially discrete element (DEM) and material point method (MPM) simulations.
* Automate tasks, such as model generation, geometry and mesh creation, assignment of materials and boundary conditions, parameter studies, high-performance computing (HPC) execution, model verification, extraction of results and standardised post-processing.
* Create robust and reusable tools that enable researchers throughout the group to build and analyse numerical models more efficiently while retaining appropriate engineering control and verification.

**Automation of experimental research**

* Develop AI-enabled methods for the acquisition, processing and interpretation of experimental data from laboratory and centrifuge testing.
* Automate sensor-data processing, synchronization of different measurement systems, computer-vision analysis of experiments, extraction of deformation and failure mechanisms from images and videos, identification of experimental parameters, and integration of experimental and numerical results.

**Geotechnical data intelligence**

* Develop methods to exploit the growing volume of geotechnical data available within the group and through external repositories.
* Organize and extract information from historical laboratory and centrifuge experiments and numerical analyses, and exploit large external datasets and research repositories such as DesignSafe and databases containing geotechnical and geological properties.
* Contribute to the longer-term development of structured, physics-aware geotechnical datasets to support parameter inference, model calibration, uncertainty quantification, identification of model deficiencies and the development of new physics-informed AI approaches.

**Scientific visualisation and communication**

* Develop automated approaches for transforming research results into high-quality visualisations, animations and videos.
* Develop tools that support scientific publications and presentations while facilitating effective communication of research through websites, teaching materials, professional audiences and social-media platforms.

**Group-wide AI capability**

* Help establish AI as a broadly accessible research capability within the group.
* Identify opportunities for AI across ongoing research activities, develop common tools and workflows, provide internal training and documentation, and work directly with researchers to enable them to use modern AI and computational methods effectively and independently.

jobs.title: Data Analyst – Microsoft Fabric (6-month contract)
jobs.description:

We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through **Lombard Odier Investment Managers** and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

**“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy** – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

**Data Analyst – Microsoft Fabric (6-month contract)**

As part of the HR team, you will contribute to a strategic transformation aimed at building a modern, scalable, and AI-ready data architecture based on **Data Mesh principles, Data Products, and the Microsoft Fabric platform**. The objective is to evolve from a traditional reporting-driven model to a self-service data platform that enables users to directly access trusted, governed, and reusable data assets.

Working closely with the **HR Data Officer**, you will help define the target architecture, design Data Products, model data structures, and implement governed semantic models that ensure consistent interpretation of HR metrics across analytical tools.

You will also contribute to the development of a data portal that enables users to discover, understand, and independently leverage certified datasets while benefiting from a strong governance and security framework.

You will work with complex but well-established datasets that already benefit from robust quality controls and a solid analytical foundation. The challenge is not to fix data quality issues, but to transform existing data into reusable, secure, and scalable analytical assets that can be leveraged by business users, analytics tools, and AI solutions.

This role combines hands-on delivery with genuine architectural responsibilities. As the Microsoft Fabric platform is currently being built, **you will take part in key decisions regarding data modelling, security, governance, and self-service analytics, helping establish a sustainable foundation for future data and AI initiatives**.

**YOUR ROLE**

  

* Gather, analyze, and formalize HR business requirements and translate them into data and analytics solutions.
* Design and model Data Products following Data Mesh and Medallion Architecture principles.
* Develop and maintain data transformation pipelines from Silver to Gold layers, including associated dimensional models.
* Build and maintain semantic models and enterprise HR metrics for Power BI, Excel, and Copilot.
* Define and implement data security mechanisms, including Row-Level Security (RLS) and Column/Object-Level Security (CLS/OLS), to protect sensitive information.
* Contribute to the implementation and continuous evolution of the Microsoft Fabric platform in collaboration with Group IT and Data Office teams.

**YOUR PROFILE**

  

* 4-5 years of experience in Data, Business Intelligence, Analytics, or Data Engineering.

* **Very good command of Microsoft Fabric environments is strongly desired (Microsoft Fabric, Lakehouse, Medallion Architecture)**
* Excellent command of SQL and Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL).
* Excellent command of Data Modelling (Star Schema), Power BI Semantic Models, and DAX .
* Excellent knowledge of Data Product design and Data Governance principles, with a strong user-centric mindset and focus on self-service analytics.

* Comfortable operating in both hands-on delivery and solution architecture capacities.
* Strong ability to collaborate with business stakeholders and technical teams in a data-driven environment.
* Strong analytical and structured thinking, at ease with business requirements analysis and formalization.

* Excellent communication skills with both business and IT stakeholders.
* Autonomous, pragmatic, and service-oriented approach.
* **Resident in Switzerland or willingness to relocate.**

**Our Maison’s DNA** is defined by five core values. **Excellence** drives us to be the best at what we do, while **Innovation** fuels our progress. **Respect** underpins every interaction, and **Integrity** shapes our actions. Together, we are **One Team**, united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

jobs.title: Internship (6 months) - Compliance data quality control & Support
jobs.description:
**Description**

Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) is one of Switzerland's leading private banks, serving private and institutional clients from Geneva, Zurich and a network of international offices. Within the bank, the Compliance Projects & Tools team is responsible for the applications, data flows and working methods that allow the Compliance function to monitor the bank's activity and meet its regulatory obligations.

As a Data & Process Analyst, you will join this team on concrete, hands-on assignments. Your work will consist of understanding how a compliance process works today, locating and analysing the data behind it, and proposing a clearer, better documented and more automated way of running it. You will move between business questions, banking datasets and the tools that consume them.

Alongside the analytical work, you will take part in the delivery of Compliance projects: gathering requirements from the business, writing specifications, preparing and running tests, and documenting how a new tool is meant to behave. Doing so, you will see in a short period, how a regulated process is designed, challenged and industrialised.

Artificial intelligence is part of the toolbox. The bank provides its staff with secure enterprise generative-AI assistants, and Compliance is actively looking at how to use them well: summarizing and comparing regulatory documents, extracting structured information from free text, drafting and reviewing procedures, and answering recurring questions faster.

**Mission**

Support the Compliance Projects & Tools team in analysing, documenting and improving compliance processes and the data that feeds them, and in delivering the tools that support the function.
  
The role sits at the intersection of data analysis, process design and project delivery: taking an open question, breaking it down, testing it against real data and coming back with a clear, evidence-based recommendation – making full and sensible use of the analytical and artificial-intelligence tools the bank makes available.
  
You will be mentored by a Change Manager in Compliance Projects & Tools team, based in our Geneva office, and will work closely with Compliance officers and IT teams.

**Main responsibilities**

* Map and document compliance processes, controls and data flows, and identify simplification or automation opportunities
* Extract, clean and structure data from several internal banking systems in order to answer precise compliance questions
* Build small scripts and prototypes, mainly in Python and SQL, to automate recurring manual tasks / reportings and reduce operational effort
* Contribute to Compliance projects end to end: requirements, specifications, test cases and user acceptance testing
* Turn analytical findings into clear, concise material that non-technical stakeholders and management can act upon

**Education**

* Currently enrolled at EPFL (or an equivalent Swiss university) in a Bachelor's final year or Master's program in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Engineering or another quantitative discipline
* Solid foundation in statistics and data handling; academic or personal projects involving AI are a plus

  
**Experience**

* Working knowledge of Python and a genuine willingness to develop it further in a professional environment; familiarity with SQL is an advantage
* Comfortable working with large or imperfect datasets: cleaning, joining, reconciling and validating data before drawing conclusions
* Hands-on user of generative-AI assistants, with a realistic sense of what they do well, where they fail, and how to verify what they produce
* Good command of Excel and the ability to produce clear, well-structured written documentation
* Interest in banking, financial markets or regulation; previous experience in the financial industry is a plus but is not required
* No prior compliance knowledge is expected: the regulatory context will be taught on the job

**Language**

* French: Fluent
* English: Fluent

**Personal Skills**

* Curious and inventive: you want to understand how a process really works before proposing a solution, and you enjoy building things rather than only describing them
* Structured, rigorous and quality conscious, with a critical eye on your own results
* Sound judgement on AI-generated output: you verify it against the source before relying on it, and you say so when it does not hold
* Able to explain technical work in simple terms, in writing and verbally, to non-technical stakeholders
* Autonomous and pragmatic: you can take an open question, break it down and come back with something concrete within a short timeframe
* Reliable, discreet and at ease with the confidentiality standards of a private bank
* A flexible team player, comfortable in an environment where priorities evolve quickly

jobs.title: Biological Technical Assistant (BTA) - Plant Transformation and Biotechnology
jobs.description:
The Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft (www.fraunhofer.com) is one of the world's leading organizations for application-oriented research. 74 institutes develop pioneering technologies for our economy and society – more precisely: 30 000 people from technology, science, administration and IT. They know: Anyone who comes to Fraunhofer wants to and can make a difference. For themselves, for us and for the markets of today and tomorrow.

Biotechnology is the basis of the bioeconomy and contributes sustainably to the knowledge-based production and industrial use of biogenic raw materials. On behalf of our customers, the Fraunhofer IME Molecular Biotechnology Division establishes tailored plants and microbes for applications such as the production of food and renewable raw materials, the manufacture of technical and pharmaceutical proteins, and the handling of anthropogenic pollutants including greenhouse gases, which we can exploit to produce valuable substances. Our synergistic activities in the fields of green, red and white biotechnology have allowed us to become established successfully in the research landscape and on the market. We offer our partners in academia, industry and the regulatory authorities a comprehensive research and service portfolio.

  

The Department of Photosynthesis and Biohybrid Systems (PBS) at our Aachen site develops innovative biotechnological approaches to improve crop productivity, stress resilience and resource-use efficiency, thereby contributing to sustainable agriculture and long-term food security.

  

To support our research activities, we are looking for a motivated Biological Technical Assistant (BTA) to strengthen our team, particularly in plant tissue culture, plant transformation and molecular biology.

  

**Become part of our team!**

  

**Be part of change**

* Carry out plant tissue culture, transformation and regeneration.
* Conduct molecular biology, protein biochemistry and microbiology experiments, including DNA isolation, PCR, qPCR, cloning and immunoblotting.
* Assist with phenotypic and photosynthetic characterization of plants.
* Document experimental procedures and results, and contribute to laboratory organization and the care and maintenance of laboratory equipment
  

**What you contribute**

* Completed vocational training as a biological technical assistant (BTA), laboratory technician or a comparable qualification.
* Practical experience in plant tissue culture and sterile working techniques.
* Experience in plant transformation and regeneration techniques is highly desirable.
* Hands-on experience in molecular biology techniques, including DNA isolation, PCR and cloning.
* Good written and spoken English skills
  

Your professional qualifications are complemented by a structured, careful and independent working style, initiative, willingness to learn, good communication skills and enthusiasm for teamwork.

  

**What we offer**

* An interdisciplinary, collegial and supportive working environment that fosters collaboration, creativity and innovation.
* Modern laboratory facilities and advanced analytical technologies.
* Diverse and challenging tasks in an innovative research field.
* Comprehensive onboarding and tailored training opportunities to develop your technical expertise and professional skills.
* Flexible working hours and, where compatible with operational requirements, the possibility of mobile working, as well as a range of measures to support work-life balance and family-friendly working conditions – recognized with the Fraunhofer Family Logo.

The weekly working time is 39 hours. The position is initially limited to a two-year term.

We value and promote the diversity of our employees' skills and therefore welcome all applications – regardless of age, gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion, ideology, disability, sexual orientation and identity. With its focus on developing key technologies that are vital for the future and enabling the commercial utilization of this work by business and industry, Fraunhofer plays a central role in the innovation process. jobs.title: Technische Assistenz (BTA) - Pflanzentransformation und Biotechnologie
jobs.description:

Sie wissen: Wer zu Fraunhofer kommt, will und kann etwas verändern. Für sich, für uns und die Märkte von heute und morgen.

Als Basis der Bioökonomie trägt die Biotechnologie nachhaltig zur wissensbasierten Erzeugung und Nutzung biogener Rohstoffe in der Industrie bei. Wir etablieren bedarfsoptimierte Pflanzen und Mikroben für verschiedene Anwendungen: Für die Produktion von Nahrungsmitteln und nachwachsenden Rohstoffen, technischen und pharmazeutischen Proteinen sowie für den Umgang mit anthropogen erzeugten Schadstoffen wie klimaschädlichen Gasen, die wir zur Herstellung wertvoller Stoffe erschließen. Durch Synergien unserer Aktivitäten im Bereich der Grünen und Weißen Biotechnologie haben wir uns in der Forschungslandschaft und am Markt erfolgreich etabliert und bieten unseren Partnern in Behörden, Akademia und Industrie ein umfassendes Forschungs- und Dienstleistungsangebot.

  

Die Abteilung Photosynthese und Biohybride Systeme (PBS) am Standort Aachen entwickelt innovative biotechnologische Ansätze, um die Produktivität, Klimaresilienz und Ressourcennutzungseffizienz von Nutzpflanzen zu verbessern und damit zu einer nachhaltigen Landwirtschaft und langfristigen Ernährungssicherheit beizutragen.

  

Zur Unterstützung unserer Forschungsaktivitäten suchen wir eine engagierte technische Assistenz (BTA), die unser Team insbesondere in den Bereichen Pflanzengewebekultur, Pflanzentransformation und molekularbiologische Methoden verstärkt.

  

**Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams!**

  

**Hier sorgen Sie für Veränderung**

* Durchführung von Pflanzengewebekultur, Pflanzentransformation und Regeneration.
* Durchführung molekularbiologischer, proteinbiochemischer und mikrobiologischer Arbeiten, einschließlich DNA-Isolierung, PCR, qPCR, Klonierung und Immunoblotting.

* Dokumentation von Versuchsabläufen und Ergebnissen sowie Mitwirkung bei der Labororganisation und -instandhaltung.
  

**Hiermit bringen Sie sich ein**

* Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Biologisch-technische Assistenz (BTA), Biologielaborant\*in oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

* Praktische Erfahrung mit molekularbiologischen Methoden, insbesondere DNA-Isolierung, PCR und Klonierung.

* Eine strukturierte, sorgfältige und selbstständige Arbeitsweise, Eigeninitiative und Lernbereitschaft sowie gute kommunikative Fähigkeiten und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team runden Ihr Profil ab.
  

**Was wir für Sie bereithalten**

* Ein interdisziplinäres, kollegiales und wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld, das Zusammenarbeit, Kreativität und Innovation fördert.
* Eine moderne Laborausstattung und innovative Analysetechnologien.
* Abwechslungsreiche und anspruchsvolle Aufgaben in einem innovativen Forschungsgebiet.
* Eine umfassende Einarbeitung und individuell abgestimmte Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten zur Erweiterung Ihrer fachlichen Kompetenzen und beruflichen Qualifikationen.
* Eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge (VBL) und vermögenswirksame Leistungen.
* Flexible Arbeitszeiten (Gleitzeit) zur besseren Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben - ausgezeichnet mit dem "Fraunhofer Familienlogo".
  

Wir wertschätzen und fördern die Vielfalt der Kompetenzen unserer Mitarbeitenden und begrüßen daher alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.Schwerbehinderte Menschen werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt eingestellt. Die wöchentliche Arbeitszeit beträgt 39 Stunden. Die Stelle ist zunächat auf zwei Jahre befristet.

Mit ihrer Fokussierung auf zukunftsrelevante Schlüsseltechnologien sowie auf die Verwertung der Ergebnisse in Wirtschaft und Industrie spielt die Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft eine zentrale Rolle im Innovationsprozess. **PhD Position in Translational B Cell Immunology in Neuroinflammation (m/f/d)**

The position is limited until December 31, 2029.

In our research laboratory at the German Center for Neurodegenerative Diseases (DZNE), led by Prof. Anne-Katrin Pröbstel, we investigate the mechanisms of neuroimmunology with a particular focus on multiple sclerosis, MOG antibody-associated disease, and the role of the microbiome in disease progression. We investigate how immune cells contribute to the development and maintenance of neuroinflammatory processes and which molecular targets can be identified from these findings for future therapies. Our interdisciplinary team combines state-of-the-art methods in immunology, microbiome research, molecular biology, and therapy development. Together with clinical and scientific partners and embedded in the Immunosensation Cluster of Excellence3, we are working to translate new findings from the laboratory into medically relevant applications. With a broad range of disciplines, it shapes the future through excellent research and teaching. Through close collaborations with leading research institutions, innovative companies, and renowned cultural organizations, it advances interdisciplinary developments. With around 17,000 students and approximately 10,000 employees, it defines Jena as a vibrant, internationally connected city of science and innovation.

The Institute of Biochemistry and Biophysics seeks to fill the position of a

**Doctoral candidate in Molecular Biology Glucocorticoid Receptor Function in Hepatic Inflammation**
====================================================================================================

commencing on **01.03.2027**. We offer a doctoral candidate position (65% TV-L) in a DFG-funded research project, offered as a fixed-term position until **29.02.2030**.

**About the project:**

Glucocorticoids are essential regulators of metabolism, immune function, and the body's response to stress. Their diverse effects are mediated by the glucocorticoid receptor (GR), a transcription factor that translates hormonal signals into changes in gene expression. Under inflammatory conditions, glucocorticoid signalling can be altered, with important consequences for cellular function and the body's response to stress.  
We are seeking an intellectually curious and highly motivated PhD candidate to investigate the molecular regulation of glucocorticoid receptor function in the liver under inflammatory conditions. The project combines advanced liver-on-a-chip technology with omics approaches to investigate glucocorticoid signalling in a human-relevant experimental setting and characterize molecular changes associated with inflammation.  
This interdisciplinary project offers the opportunity to work at the interface of molecular biology, advanced cellular models, and data-driven research, contributing to a better understanding of the interplay between inflammation, hormone signalling, and gene regulation. The successful candidate will work closely with the project leader, Dr. Aishwarya Iyer-Bierhoff, and benefit from the expertise and collaborative research environment of the Department of Biochemistry.

**Your responsibilities:**
--------------------------

* Work with cell lines and liver-on-a-chip models, applying a range of molecular and cellular biology techniques.
* Contribute to omics-based investigations and the analysis and interpretation of molecular datasets.
* Critically evaluate experimental results, present findings at scientific meetings, and contribute to scientific publications.
* Develop independent scientific questions and collaborate with other members of the research team.

**Your profile:**
-----------------

* An excellent Master's degree (or equivalent) in biochemistry, molecular biology, cell biology, biotechnology, pharmacology, or a related discipline.
* A strong academic background and a keen interest in molecular mechanisms of cellular signalling, inflammation, and gene regulation.
* Excellent analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to approach scientific questions independently and creatively.
* Motivation to engage in interdisciplinary experimental and computational research.
* Good written and spoken English (C1 level).

**The following experience would be a major advantage**

* Cell culture and experimental model systems.
* Molecular biology, protein biochemistry, or gene-expression analysis.
* Bioinformatics, computational biology, or analysis of high-dimensional molecular datasets.
* Omics technologies and the interpretation transcriptomic, proteomic, and other molecular profiling data.
* Microphysiological systems, organ-on-a-chip technology, or advanced cell culture platforms.

**We offer:**
-------------

* An exciting research project addressing fundamental questions in glucocorticoid receptor biology and inflammation, with an opportunity to work with liver-on-a-chip technology and omics approaches.
* Scientific supervision, methodological training, and opportunities to develop independent research skills.
* A Graduate Academy for doctoral candidates and postdocs.

Bookmark jobad

Malaria control remains heavily dependent on insecticide-based interventions, including insecticide-treated bed nets and indoor residual spraying, which have averted over 1.2 billion cases since the turn of the century. Whilst insecticides prevent infections, drugs are used for curative therapy. In both cases, widespread use of limited chemistries has led the emergence and spread of resistance both within the mosquito vector and the parasitic pathogen. Beyond reducing intervention efficacy, resistance in either the mosquito or parasite can alter their biology and interactions, ultimately influencing malaria transmission.Our interdisciplinary research group investigates the complex interactions between Anopheles mosquitoes, Plasmodium parasites and insecticidal and drug-based interventions. We study how conventional and next-generation insecticides influence parasite development and transmission, both directly and through changes to mosquito metabolism and immune responses. We also investigate how insecticide-resistance mechanisms affect vector competence and how drug-resistant Plasmodium falciparum parasites are transmitted by mosquitoes. To address these questions, we combine experimental mosquito infections, insecticide bioassays, molecular and cellular biology, microscopy, genomics, transcriptomics, bioinformatics and mathematical modelling, using both laboratory colonies and field-derived mosquitoes. Our overarching aim is to translate mechanistic understanding into evidence that supports the development and effective use of malaria-control interventions.If you're interested in contributing to malaria research as part of a young, international team, we look forward to receiving your application.

**Internship and Master's Thesis: Computational Biology for Allergy Research (f/m/x)**
======================================================================================

103055

Full time  
39 hrs./week

Neuherberg near Munich

**At Helmholtz Munich, we develop groundbreaking solutions for a healthier society in a rapidly changing world. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation. Through strong partnerships, we accelerate the transfer of new ideas from the lab to real-life applications, improving lives.**

Our Group at the / at Helmholtz Munich investigates the molecular mechanisms that regulate B cell-mediated immune responses. Our research focuses on understanding how B lymphocytes differentiate into effector B cells, including antibody-secreting cells and memory B cells, during homeostasis and in diseases such as autoimmunity, cancer, and allergy.

Allergic diseases, including asthma and food allergies, affect more than one billion people worldwide and represent a major global health burden. A hallmark of allergic immune responses is the production of immunoglobulin E (IgE), a key driver of disease pathogenesis. However, the cellular and molecular mechanisms that sustain IgE responses remain poorly understood.

Recent studies have identified **type 2 memory B cells (MBC2s)** and **long-lived IgE-secreting plasma cells (IgE-PCs)** as key cellular reservoirs of IgE. Despite their importance, the molecular pathways governing their development, maintenance, and function remain largely unknown.

**Project Description**

We are seeking a highly motivated Master's student (f/m/x) with a strong interest in **computational biology, statistical learning**, and **immunology** to join our team for an internship and subsequent Master's thesis project. The goal of this project is to identify genes, molecular pathways, and regulatory networks that drive the differentiation and function of IgE-PCs and MBC2s. Candidate genes identified through bioinformatics analyses will subsequently be functionally validated in our laboratory using cutting-edge in vitro and in vivo CRISPR/Cas9 screening platforms in mouse and human B cells.

**Your tasks**
--------------

* Analyze and integrate, using statistical learning algorithms, multi-omics datasets (single-cell transcriptomic, epigenomic, and proteomic data) derived from B cells isolated from allergic patients and mouse models of allergic disease.
* Identify candidate genes and pathways associated with the generation and maintenance of IgE-secreting plasma cells and type 2 memory B cells.
* Contribute to the development of hypotheses for experimental validation using CRISPR-based functional genomics approaches.

**Your profile**
----------------

* Master's student in Bioinformatics, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Machine Learning, Biotechnology, Immunology, or a related field.
* Experience with programming and data analysis (preferably in Python).
* A high degree of scientific curiosity, creativity, flexibility, and enthusiasm for working in an interdisciplinary and international team.

Desirable qualifications

* Experience with multi-omics dataset analysis.
* You know the basics of immunology or are keen to learn them.

**The student will be jointly supervised by Zaikang Lin from the Fabian Theis laboratory and our research group,** offering a unique opportunity to receive interdisciplinary training at the interface of computational biology, statistical learning, and immunology.

If you are interested in applying computational approaches to answer fundamental questions in B cell immunology and allergy, we would be very happy to hear from you.

This position has a fixed term of 2 + 6 months.

Managing Director Mike Frieser: „We believe that diversity is the key to groundbreaking research and innovative solutions. Our flexible working models and remote options create a supportive environment for balancing work and family life. For us, contributing to a healthier society in such an inspiring workplace is truly meaningful.“

---------------------------

If you have any questions, feel free to contact Dr. Lesly Calderon Dominguez, lesly.calderon@helmholtz-munich.de, who will be happy to help.

Our recruiting is decentralized - your application will be reviewed directly by the specialist department in which you could work in the future.

**Please send your application only via our online application tool and with the following documents:**

* Cover letter
* CV

If you have obtained a university degree abroad, we will require further documents from you regarding the comparability of your degree at the latest by the time you start work.

We are committed to promoting a culture of diversity and welcome applications from talented people regardless of gender, cultural background, nationality, ethnicity, sexual identity, physical abilities, religion or age. *Application deadline: 15/12/2026*

The Institute of Clinical Genetics and Genomic Medicine at the University Hospital Würzburg is seeking a highly motivated **PhD student** (m/f/d, 65% TV-L) with a strong background in **molecular genetics and/or cell biology** to join our team in the field of cancer genomics.

The successful applicant will join an interdisciplinary team working on the **José Carreras Leukämie-Stiftung** funded project aimed at improving our understanding of pediatric acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) using long-read DNA sequencing. The successful applicant will be working closely with other members of the ALL research group and the bioinformatics team on sample selection, sequencing, data analysis and functional validation of the findings.

### **We offer**

* An international, dynamic, and collaborative multidisciplinary research environment.
* Access to state-of-the-art genomics and sequencing facilities.
* Close integration with clinical departments and translational research initiatives.
* Full access to cutting-edge GPU-based servers capable of diverse AI, HPC and computing workloads.
* Opportunities for career development and scientific networking.
* Salary according to TV-L E13.
* Flexible working hours and a family-friendly environment, helping you balance personal and professional life.
* Excellent employee benefits, including sports and healthcare workshops, an attractive occupational pension, and a subsidized canteen, to enhance your overall well-being.

### **Your Tasks**

* Sample selection, communication with the biobank and other stakeholders involved in sample collection and data management.
* Isolation of DNA, RNA and proteins from mononuclear cells, cell lysates, blood or bone marrow, quality control and sample management.
* DNA and RNA library preparation, quality control and sequencing on Illumina NovaSeq X plus, PacBio Revio and Oxford Nanopore PromethION platforms.
* Other molecular genetics assays (e.g., qPCR, Sanger sequencing, MLPA).
* Maintaining cell cultures, CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing in ALL cell lines, cell viability assays, western blots, and flow cytometry.
* Data analysis, interpretation and visualization.
* Collaboration with bioinformaticians and members of the European ALL study groups (AIEOP-BFM and ALLTogether).
* Publication of results in peer-reviewed journals.
* Presentation of research findings at international scientific conferences (e.g., ESHG, ISCB, EHA, ASH).
* Supervision of master’s and bachelor’s students.

**Project Background**

Prognosis and treatment of pediatric acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) are largely determined by underlying genetic alterations. However, in approximately 10% of pediatric ALL cases no genetic alterations relevant to risk-stratification can be identified using conventional cytogenetic, molecular genetics and short-read sequencing-based methods (B-other). Children diagnosed with B-other ALL receive uniform treatment, despite genetic heterogeneity of their leukemia, resulting in worse outcomes (5-year EFS 77.3%) compared to children diagnosed with favorable genetic subtypes. Therefore, the discovery of novel biomarkers is urgently required in order to enhance risk stratification, enable tailored therapeutic approaches and improve outcomes in pediatric B-other ALL.

In this project, we will apply long-read whole-genome sequencing, integrated multi-omic and clinical data analysis, and machine learning approaches to characterize the genetic and epigenetic landscape of B-other ALL and identify novel biomarkers for improved risk stratification. Promising candidates will be further investigated in functional in vitro models to assess their biological relevance.

### **Your Profile**

* Master’s degree in Biology, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Biomedical Sciences or a related field.
* Hands-on experience in molecular biology techniques.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Ability to work independently and in an interdisciplinary team.
* Background in cancer genetics or cancer biology will be considered an advantage.
* Experience with bioinformatics tools and programming (e.g., R, Python, or similar) will be considered an advantage.

### **This is what you can look forward to**

* Challenging, diverse and evolving area of responsibility
* Attractive salary according to TV-L incl. annual special payment
* Training and Continuing Education
* Retirement Pension Plan
* Company daycare center with extended opening hours
* Company sports program
* Flexible Working Hours
* JobBike
* Corporate Benefits
