jobs.title: Research Associate at TLZ-RT at Fraunhofer ISC
jobs.description:
The Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft (www.fraunhofer.com) is one of the world's leading organizations for application-oriented research. 74 institutes develop pioneering technologies for our economy and society – more precisely: 30 000 people from technology, science, administration and IT. They know: Anyone who comes to Fraunhofer wants to and can make a difference. For themselves, for us and for the markets of today and tomorrow.

The Fraunhofer Translation Center for Regenerative Therapies (TLZ-RT) at Fraunhofer ISC in Würzburg develops innovative solutions for the life sciences sector at the intersection of biology, materials science, laboratory automation, and biomedical translation.
  
The focus is on cell-based tissue models and test systems, novel biomaterials, and scalable production processes for preclinical and clinical applications. Our partners include companies from the medical technology, cosmetics, biotechnology, and pharmaceutical sectors, as well as clinical institutions.
  
For our ***Human-Relevant in vitro Models & Test Systems*** department, we are looking for a Research Associate to join our team in Würzburg starting January 1, 2027, and contribute to application-oriented research and development projects.

  

**Be part of change**

You will:

* develop, establish, and apply complex in vitro models and cell-based test systems, particularly 3D tissue and barrier models, with a focus on the skin.
* independently carry out laboratory work, including cell culture (also stem cell and organoid culture) and the development and performance of assays.
* plan, document, and analyze experiments, and ensure the scientific quality and reproducibility of the results.
* collaborate actively with industry and research partners on projects and support project management in the design, implementation, and reporting of projects.
* prepare experimental results for reports, presentations, and publications.
* support the further development of the department’s scientific and technological portfolio, e.g., by establishing new methods and technologies.
* collaborate closely and interdisciplinarily with the department’s staff as well as with other departments at TLZ-RT and Fraunhofer ISC.
  

**What you contribute**

* a completed university degree (Master’s degree or equivalent) in biology, biotechnology, biomedicine, or a related field.
* substantial hands-on experience in cell culture and, ideally, in developing, establishing, and applying cell-based in vitro models and test systems, preferably 3D tissue and barrier models with a focus on skin.
* experience working with primary cells; knowledge of human stem cell culture and organoid work is a plus.
* hands-on experience in characterizing cell and tissue models using immunohistochemical and/or molecular biology methods is desirable.
* knowledge of functional cell-based assays, such as those used to investigate cell viability, cytotoxicity, or barrier integrity, is an asset.
* experience in the microscopic analysis of cell and tissue models, as well as in the evaluation and analysis of microscopic images.
* experience in applied research and development.
* a meticulous, structured approach to work and strong organizational skills.
* strong teamwork and communication skills.
* fluency in spoken and written German and English.
  

**Please submit the following documents in either German or English:**

* a detailed CV.
* a cover letter (maximum one page) explaining why you are a suitable candidate for this position, particularly highlighting your relevant laboratory and methodological experience, your interest in applied research, and how these relate to your professional background.
* academic transcripts and relevant certificates.
  

**What we offer**

* varied research projects with opportunities for independent scientific work in a dynamic, innovation-driven research field.
* collaboration on application-oriented projects with industry partners and clinical institutions—from development through to implementation.
* a highly qualified, interdisciplinary team working in an innovation-driven environment.
* a strong network within the Fraunhofer Society, both within and across institutes.
* individual training and development opportunities.
* benefits in accordance with the Collective Agreement for the Public Service (TVöD), as well as flexible working arrangements to support work-life balance.
  

The weekly work schedule is 39 hours. The position is a one-year fixed-term contract and may also be filled on a part-time basis. Employment, compensation, and benefits are based on the Collective Bargaining Agreement for the Public Sector (TVöD). Compensation is determined based on qualifications and assigned duties, up to Pay Grade 13 of the TVöD. We value and promote the diversity of our employees' skills and therefore welcome all applications – regardless of age, gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion, ideology, disability, sexual orientation and identity. Severely disabled persons are given preference in the event of equal suitability. Our tasks are diverse and adaptable – for applicants with disabilities, we work together to find solutions that best promote their abilities. Appointment, remuneration and social security benefits based on the public-sector collective wage agreement (TVöD).

With its focus on developing key technologies that are vital for the future and enabling the commercial utilization of this work by business and industry, Fraunhofer plays a central role in the innovation process. As a pioneer and catalyst for groundbreaking developments and scientific excellence, Fraunhofer helps shape society now and in the future.

**Position Summary:**

The Research Associate will support Research and Development activities in the field of molecular biology, with a focus on the identification and verification of DNA methylation-based biomarkers and the development, optimization, and verification of epigenetic qPCR assays and ddPCR-based assays. The position involves the execution of laboratory experiments, processing of clinical study samples, analysis and documentation of experimental data, and support of laboratory quality and operational activities in a regulated environment.

**Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:**

* Perform laboratory activities in accordance with approved SOPs, work instructions, and experimental protocols with appropriate guidance.
* Conduct laboratory experiments to support the identification and verification of DNA methylation-based biomarkers.
* Support the development, optimization, verification, and transfer of (epigenetic) qPCR- and ddPCR-based assays.
* Perform experimental quality control activities and support the qualification and release of plasmid standards and other critical reagents.
* Receive, prepare, process, and document clinical trial samples in accordance with defined procedures and study requirements.
* Perform epigenetic immune monitoring analyses, including bisulfite conversion and purification of DNA samples, qPCR analysis, data evaluation, and quality control.
* Analyze, interpret, document, and communicate experimental results to project scientists and team members.
* Identify technical issues, investigate deviations, and support troubleshooting and root cause analysis activities.
* Prepare reagents, controls, and laboratory materials required for routine and development activities.
* Operate and maintain laboratory automation and liquid handling systems.
* Perform routine equipment checks, maintenance, calibration support, and associated documentation activities.
* Maintain accurate, complete, and traceable laboratory records in accordance with applicable quality requirements.
* Support the preparation, review, and revision of SOPs, work instructions, protocols, reports, and other controlled documents.
* Participate in method evaluations, feasibility studies, and implementation of new laboratory technologies.
* Collaborate with scientists, project managers, and laboratory personnel to meet project timelines and milestones.
* Support laboratory organization, inventory management, ordering of consumables, and monitoring of laboratory supplies.
* Perform all activities in accordance with applicable health, safety, quality, and data integrity requirements.
* Contribute to inspection and audit readiness activities.

**Qualifications:**

**Minimum Required:**

* Bachelor's degree in molecular biology, Biology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or a related scientific discipline.
* Minimum of 2 years of relevant laboratory experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Practical experience with molecular biology laboratory techniques.
* Experience working with scientific procedures, protocols, and laboratory documentation.
* Ability to communicate effectively in English, both written and verbal.
* German language skills at a minimum B1 level.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.

**Other Required:**

* Ability to organize, prioritize, and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Structured, reliable, and quality-focused working style.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and within a multidisciplinary team.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to evaluate experimental data and document results appropriately.
* Willingness to continuously learn new methods, technologies, and quality system requirements.

**Preferred:**

* Experience with DNA methylation analysis and bisulfite conversion methods.
* Experience with qPCR and/or ddPCR technologies.
* Experience processing and handling clinical trial samples.
* Experience with assay development, optimization, verification, or validation.
* Experience operating automated liquid handling systems.
* Experience with Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS).
* Familiarity with GraphPad Prism or other scientific data analysis software.
* Experience working in a regulated or quality-controlled laboratory environment (e.g., GCP, GLP, ISO, CAP, CLIA, or equivalent).
* Knowledge of cell biology and immunology concepts.
* Experience supporting scientific reports, technical documentation, or publications.

The University of Koblenz stands for interdisciplinarity in practice, innovative strength, and a dynamic approach to shap-
  
ing the future. It makes a decisive contribution to the development of a strong academic and economic region, while also
  
maintaining a strong international presence and network. Its researchers are dedicated to addressing key, socially rele-
  
vant issues in the four focus areas of education, computer science, culture and communication, and materials and the
  
environment. Approximately 9,800 students benefit from a high-quality, flexible range of academic programs. The uni-
  
versity offers its staff attractive working conditions. Join our team and help shape our future!

The position is for 65% of a full-time workload (currently 25.35
  
hours per week) and is limited to a term of three years. The
  
fixed-term appointment is based on the provisions of the Ger-
  
man Act on Fixed-Term Employment Contracts in Academia
  
(WissZeitVG). Further academic qualification (Ph.D.) is part of
  
the job responsibilities and is strongly encouraged.
  
  
The positions are in the field of evolution, genomics, and cell
  
biology of algae within the Aquatic Ecosystem Analysis research
  
group at the Institute for Integrated Natural Sciences, Biology,
  
in Division 3: Mathematics/Natural Sciences.
  
  
How do new photosynthetic organelles arise, and how are
  
they permanently integrated into a eukaryotic cell? In a
  
newly discovered photosynthetic single-celled organism, we
  
are investigating an unusually complex plastid whose evolu-
  
tionary origin and cellular integration have so far remained
  
largely unclear. This system thus offers a rare opportunity to
  
study key processes of the evolution and integration of photo-
  
synthetic organelles in a living organism. Preliminary genomic
  
and ultrastructural data suggest that the plastids arose from a
  
complex endosymbiosis with an alga.
  
  
At the heart of the project is a yet-to-be-named unicellular alga
  
from the Cercozoa. Two closely linked doctoral projects are
  
jointly investigating the evolutionary origin of the plastids. One
  
of the projects focuses on genomic adaptations, while the sec-
  
ond, primarily using microscopy, examines the cellular integra-
  
tion and functional properties of the plastids. To this end, we
  
combine modern genomics and phylogenomics with bioinfor-
  
matic analyses, cell culture, and light and electron microscopy
  
techniques. Among other things, we are investigating the ge-
  
nomes of the host cell and the plastid, the transfer and origin
  
of plastidial genes and proteins, as well as the architecture and
  
inheritance of plastids within the cell.
  
Both positions combine experimental work in the wet lab with
  
the analysis of genomic and microscopic data, offering scope
  
for diverse research focuses in the fields of algae evolution, ge-
  
nomics, and cell biology.

The doctoral projects are based in the Aquatic Ecosystem
  
Analysis research group, are closely coordinated, and are de-
  
signed to last three years. Further information about the re-
  
search group can be found at www.kennethdumack.de.

Your Responsibilities
  
 Advanced scientific training with the goal of earning a Ph.D.
  
 Independent work on a Ph.D. project focusing on the evolu-

tion and cellular integration of a complex plastid
  
 Conducting and evaluating genomic, phylogenomic, micro-

cus

national journals, as well as presentation at scientific con-
  
ferences

with national and international partners

equivalent) in biology, biochemistry, molecular biology, bio-
  
informatics, or a related field

lution, genomics, and/or cell biology

methods, genomics and bioinformatics, phylogenetics or
  
phylogenomics, or light and electron microscopy

self with new experimental or bioinformatics methods

work

work, as well as a high degree of motivation and scientific
  
curiosity

jobs.description:
**Institution**Faculty of Mathematics, Informatics and Natural Sciences, Department of Mathematics/Physics, Cluster of Excellence “Quantum Universe”

**Salary level**EGR. 13 TV-L

**Start date**01.08.2027 or later, fixed for a period of two years (This is a fixed-term contract in accordance with Section 2 of the academic fixed-term labor contract act [Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz, WissZeitVG]).

**Application deadline**01.12.2026

**Scope of work**full-time position suitable for part-time

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------

Duties include academic services in the project named above. Research associates may also pursue further academic qualifications outside of their work responsibilities.

The Cluster of Excellence “Quantum Universe” performs research to understand mass and gravity at the interface between quantum physics and cosmology. The research team includes leading scientists from mathematics, particle physics, astrophysics, and cosmology at the University of Hamburg and DESY.

We aim to fill a postdoctoral position for research on higher structures and categorification in the context of quantum topology in the research group of Prof. Dr. Paul Wedrich, and in close collaboration with Prof. Dr. Tobias Dyckerhoff, as part of the project “Stable Categorification”. The project is part of an interdisciplinary collaboration between mathematicians and physicists aiming to develop novel algebraic and geometric structures by extracting exact information from physical theories. Active participation in this collaboration is expected.

Postdoctoral research associates will become members of the Quantum Universe Research School (QURS), which provides academic and key skills training, as well as career planning support. In addition, they will receive individual budgets to facilitate the attendance of summer schools and conferences, and to support other educational measures. Additional travel money for project-specific duties will be provided by the hosting research groups. Postdoctoral research associates may participate in the supervision of doctoral researchers, teaching at the University, and in the organization of the Cluster via an early career council.

**Your profile**
----------------

A university degree in a relevant field.

Research experience equivalent to a PhD.

Mathematical background in a research area relevant to the project.

Desirable relevant expertise and interests include: higher algebra, stable -categories, ( , n)-categories, extended topological quantum field theories, knot homology theories, categorified quantum groups/KLR algebras, and related topics in algebraic and symplectic geometry.

------------

* Reliable remuneration based on wage agreements

* Health management, EGYM Wellpass

jobs.title: 2 Research Associates / PostDocs (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
As part of the German government's artificial intelligence (AI) strategy, the successful Saxon competence center
  
ScaDS.AI Dresden/Leipzig (Center for Scalable Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence) is being expanded into a
  
leading German AI competence center for Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (AI). For TUD Dresden University of
  
Technology, diversity is an essential feature and a quality criterion of an excellent university. Accordingly, we
  
welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of
  
the whole institution.

At the **Center for Interdisciplinary Digital Sciences (CIDS),** the **Department for Scalable Data**  
**Analytics and Artificial Intelligence (ScaDS.AI Dresden)** offers,subject to the availability of resources,
  
two project positions funded by the BMFTR as

**Research Associate / PostDoc (m/f/x)**  
(subject to personal qualification, employees are remunerated according to salary group E 13 TV-L)

starting **as soon as possible**. The positions are fixed-term until March 31, 2029. The individual contract
  
duration will be determined according to the candidate’s qualifications and the intended academic
  
qualification goal. An extension may be possible subject to the availability of resources. The period of
  
employment is governed by § 2 (2) Fixed Term Research Contracts Act (Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz -
  
WissZeitVG). A shorter contract term is possible by arrangement.

Within the project Neuro-Symbolic AI with Logic-Memory Decomposition (Neuro-SAIL), a new class of
  
architectures for verifiable neuro-symbolic AI is being researched using Logic-Memory Decomposition.
  
Rule-based decisions are made by logic components, while memory modules are only used when
  
information is incomplete or ambiguous. If no reliable decision is possible, escalation to humans occurs.
  
The aim is to make rule-based decisions more transparent and efficient, to limit the use of neural models
  
to necessary cases, and to reduce rule violations and unsubstantiated statements.

**Professional assignment:** Chair of Scalable Software Architectures for Data Analytics (Prof. Dr. Michael
  
Färber)

**Research areas:** Natural Language Processing, Large Language Models, Knowledge Graphs, and related
  
fields (e.g., Graph Machine Learning)

**Tasks:**
  

* scientific research and development activities in at least one of the above-mentioned research

areas
  

* participation in national and international research projects, possibly in collaboration with

industry
  

* preparation of publications in internationally renowned journals and presentation of research

findings at conferences

**Requirements:**
  

* a university degree (M.Sc., M.Eng. or equivalent) and if applicable a PhD degree in Computer

Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Intelligent Systems,
  
Data Science, Computational Science, Mathematics, Applied Statistics, Information Science,
  
Information Systems, Information Systems Engineering, Electronic Information Engineering,
  
Computational Linguistics, Digital Humanities, Linguistics, or a related field

* a strong interest in fundamental research in the above-mentioned fields
* strong programming skills, preferably in Python, including experience with deep learning

frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, TensorFlow) and related tools
  

* good written and spoken English
* strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* high level of motivation and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team
* research experience (publications, theses, projects) in the above-mentioned research areas is a

major advantage

**We offer:** The position comes with access to high-performance computing resources and access to
  
training opportunities within ScaDS.AI.

TUD strives to employ more women in academia and research. We therefore expressly encourage
  
women to apply. The university is a family-friendly university. We welcome applications from candidates
  
with disabilities. If multiple candidates prove to be equally qualified, those with disabilities or with
  
equivalent status pursuant to the German Social Code IX (SGB IX) will receive priority for employment.

**Application:** Please submit your detailed application with the usual documents (e.g., cover letter, CV, and
  
other supporting documents), quoting the job reference **“ScaDS.AI Färber E 13”** by **November, 25, 2026**
  
(stamped arrival date of the university central mail service or the time stamp on the email server of TUD
  
applies), preferably via the TUD SecureMail Portal https://securemail.tu-dresden.de by sending it as a
  
single pdf file to **jobs-scads.ai@tu-dresden.de** or to:

**TU Dresden, ScaDS.AI, Prof. Dr. Michael Färber, Helmholtzstr. 10, 01069 Dresden, Germany.**

Please submit copies only, as your application will not be returned to you. Expenses incurred in attending
  
interviews cannot be reimbursed.

TUD is a founding partner in the DRESDEN-
  
concept alliance.

  

**Reference to data protection:** Your data protection rights, the purpose for which your data will be processed, as
  
well as further information about data protection is available to you on the website:
  
https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis.

jobs.title: Research Associate for the Project “A JWST/HST Census of faint, distant Quasars at Cosmic Dawn”
jobs.description:
**Institution**Faculty of Mathematics, Informatics and Natural Sciences, Department of Physics

**Salary level**EGR. 13 TV-L

**Start date**01.03.2027 or later, pending approval of external funding, fixed for a period of 2 years (with a possible extension of 1 year pending future external funding) (This is a fixed-term contract in accordance with Section 2 of the academic fixed-term labor contract act [Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz, WissZeitVG]).

**Application deadline**15.12.2026

**Scope of work**full-time position suitable for part-time

We invite applications for one position in extragalactic astrophysics at Hamburg Observatory (Universität Hamburg) within the DFG-funded Emmy Noether Research Group led by Dr. Jan-Torge Schindler. The group studies the formation of growing supermassive black holes (SMBHs) and their subsequent evolution in the early Universe. We aim to understand the processes by which SMBHs form, how they grow to their observed masses and how they influence the evolution of their host galaxies. Furthermore, we use actively growing SMBHs - quasars - as probes of the cosmic large-scale structure and the physical evolution of the intergalactic medium. In order to address these science questions, we utilize wide-area photometric surveys to discover new quasars at high redshift (using Euclid, LSST, data mining, machine learning, spectroscopy), conduct follow-up observations to characterise them (with optical, near-infrared, and sub-mm observations, spectroscopic modelling) and analyse their demographics (e.g., luminosity function, mass function using statistical inference).

We are looking for a candidate with a keen interest in the formation and growth of supermassive black holes in the first billion years of cosmic time. This project position focuses on the analysis of quasar discovery observations collected by the HST program SNAP 18112 (PI: Wolf) and the JWST survey program GO 11173 (PI: Schindler). More generally, the successful candidate is expected to lead efforts on high-redshift quasar/galaxy discovery and characterization within the Euclid Consortium’s Primeval Universe Science Working Group and its work package QSOs. Please do not hesitate to contact Jan-Torge Schindler for more information about the position.

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------

Duties include academic services in the project named above. Research associates may also pursue further academic qualifications outside of their work responsibilities.

The research associate will spend 100% of their time on academic research, including communicating results in major conferences and through journal publications. In addition to pursuing independent research and obtaining further qualifications, they also have the opportunity to mentor students at the Bachelor and Master level.

**Your profile**
----------------

A university degree in a relevant field, plus doctorate.

Applicants should hold a university degree with a doctorate in a relevant field (e.g., Physics, Astronomy/Astrophysics) at the time of starting. The position requires demonstrated research experience (in form of publications) in the area of extragalactic astrophysics, specifically on the topics of active galactic nuclei/quasars or high-redshift galaxies. Furthermore, applicants should have experience in the data reduction and analysis of spectroscopic observations. Additionally, the position requires excellent English proficiency, good communication and team skills.

Please do not hesitate to contact Jan-Torge Schindler via the below email address in case you have any questions about the position, the selection process, or the possible research projects. More information about the research group can be found at https://jtschindler.github.io/.

Frankfurt am Main, Germany | Full time | Home-based | R1576287

  

*IQVIA Biotech partners exclusively with biotech and emerging biopharma companies to support clinical development across all phases and therapeutic areas. agile structure, collaborative culture, and deep therapeutic expertise allow us to deliver tailored solutions that help bring innovative treatments to patients faster.*

This position forms part of the research program on food-grade, bio-based, and biodegradable aerogels and their application in sustainable food systems. The selected candidate will be employed by and will be required to enroll as a PhD student at Hamburg University of Technology, in accordance with the relevant admission and enrolment requirements. The scientific project will focus on the sub section

**DC2 – Doctoral Candidate: Aerogels from Non-Gelling Biopolymers**

The Doctoral Candidate will develop innovative food-grade aerogels from biopolymers that do not naturally form stable gels, including proteins and soluble fibres. The project will establish cryo-structuring as a route to create temporary solid networks without chemical crosslinkers, followed by cryo-solvent exchange and supercritical CO₂ drying. The candidate will systematically investigate how formulation, freezing conditions, solvent exchange and drying parameters determine pore morphology, density, mechanical properties, hydration behaviour and loading capacity. A major task will be the development and optimisation of reproducible processing protocols and the comprehensive characterisation of the resulting aerogels, including porosity, BET surface area, pore-size distribution, swelling and mechanical behaviour. The candidate will also assess compatibility with food matrices.

jobs.description:
**Lab Technician - Type 1 Diabetes (f/m/x)**
============================================

103046

Part time  
20 hrs./week

Munich

**At Helmholtz Munich, we develop groundbreaking solutions for a healthier society in a rapidly changing world. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation. Through strong partnerships, we accelerate the transfer of new ideas from the lab to real-life applications, improving lives.**

The research focus of the **Institute of Diabetes Research** lays on understanding the pathogenesis of type 1 diabetes, on identifying mechanisms and predictive markers of the disease, and the translation of findings into clinical trials to prevent type 1 diabetes in humans. The institute is particularly interested in deciphering the molecular mechanisms of islet autoreactivity, and the interaction of environment, genes, and the immune response. The ultimate goal is to develop therapies for the prevention and cure of islet autoimmunity and diabetes.

The within the Institute of Diabetes Research is seeking a **Research Technician (f/m/x)**. We are looking for a highly motivated individual to help us investigate the pathogenesis of type 1 diabetes in humans. You will have the opportunity to work with human tissue material provided by the Network for Pancreatic Organ Donors with Diabetes (nPOD). In addition, you will help us to manage the daily tasks in the lab and work with colleagues on their research projects. You will be part of an international and diverse team formed by PhD students, postdocs and bachelor/master students.

**Your tasks**
--------------

* Receipt, documentation and storage of samples in accordance with established procedures.
* Maintenance of accurate sample records and associated donor information in laboratory databases.
* Performance of established immunofluorescence staining procedures.
* Careful documentation, organization, and initial quality control of laboratory data and experimental results.
* Operation, cleaning, routine maintenance, and function checks of laboratory instruments and equipment.
* Organization of day-to-day laboratory operations, including monitoring stocks of consumables, reagents, antibodies, and other laboratory materials.
* Timely ordering of laboratory supplies.
* Follow-up and storage of orders (delivered reagents, consumables, and laboratory materials).
* Support in preparing and maintaining standard operating procedures.
* Practical instruction of students and new team members in established laboratory procedures.

----------------

* Successfully completed vocational training as a biological technical assistant (BTA), chemical technical assistant (CTA), medical technologist for laboratory analysis (MTL), medical technical laboratory assistant (MTLA), or a comparable laboratory qualification.
* Good organizational skills and willingness to take responsibility for laboratory inventories, routine orders, delivery checks, and associated documentation.
* Confident use of standard computer applications, particularly Microsoft Office.
* Ability to work independently within established workflows while collaborating closely with scientific and technical colleagues.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Desirable qualifications

* Experience in processing and documenting human donor samples or other biological specimens.
* Practical knowledge of established histological and pathology-related methods, particularly immunofluorescence.

If you fulfill all the requirements, you may be eligible for a salary grade of up to E 6. Social benefits are based on the Collective Wage Agreement for Public-Sector Employees (TVöD). The position has an (initial) fixed term of 6 months but may be extended under certain circumstances.

This has allowed us to discover novel pathological aspects, which have opened new lines of investigation that will shape our understanding of the natural history of type 1 diabetes."*

**Unser Profil**
----------------

The Joint Laboratory for Electron Microscopy (GFE) is a central facility at RWTH Aachen University and is active in the field of microstructure and surface analysis. In addition, it collaborates closely with research institutions, partners from large corporations, and small and medium-sized enterprises.

**Project Description:** In close collaboration with the Institute for Machine Elements and Systems Development (MSE), this project investigates the effect of combined wear and corrosion protection additives in lubricating oils on wear protection in rolling bearings. In addition to the purely protective effect, the focus is on developing a comprehensive understanding of the underlying tribocorrosion mechanisms. Additive interactions within the lubricant, as well as their surface competition, are identified through the analysis of the boundary layer structure and its durability. The evaluation of wear protection and corrosion tests is carried out using state-of-the-art methods, in particular electron microscopy techniques and modern surface analytics.

In addition, you are assisting in the development and acquisition of new research and industrial projects, supervise industrial contracts and participate in teaching and internships.

jobs.title: Student Research Assistant (m/f/div) for artificial muscle fabrication and testing
jobs.description:
High-performance artificial muscles provide new opportunities for the field of robotics.

The Robotic Materials Department at the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems, led by Prof. Christoph Keplinger, aims to fundamentally challenge current limitations of robotic hardware, using an interdisciplinary approach that synergizes concepts from soft matter physics and chemistry with advanced engineering technologies to devise robotic materials that enable the creation of intelligent machines that mimic the astonishing capabilities of organisms in nature.

One of our central goals is the development of new classes of actuators - a key component of all robotic systems - that replicate the sweeping success of biological muscle, a masterpiece of evolution featuring astonishing all-around actuation performance, the ability to self-heal after damage, and seamless integration with distributed sensing. Our fundamental research aims to realize practical applications for soft robotic systems that span from industrial automation, over medical and wearable robotics, all the way to new types of human-machine interfaces.

Department website:

Department videos:

We are looking for a

**Student Research Assistant (m/f/div) for artificial muscle fabrication and testing**
======================================================================================

**Roles & Responsibilities**
----------------------------

The student assistant position is paid hourly and will allow the student to gain hands-on experience with hardware systems, as well as to be exposed to ongoing robotics research. The position and tasks are subject to discussion with the interested candidates. Selected candidates can start working as soon as they are hired.

Possible tasks include:

**Unser Profil**
----------------

At the Chair and Institute of Highway Engineering (ISAC), RWTH Aachen University, we investigate pavement materials and structures through laboratory testing, computational mechanics and data analysis. Our research aims to understand material behaviour and support the design of durable road infrastructure.

The DFG-funded project FatigueID studies how fatigue damage develops in asphalt mixtures and how its variability can be used in reliability-oriented mixture design. It combines mechanical fatigue testing, digital image correlation (DIC), X-ray computed tomography (CT), mesoscale finite element modelling and probabilistic damage-state analysis.

We offer a doctoral research position with access to pavement testing facilities, computational resources and established collaborations for CT characterisation. You will receive supervision in experimental mechanics, multiscale modelling and probabilistic analysis, and have opportunities to develop your own research ideas within Fatigue.

**Ihr Profil**
--------------

Applicants must hold a university degree (master's or equivalent) in civil engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, computational engineering, applied mathematics or a related field.

A basic understanding of mechanics or material behaviour and some familiarity with programming, for example in Python or MATLAB, would be helpful. You should be interested in combining laboratory work with numerical modelling and data analysis.

An interest in one or more of the following areas is particularly welcome: asphalt or heterogeneous materials, fatigue and fracture mechanics, finite element analysis (e.g. Abaqus), DIC or CT image analysis, probability and statistics, uncertainty quantification, machine learning or optimisation. Previous experience is an advantage, but is not expected in all these areas. We particularly value motivation to learn and develop new skills.

You should bring curiosity, a responsible and proactive approach to work, and openness to feedback. You should be willing to work independently and contribute to an interdisciplinary team. Very good English skills are required. German language skills are desirable, and willingness to develop them is welcome.

**Ihre Aufgaben**
-----------------

You will carry out doctoral research on fatigue damage identification and modelling in asphalt mixtures. You will help design and conduct cyclic indirect tensile fatigue tests, evaluate stiffness degradation and cracking, and combine DIC and CT measurements to track damage development.

You will develop and assess mesoscale finite element models representing material heterogeneity and fracture, using constitutive models and cohesive zone approaches. Experimental measurements will be used to calibrate and validate the simulations.

Building on these results, you will investigate probabilistic damage-state transitions and fatigue-life variability. You will contribute to surrogate modelling and constrained optimisation to examine how mixture composition affects fatigue performance and reliability.

You will work closely with experimental and computational researchers, document reproducible workflows, publish your findings and present them at scientific conferences. The position offers the opportunity to pursue a doctoral degree at RWTH Aachen University.

**Unser Profil**
----------------

At the Institute of Crystallography at RWTH Aachen University, we investigate the structure and dynamics of nanoscale solid-liquid interfaces, which play a significant role in catalysis, energy, nanomaterials, and our environment. To gain novel insights, we use and develop modern X-ray and neutron scattering methods, both in the laboratory and at major research facilities worldwide. In our newly renovated, climate-controlled laboratories, we synthesize and characterize material systems relevant to real-world applications. A fundamental understanding of interfacial processes is essential for improving modern functional materials in practical applications.

  

**Project description**

In this project, our goal is to investigate the diffusion dynamics of water and organic molecules on the surfaces of magnetic iron oxide nanoparticles. These nanoparticles are used, for example, in catalysis and biomedicine. To measure the interesting dynamic processes of hydrogen-containing molecules as a function of humidity and temperature, we use quasi-elastic neutron scattering (QENS) at major international research facilities. The project is part of the Cluster of Excellence Fuel Science Center 2, where interdisciplinary research is conducted to optimize catalytic processes and develop novel fuels or platform chemicals.

The Chair for Digital Additive Production (DAP) at RWTH Aachen University collaborates with industrial and scientific partners to investigate the fundamental interrelationships of digital and additive manufacturing, transferring these findings to industrial applications. Our research encompasses a wide range of topics, from component design and process development to production and the application properties of additively manufactured components. Additionally, we focus on accompanying processes such as design, quality management, and the digital representation of the entire process chain. Our service portfolio is further enhanced by individual consulting and training services. Through industry projects, we work closely with partners from various sectors—including automotive, aerospace, turbomachinery, life sciences, machinery, tool making, and mold making—to develop and shape the future of digital and additive manufacturing. **Ihr Profil**
--------------

* You hold a university degree (Master's or equivalent) in mechanical engineering, materials science, materials engineering, or a related field.
* You have a solid background in materials science and a strong interest in experimental research.
* You are highly motivated to work scientifically with the goal of earning a PhD.
* You work independently and carefully, and you enjoy working in an interdisciplinary team.
* Very good English skills are required.
* Experience in one or more of the following areas is an advantage: materials characterization (e.g. metallography, electron microscopy), mechanical testing, laser-based or additive manufacturing processes, and data analysis (e.g. Python or MATLAB). **Ihre Aufgaben**
-----------------

You will work in an ERC-funded project that combines laser-based Directed Energy Deposition (DED) with laser heat treatment and deep rolling in one hybrid process. The goal is to develop novel methods that enable tailoring mechanical properties of metal components directly during manufacturing and repair.

For this, process development and materials research go hand in hand: you will develop novel process routes for nickel-based superalloys and investigate how the processing history changes the microstructure (SEM, EBSD, EDS, TEM). In close collaboration with the simulation team and international partners, you will establish how hybrid processing can deliberately shape metallic materials.

jobs.title: Chemical Lab Technician - Semiconductor (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Join us during the exciting build-up phase of one of Europe’s most advanced semiconductor manufacturing sites in Dresden. As a Chemical Laboratory Technician, you will ensure the highest purity standards across our manufacturing processes. Working with state-of-the-art analytical equipment, you will analyze chemicals, ultra-pure water, and cleanroom air impurities that directly safeguard our semiconductor yield. You bridge advanced trace analysis with active engineering support in a modern, 24/7 high-tech manufacturing environment.

Job Responsibilities

1. Routine & Trace Analysis: Perform testing on routine samples (process chemicals, ultra-pure water, and cleanroom air) following strict Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

2. Instrument Operations: Operate, maintain, and troubleshoot advanced analytical tools (e.g., ICP-MS, Ion Chromatography, GC-MS).

3. Data Collection & Reporting: Evaluate test results, compile accurate data, and generate analytical quality reports for internal engineering teams and external partners.

4. Engineering Support: Collaborate with engineers on experimental design, method optimization, and new process qualifications.

5. Tool Maintenance & Calibration: Perform routine calibrations, basic maintenance, and quality gating to ensure maximum laboratory tool uptime.

6. Safety & Compliance: Uphold the highest laboratory safety protocols and maintain a clean, organized, and compliant workspace.

7. Shift Collaboration: Ensure seamless 24/7 lab support by working within a rotating day/night shift schedule.

8. Training & Mentorship: Assist in onboarding and sharing best practices with new team members.

  

Job Qualifications

**Must Have**

1. Completed 3-year vocational training as a Chemical Laboratory Technician (Chemielaborant), Chemical Technical Assistant (CTA), Physical Technical Assistant (PTA), or a comparable technical qualification.

2. 0–3 years of professional experience in an analytical laboratory, manufacturing, or quality control environment (career starters are welcome).

3. Familiarity with standard PC operations and MS Office (Excel, Word).

4. Willingness to work in a rotating day/night shift model.

5. Readiness to complete an intensive ~6-month on-the-job training program in Taiwan during your onboarding to gain hands-on equipment expertise and build an international network.

6. Fluent English skills (written and spoken); German communication skills are an advantage.

  
  

**Nice to Have**

1. Hands-on experience with analytical instruments such as ICP-MS, IC, or GC-MS.

2. Prior experience in the semiconductor, pharmaceutical, chemical, or cleanroom-regulated industries.

3. Basic programming or data-automation skills.

Sandoz befindet sich weiterhin in einer aufregenden und transformierenden Phase als globaler Marktführer und wegweisender Anbieter nachhaltiger Biosimilars und Generika. Auf unserem neuen und ehrgeizigen Weg werden sich sowohl beruflich als auch persönlich einzigartige Chancen eröffnen. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams – die Zukunft liegt in unseren Händen!

* Durchführung und Auswertung von Analytik an Wirk-, Hilfstoffen, Packmaterial, Zwischenprodukten und Fertigprodukten (Transdermale Therapeutische Systeme) nach Arzneibuch oder validierten Methoden (HPLC / GC / UV- VIS, FTIR) unter Beachtung der aktuellen GMP-Standards
* Dokumentation und Kontrolle der Ergebnisse nach aktuellen internationalen GMP- Vorgaben und -Regelwerken mit Hilfe des Labordatenmanagement System (LIMS) sowie gängigen Softwareprogrammen, wie z. B. Word, Excel und PowerPoint
* Eigenständige Überprüfung von Methodenvalidierungen / Lifecycle analytischer Methoden
* Übernahme der Geräteverantwortlichkeiten, der selbstständigen Durchführung und Dokumentation entsprechender Gerätequalifizierungen
* Organisation der Analytik zur termingerechten Freigabe
* Unterstützung beim Probenzug von Wirk- und Hilfsstoffen

* Abgeschlossene naturwissenschaftliche Ausbildung (z. B. Chemielaborant (d/w/m), CTA (d/w/m) oder vergleichbar)
* Theoretische und praktische Kenntnisse im Bereich der instrumentellen Analytik (Schwerpunkt HPLC, GC, FTIR) in einem GMP-regulierten Umfeld sowie Erfahrung im Umgang mit Arzneibüchern (Ph. Eur., USP) wünschenswert
* Hohes Engagement sowie die Bereitschaft zu eigenverantwortlichem, selbstständigem Arbeiten in einem motivierten Team
* Leistungsorientiertes Arbeiten, analytische Fähigkeiten und Genauigkeit
* Neben sehr guten Kenntnissen der deutschen Sprache, gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
* Gute Kenntnisse in MS Office; LIMS Erfahrung von Vorteil

Die Vergütung bei Sandoz richtet sich nach Joblevel, Qualifikation, spezifischen Fachkenntnissen, Erfahrung sowie dem Standort innerhalb der unternehmensinternen Gehaltsbänder. Voll leistungsfähige und besonders effektive Mitarbeitende können ein Einstiegsgehalt im Bereich des Marktmedians erwarten. Mitarbeitende mit weniger Erfahrung oder geringerer funktionaler Tiefe liegen eher im unteren Bereich der Bandbreite, während solche mit dauerhaft überdurchschnittlicher Leistung oder speziellen Expertenkenntnissen im oberen Bereich angesiedelt sind. Interne Vergleichbarkeit und externe Marktdaten bestimmen die Einordnung. Jährliche Gehaltsüberprüfungen berücksichtigen Leistung, Marktanpassung und geschäftliche Anforderungen.

* Variable Vergütung: 5% leistungsabhängiger Bonus
* Weitere Benefits: 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr (in Vollzeit), 1.200€ Urlaubsgeld pro Jahr (in Vollzeit), betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Vermögenswirksame Leistungen (40€ / Monat; in Vollzeit), bis zu 50% mobiles Arbeiten, Zugang zur Weiterbildungsplattformen Skillsoft und Learnlight, Zugriff auf unser Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm OurShare
* Auszahlungsrhythmus: monatlich
* Erwartete wöchentliche Arbeitszeit: 40 Stunden
* Vertragsart: Vollzeit

Sandoz ist weltweit führend bei Biosimilars und Generika, einem Segment der Gesundheitsbranche, das 80% der weltweiten Arzneimittel zu lediglich 30% der Kosten bereitstellt und das Leben von mehr als 1 Milliarde Menschen in über 100 Ländern berührt!
  
Auch wenn wir stolz auf unsere bisherigen Leistungen sind, haben wir den Anspruch, noch mehr zu erreichen, damit jeder Mensch das grundlegende Menschenrecht auf gute Gesundheit verwirklichen kann.
  
Durch Investitionen in neue Entwicklungskapazitäten, Produktionsstandorte sowie neue Akquisitionen und Partnerschaften haben wir die Chance, die Zukunft von Sandoz aktiv zu gestalten und noch mehr Menschen nachhaltig Zugang zu kostengünstigen, qualitativ hochwertigen Arzneimitteln zu ermöglichen.
  
Unser Fortschritt wird von einer offenen, kollaborativen Unternehmenskultur getragen, die von unseren talentierten und ambitionierten Kolleginnen und Kollegen geprägt ist. Bei Sandoz erwartet Sie ein agiles, kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld mit vielfältigen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, in dem unterschiedliche Perspektiven geschätzt und individuelle Weiterentwicklung aktiv gefördert werden.
  
Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams! Gestalten Sie mit uns eine gerechtere und schnellere Gesundheitsversorgung!

Sandoz setzt sich für Vielfalt, Chancengleichheit und Inklusion ein. Wir sind bestrebt, vielfältige Teams zusammenzustellen, die für die Patient\*innen und Gemeinschaften, denen wir dienen, repräsentativ sind.

**BUILDING A WORLD CLASS TEAM STARTS WITH YOU**
-----------------------------------------------

At the heart of CSA Group is a vision: making the world a better, safer, more sustainable place. It's been part of our mission for nearly one hundred years: from the first engineering standard for railway bridges developed in 1919, to more than 3,500 standards, codes & related products today.

Headquartered in Canada, with a global footprint of more than 30 labs and offices across Europe, Asia and North America, CSA Group tests, inspects and certifies a wide range of products - from every day househould items to leading edge technology-to meet exacting requirements for safety, performance and environmental impact.

Our employees take pride in making a difference in people's lives through the work that we do. We're looking for people like you to help make it happen.

**Job Summary:**
----------------

This is an exciting opportunity to join our team at CSA Group. A Laboratory Engineer (m/f/d) is required to join our team to work on the testing of hazardous location (HazLoc) equipment. This role will be based in our new state of the art facility in Plattling, Germany.

**The Position:**

As part of this team, you will have the opportunity to test new and emerging products for safety before they hit the market. You will be involved in a world class organization dedicated to creating a better, safer, and more sustainable world.

**Responsibilities:**

* Assumes total responsibility for the completion of assigned tests within negotiated time schedules.
* Conducts a wide range of test procedures on sample equipment to the applicable standards and interprets results of the test. Works with Certifiers confirming which tests are required; the order in which to perform tests and the number of samples required. Performs tests and calculations, compiles data and summarizes test results into test reports. Verifies calculations are consistent with results of measurements. Determines whether product passes or fails subject to review by Certifier.
* Assembles and disassembles test samples, hooks-up laboratory test equipment in preparation for testing; operates most laboratory test equipment without supervision.
* Maintains good housekeeping of tools, equipment and work area following tests and carry out assigned laboratory clean-up duties.
* Responsible for follow-up for any non-conformances as a result of calibration, with guidance from supervisor.
* Responsible for the integrity of customer samples while in the laboratory as per company procedures.
* Interacts with jobholder / certifier to plan activities, exchange information, review and approve lab reports.
* May make field trips and assist in work outside the laboratories as required.
* Performs other duties as assigned by immediate supervisor.

**Education & Experience:**

* Technical Certificate or equivalent education and experience in electrical or mechanical technologies.
* Associates degree in Engineering Technology OR
* 3-5 years of related experience
* Use of various lab equipment, instruments and tools
* Practical knowledge of working with test and measurement instruments and equipment, such as: power supplies, multi meters, thermocouples and oscilloscopes, operation of machines such as drills, ovens and compressors.
* Must be able to read, interpret and develop engineering drawings and test data
* Must be able to understand and follow operating principles and calibration procedures, as well as general Laboratory procedures

**Skills:**

* Ability to manage difficult or unusual projects simultaneously and meet promised delivery dates
* Team-oriented with good interpersonal skills and abilities to communicate effectively both orally and in writing
* Must be self-motivated and client-service oriented
* Demonstrated systematic problem-solving ability
* Demonstrated ability to plan, organize, prioritize, follow-through and evaluate assigned functions and duties
* Demonstrated ability to work with some supervision. Good communication skills and ability to provide feedback to less experienced personnel when needed
* Strong organizational, time and project management skills to complete job tasks independently and in a time-efficient manner
* Technical report writing
* Computer proficiency (Word processing, Microsoft Word, Excel)
* Good knowledge of German and English (written and spoken)
* Demonstrated awareness of safety principles

**What we offer:**

* Innovative company with great growth potential and opportunities for employee participation.
* Internal networking with global experts.
* On-site presence is required. Partial home office is possible.
* Company pension plan
* Wellness program for a relaxed work-life balance
* Permanent direct employment and a future-proof job

* The data and information come from the companys own CRM systems, financial reporting systems and from external sites and information, and operational documents. Analysis, processing, and visualization of raw data using Excel, Power Query, Power BI, or Tableau.
* The sales analyst analyzes all the data collected with the help of mathematical and statistical methods and visualizes careful e.g. weekly, monthly or quarterly reports, e.g. with Excel, Power Query, Power BI, Alteryx, etc.
* She/he prepares management summaries and/or presentations in order to explain the results in a clear, meaningful way and, if necessary, derive recommendations for action or decision templates.
* In addition, she/he provides support in the coordination, control and accounting of the agreements made in the headquarters.
* Sales Analyst Reporting provides a solid basis for the evaluation and evaluation of sales measures as well as their success monitoring, taking into account budget planning and the companys internal PL.
* It also serves to provide the Sales team with data-based recommendations for increasing sales, mix and margins and to provide investment guidelines for the decision-making process in Sales. In doing so, he keeps an eye on different budget KPIs and supports the KAM team in their control and further development.
* Careful and reliable sales analyses and forecasts are the necessary basis for decision-making for more efficient customer management and can create an important competitive advantage.
* Part of the role is the advancement of the Antech data landscape and key performance indicator system
* Job holder is also responsible for training teams for independent use of data/dashboards, as well as development, updating and management of databases.

**Qualifications:**  

* Completed university degree IT, maths, engineering, ideally with 1-2 years of experience in sales, finance or similar analytical areas
* Strong conceptual and analytical thinking skills
* Initiative in the implementation of the sales strategy
* Very good communication and negotiation skills
* Solution-oriented, structured and independent way of working
* Very good knowledge of Microsoft Office
* Excellent analytical skills
* Fluency in Germand and English written and spoken
* Competence in the structure and development of complex reports and analyses as well as their comprehensible presentation to different stakeholders
* Knowledge of core systems: Salesforce, NetExam, Igloo, Magento, Web platform hostings, Alteryx, EZ Publish, Jotform, Wordpress and GetResponse. Knowledge of Excel and database manipulation.

About Antech
  
Antech is a leader in veterinary diagnostics, driven by our passion for innovation that delivers better animal health outcomes. Our products and services span 90 reference laboratories around the globe; in-house diagnostic laboratory instruments and consumables, including rapid assay diagnostic products and digital cytology services; local and cloud-based data services; practice information management software and related software and support; veterinary imaging and technology; veterinary professional education and training; and board-certified specialist support services.
  
  
Note to Search Firms/Agencies
  
Antech Diagnostics, Inc. and its subsidiaries and affiliates (Antech) do not compensate search firms for unsolicited assistance unless they have a written search agreement with Antech and the requisition is position-specific. Any resumes, curriculum vitae, and other unsolicited assistance from search firms that do not have a written search agreement or position-specific requisition submitted to any Associate of Antech will be deemed the sole property of Antech and no fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Antech.

**Research Associate (gn\*) AI, Computer Vision and Computational Neuropathology**
==================================================================================

12801

Startdatum der Ausschreibung: 04.11.26

**Fixed-term contract for 3 years | Full-time, 38.5 hours per week | Salary according to TV-L E13 | Institute of Neuropathology**

  

**We are UKM.** We have a clear social mission and, with our focus on healthcare, research, and teaching, we bear a unique responsibility.

  

To meet our high standards every day, we are looking forward to your expertise in AI and computer vision at the Institute of Neuropathology. We develop deep learning methods that improve the diagnostic yield of brain biopsies – **ideally with you on board!**

  

**RESEARCH PROJECT: DISEASE RECOGNITION FROM REACTIVE CNS TISSUE**

Brain biopsies may contain only reactive tissue adjacent to a lesion, preventing a definitive diagnosis by conventional histopathological assessment. Our project uses pathology foundation models and weakly supervised deep learning to recognise the underlying disease in such tissue from whole-slide images (preprint: arxiv.org/abs/2609.02390).

  

The project will be carried out in close collaboration with the Computer Vision and Machine Learning Systems group at the University of Münster (Prof. Dr. Benjamin Risse and Dr. Jan Ernsting), providing an interdisciplinary environment for developing and applying advanced AI methods to clinically relevant challenges.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Develop machine learning approaches for histological whole-slide image analysis, including weakly supervised classification using pathology foundation models and multiple instance learning (MIL)
* Build reproducible pipelines for image preprocessing, quality control and feature extraction
* Evaluate model robustness, bias and generalisation across centres, scanners and frozen sections, and apply interpretability methods
* Manage the digital pathology infrastructure of the institute (slide scanners, computing servers)
* Contribute to prospective observational evaluation, reproducible research software, scientific publications and conference presentations
  

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* A Master's degree or equivalent qualification in computer science, data science, mathematics, bioinformatics or a related discipline
* Strong theoretical foundations in machine learning and computer vision
* Practical experience with Python programming and deep learning frameworks
* Interest in rigorous statistical evaluation and reproducible scientific research
* An independent and structured working approach, strong communication and teamwork skills, and enthusiasm for interdisciplinary research
* Good written and spoken English skills
* Experience with large image datasets, computational pathology, foundation models, multiple instance learning or image registration is an advantage

Prior medical knowledge is not required.

  

**WE OFFER:**

* Salary according to TV-L E13, extra annual payment, and company pension plan (VBL)
* 30 days of vacation per year, plus two additional days off on Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve
* A wide range of training and professional development opportunities
* A respectful and appreciative work environment within a diverse team
* Support and advisory services for health and work-life balance
* Additional benefits such as sports programs, job ticket, jobrad, company events, cafeteria, and emergency childcare
  

**ADDITIONAL RESEARCH BENEFITS:**

* An opportunity to address a clinically relevant challenge at the intersection of AI, computer vision, neuropathology and molecular research, with the potential for meaningful clinical impact
* Close collaboration with internationally recognised research groups specialising in AI, neuropathology and molecular research, as well as an established network of partner neuropathology centres
* An interdisciplinary research environment with established analysis workflows and access to extensive histological image datasets
* Opportunities to develop innovative methodological approaches and shape your own research directions

jobs.description:
registration number:  
fb16-0017-wmz-2026

**Entry date:** as soon as possible

**Application deadline:** 2026-11-21

**Salary:** E 13 TV-H

**Duration:**  
3 years

**Volume of employment:** part-time (65%)

The University of Marburg, founded in 1527, offers a variety of excellent programs of study for around 22,000 students and confronts the important topics of our time through excellent research across a broad spectrum of sciences.

The Department of Pharmacy, research group on “Mitochondrial Gene Expression” led by Dr. Benedict Tan is currently accepting applications for

**Research Assistant (Doctoral Researcher/PhD)**
================================================

This position is offered for a period of 3 years, if no former times of qualification must be considered. The starting date is as soon as possible. The position is part-time (65% of regular working hours) with salary and benefits commensurate with a public service position in the state Hesse, Germany (TV-H E 13, 65%).

We seek a motivated and dedicated individual to conduct cutting-edge RNA research in an interdisciplinary and highly collaborative environment. This position is funded as part of the CRC/Transregio 440: “smART – specific mRNA targeting”, with the goal of developing new RNA-based technologies to control the function of disease-relevant eukaryotic mRNAs. In this project, we aim to establish the biological function of 7S RNA, a non-coding, mitochondrial DNA-encoded transcript. We will approach this primarily with biochemical methods involving purified recombinant proteins and RNA, and by developing precision small molecule ligands to modulate the function of 7S RNA in living cells.

**Tasks:**
----------

* Scientific services in research and teaching, with a focus on RNA-ligand interactions
* Identification and characterization of new 7S RNA-binding proteins
* Development of small molecule libraries and high-throughput screening platforms to characterize
* 7S RNA-targeting ligands using structural probing techniques (e.g., SHAPE-MaP)
* Expression and purification of recombinant mitochondrial proteins
* Preparation of mitochondrial extracts
* Synthesis and purification of DNA and RNA molecules for biochemical experiments

The position is limited to a time period deemed adequate for the completion of a doctoral degree. As part of the assigned duties, there will be ample opportunity to conduct the independent scientific research necessary for the completion of a doctorate. The limitation complies to Section 2(1) of the German Academic Fixed-Term Contract Act (WissZeitVG).

**Profile:**
------------

* MSc degree or equivalent in biochemistry, biolgy or a related field in the life and natural sciences
* Highly motivated individual who thrives in working as part of a team
* Practical experience in the field of biochemistry and/or molecular biology is required
* Critical thinking and an enthusiasm for scientific inquiry and experimental work
* Prior experience in nucleic acid biochemistry, mitochondrial RNA biology & transcription is an advantage
* Excellent English proficiency is required; knowledge of German is an advantage

Disposition to own scientific qualification i.e., a doctorate project in the area of RNA biochemistry is expected.

**We offer:**
-------------

* A strong research environment within an interdisciplinary team comprising over 20 research groups in the field of RNA biochemistry and RNA therapeutics
* Membership in the integrated graduate school of TRR 440, which offers workshops and seminars on RNA research, bioinformatics, career development, and science communication
* The “Landesticket” for free use of public transportation in Hesse

We actively support the professional development of junior researchers by the offers of the IRTG of the TRR 440, the Marburg Research Academy (MARA), the International Office and the Higher Education Didactics Office.

**Contact for more Information** **Dr. Benedict Tan**

ben.tan@uni-marburg.de

Application and interview costs can not be refunded.

* Motivation Letter (In English, 1 Page, Max. 500 words)
* Curriculum vitae (In English, max. 2 Pages)

jobs.title: Research Associate (Scientific Coordinator) for the planned Collaborative Research Centre/Transregio “Linked Lives” , salary level E 13 TV-L, 50% FTE)
jobs.description:
Creating knowledge. Making a difference. Shaping the future. This is what the University of Münster stands for as one of the strongest research-oriented universities in Germany and one of the largest employers in the region. Every day, over 7,000 employees devote themselves to cutting-edge research and excellent teaching. We share more than a workplace. We share the desire to make a real impact – regionally and internationally. Our day-to-day work is distinguished by diversity, openness and space to pursue one’s ideas. Become a part of our team – in academia, a technical or manual trade, or administration.  
  

The Department of Psychology at the University of Münster, Germany (working unit Psychological Assessment and Personality Psychology; head: Prof. Dr. Mitja Back) is seeking to fill two positions of a

**Research Associate (Scientific Coordinator) for the planned Collaborative Research Centre/Transregio “Linked Lives” , salary level E 13 TV-L, 50% FTE)**
==========================================================================================================================================================

starting on 1 March 2027. These are two fixed-term part-time positions (50%) until 29 February 2028. The appointment is subject to the approval of funding.

The position is part of the initiative for the Collaborative Research Centre/Transregio (CRC/TRR) “Linked Lives: Understanding Individuality in Social Interactions”, which the University of Münster (spokesperson: Prof. Dr. Mitja Back) is preparing together with Bielefeld University (deputy spokesperson: Prof. Dr. Barbara Caspers). Linked Lives asks why individuals differ in their social lives, for example in how cooperative, competitive or sociable they are, and what these differences mean for their relationships and their development. Its 33 project leaders from psychology, biology, philosophy of science and the data and computational sciences at six institutions study this in humans and about 15 animal species. We are currently preparing the full proposal and the DFG on-site review. The coordinator supports the spokespersons in this phase and helps prepare the start of the centre.

**Your tasks:**
---------------

* Coordinating the proposal process in close cooperation with the spokespersons: time and work planning, templates and shared standards for all projects, version management
* Contributing to the central parts of the proposal and editing the project descriptions, including the alignment of terms, methods and collaborations across projects and disciplines
* Supporting the scientific integration of the consortium, for example the joint data concept and comparable methods across species
* Designing and organising retreats, workshops and test reviews with external experts
* Preparing and organising the two-day DFG on-site review at the University of Münster, including presentations, posters and a full rehearsal
* Communicating with the DFG, the administrations of the Universities of Münster and Bielefeld and the project leaders at all sites; budget planning
* Preparing the start of the centre: job advertisements and selection procedures, information and documentation structures, website

**Our expectations:**
---------------------

* A university degree (Master's degree, Diplom or equivalent) in psychology, biology or a related field and a completed doctorate or one close to completion
* Experience in empirical research and a strong interest in interdisciplinary questions, ideally at the interface of psychology and biology
* Experience with research proposals; experience with collaborative research projects (such as Collaborative Research Centres, Research Units or Research Training Groups) or in research management is an advantage
* A strong service orientation and enjoyment in supporting the researchers involved in preparing and coordinating the proposal process in a solution-oriented, reliable and forward-looking way
* Excellent organisational and communication skills and a structured, independent way of working, also under tight deadlines
* Very good written and spoken English; good German is an advantage
* Confident use of common tools for writing, project management and digital collaboration

**Advantages for you:**
-----------------------

* A responsible role in a large interdisciplinary consortium at its decisive stage
* Close collaboration with the spokespersons and 33 project leaders from four disciplines at six institutions
* Comprehensive insight into how a Collaborative Research Centre is acquired and set up, including work with the DFG and the university leadership
* Room for your own ideas on organisation, communication and quality assurance
* The prospect of taking on the coordination of the centre in the longer term if the CRC/TRR is funded
* Integration into a cooperative research environment, including the BackLab, the Center for Social Skills, the Münster Center for Open Science and the Joint Institute for Individualisation in a Changing Environment
* The benefits of public-sector employment, including flexible working-time models, continuing education, a company pension scheme (VBL) and an annual special payment

Linked Lives and the BackLab value transparent and reproducible research. The researchers involved have committed to shared quality standards, including open data, open code, open materials and preregistration.

The University of Münster strongly supports equal opportunity and diversity. We welcome all applicants regardless of sex, nationality, ethnic or social background, religion or worldview, disability, age, sexual orientation or gender identity. We are committed to creating family-friendly working conditions. Part-time options are generally available.

jobs.title: Research Scientist (m/f/d) in Archaeo- and Palaeogenomics (Tenure Track)
jobs.description:
**Senckenberg – Leibniz Institution for Biodiversity and Earth System Research (SGN)** headquartered in Frankfurt am Main is seeking to fill the following position at the **Senckenberg Centre for Human Evolution and Palaeoenvironment (SHEP) in Tübingen** as soon as possible

**Research Scientist (m/f/d) in Archaeo- and Palaeogenomics (Tenure Track)**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------

### **(full time / part time)**

**Location: Tübingen**

**Employment scope:** full-time / part-time options available

**Type of contract:** The position is initially offered on a fixed-term basis. The type and duration of the contract will depend on the successful candidate’s individual qualifications and profile, as well as the applicable legal framework, and may not exceed six years. Subject to a positive evaluation, the position is intended to lead to a permanent appointment under the Senckenberg tenure track scheme.

**Remuneration:** collective agreement of the German Länder, TV-L E 13

﻿

The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level. The Senckenberg Centre for Human Evolution and Palaeoenvironment (SHEP) is based in Tübingen, Baden-Württemberg.

Since 2009, our scientists in Tübingen have been conducting research on the biological and cultural evolution of humans in their environments in close cooperation with the Eberhard-Karls-University of Tübingen.

**Your Responsibilities**

* Developing, planning and conducting archaeogenetic and palaeogenetic research projects within the framework of the SHEP research programme in Tübingen
* Analysing ancient human DNA, particularly from Eurasia, and reconstructing the evolutionary and population history of ancient human populations
* Investigating population structures, kinship patterns and forms of social organisation through the integration of genomic, archaeological and historical data
* Scientifically coordinating the generation of new genomic data in collaboration with project partners, and contributing to the development and enhancement of bioinformatic analysis pipelines
* Publishing research findings in international peer-reviewed journals, developing research proposals and contributing to third-party funding acquisition
* Establishing and maintaining national and international research collaborations, and working closely with research groups at SHEP and the University of Tübingen
* Providing academic and professional supervision to staff, as well as supervising doctoral researchers and students
* Undertaking organisational responsibilities and coordinating collaborative research activities within the research group

**Your Profile**

* A completed PhD in Archaeogenetics, Evolutionary Biology, Molecular Anthropology, Population Genetics or a related natural science discipline
* Strong expertise in the analysis and interpretation of genomic data, particularly ancient DNA, combined with excellent bioinformatic skills
* Proven experience in integrating genomic data with archaeological, anthropological and historical evidence
* Knowledge of approaches to reconstructing population structures, kinship relationships and forms of social organisation in past communities
* Experience in developing and applying genomic or bioinformatic methods; experience in developing computational pipelines would be an advantage
* A strong academic publication record, including publications in internationally recognised peer-reviewed journals
* Experience in planning, conducting or coordinating scientific research projects, together with the ability to independently develop research proposals and secure third-party funding
* Experience in supervising students and early-career researchers
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, together with a strong interest in interdisciplinary research
* Excellent written and spoken English, and a willingness to learn German

**Desirable skills**

* Research expertise in the genomics of early humans, particularly archaic hominins such as Neanderthals.
* In-depth knowledge of the demography, population structure and evolutionary history of prehistoric human populations, particularly European hunter-gatherers.
* Established national and international research collaborations in archaeogenetics and palaeogenomics.

**We offer**

* access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations
* an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution
* flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension plan

Senckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of age, gender, ethnic or cultural origin, religion and ideology, sexual orientation and identity or disability. Women are particularly encouraged to apply, as they are underrepresented in the field of this position; in the case of equal qualifications and suitability they will be given preference.
