jobs.title: Research Scientist – Foundation Models and Multimodal AI
jobs.description:
**About us**
============

Owkin is an agentic AI company pioneering Biological Artificial Superintelligence to solve problems in biology where human researchers alone have failed.  
Owkin builds K Pro - an AI scientist for pharmaceutical research and strategic decision-making. K Pro orchestrates a suite of AI skills and tools to decode complex biology, accelerate research, and dramatically increase productivity.  
K Pro is built on Owkin’s unrivalled multimodal patient data network, state-of-the-art AI for biology and a decade of experience working with pharmaceutical partners.

***Position is based in our Paris office or remotely in France, UK, Germany.***

***Please submit your CV in English***

**About the role:**
===================

We are seeking a driven **Research Scientist** with hands-on expertise in Foundation Models (FMs) and Multimodal AI to help drive the next phase of our machine learning platform.

In this role, you will bridge cutting-edge AI research and practical application. Rather than training massive base models from scratch, your focus will be on fine-tuning, adapting, and aligning open-weights foundation models across diverse data modalities (e.g. structured tabular data, single-cell scRNA-seq, image representations, and natural language) to build multimodal systems.

**In particular, you will be responsible for:**
===============================================

* **Model adaptation and optimization:** Adapt, fine-tune, and evaluate state-of-the-art open-source foundation models (e.g., domain-specific transformers, vision-language models) using fine-tuning and transfer learning strategies.
* **Multimodal integration:** Design and implement cross-modal alignment architectures (e.g., contrastive learning, projection heads, unified embedding spaces) to fuse structured, sequential, and text/image data layers.
* **Pipeline and evaluation engineering:** Build rigorous, domain-tailored benchmarking frameworks and evaluation pipelines to validate model reliability, generalization, and downstream task performance.
* **Applied R&D collaboration:** Work closely with cross-functional teams (data engineers, domain specialists, and software engineers) to integrate adapted models into scalable production and inference workflows.
* **Low-hanging fruit innovation:** Identify high-impact, incremental improvements in data pre-processing, embedding representation, and fine-tuning to maximize model performance without unnecessary computational overhead.

**About you**
=============

Required qualifications / experience:

* **Education:** Ph.D. or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics or a related quantitative field.
* **Experience:** 2-4 years of post-degree experience applying deep learning and foundation models to complex datasets.
* **Foundation models:** Demonstrated experience adapting and fine-tuning foundation models.
* **Multimodal learning:** Proven experience with cross-modal representation learning, joint embedding alignment (e.g., CLIP-style architectures), or vision-language models.
* **Technical stack:**

  + Advanced proficiency in Python and modern deep learning frameworks (**PyTorch**, Hugging Face ecosystem).
  + Hands-on experience with fine-tuning techniques.
  + Familiarity with data engineering tools for handling large-scale or multi-modal datasets (Parquet, AnnData, HDF5).

Preferred qualifications/bonus:

* Experience working with biological or omics data (e.g., scRNA-seq, spatial transcriptomics, clinical and/or histology data).
* Experience deploying or scaling models using containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP).
* Track record of open-source contributions or peer-reviewed publications at top ML conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR) or domain-specific journals.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

The Transparency International Secretariat (TI-S) is seeking a Research Coordinator / Data Analyst to support the implementation of the Building Regional Integrity and Democratic Governance in the Western Balkans and Türkiye (BRIDGe-WBT) project, a regional action aimed at strengthening political integrity, the rule of law and democratic governance in Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Kosovo, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Serbia, and Türkiye.

The objective of the action is to strengthen the fight against corruption in the Western Balkans and Türkiye. It aims to contribute to credible progress in the EU enlargement process by strengthening political integrity and judicial independence in the Western Balkans and Türkiye. It does so by monitoring reforms, identifying weaknesses, and providing evidence-based recommendations.

It brings together national civil society expertise and regional coordination to generate reliable evidence on corruption risks, political integrity and judicial independence and accountability reforms.

Building on existing Transparency International tools and methodologies, including Integrity Watch platforms and the regional National Integrity System (NIS) recommendation tracker, the research coordinator will generate reliable policy relevant evidence to support the project objectives. This includes strengthening the data and indicators available through Integrity Watch, quality control and support to tracking the implementation of priority NIS recommendations, and analysing gaps between formal regulations, and institutional practice through systematic, transparent and comparable monitoring.

More specifically, the researcher will contribute to maintaining and upgrading five existing Integrity Watch platforms and launching two new platforms in Albania and Montenegro, using datasets to develop corruption-risk indicators and red flags. The researcher will support the compilation of country analyses and produce at least two regional comparative analytical products on agreed themes such as political finance and electoral integrity, procurement integrity, and judicial independence, integrity and accountability. The researcher will also support TI chapters and partners in applying SMART criteria to the tracked NIS recommendations, including setting a baseline, clear milestones and evidence requirements for assessing their implementation. The researcher will quality assure each tracker update, which monitors progress on priority reforms across the target countries. The researcher will use the findings to develop evidence-based recommendations for policy makers and support the dissemination of findings and policy recommendations in relevant fora as required.

The Research coordinator will work closely with TI national chapters and partner organisations in the region as well as the Projects, Policy & Advocacy, Global Movement, and Communications teams to ensure that research outputs are rigorous, accessible to wide audiences, comparable across countries, and policy relevant for advocacy.

The role requires a highly motivated researcher with expertise in anti-corruption, rule of law, political integrity as well as data management and analysis to (1) conduct and coordinate research activities on political integrity and judicial independence; (2) provide technical advice (3) overseeing the implantation of digital tools for political integrity and democratic governance and (4) support the development of policy recommendations and the dissemination of findings in relevant fora to meet the objectives of the project.

The position is currently estimated to start in January 2027 for 27 months.

**OVERVIEW OF KEY DIMENSIONS**

**Role Purpose:** to conduct and coordinate research and data activities on political integrity, judicial independence and democratic governance in the Western Balkans and Türkiye, including quality assuring the tracking of progress on anti-corruption reforms and their implementation.

**Team:** Research and Knowledge.

**Reporting Line:** Head of Research and Knowledge.

**Starting Date:** 1January 2027, or as soon as possible there after subject to funding.

**Contract Duration:** Currently we can offer an employment contract limited to a duration of 27 months.

**Working Hours:** full time [100%; 40 hours per week]

**Location:** Transparency International Secretariat (TI-S), Berlin - with some international travel.

**MAIN ACCOUNTABILITIES OF THE ROLE**

Based in the Research and Knowledge Team, and in close collaboration with the Projects, Policy and Advocacy, Global Movement and Communications teams and national chapters and partner organisations, the Research Coordinator will:

* Produce original materials on political corruption and democratic governance in the region by coordinating cross-country research on political integrity, corruption risks, judicial independence and the rule of law.
* Provide methodological and technical support to national chapters and partner organisations, including data processing and analysis and through peer learning exchanges to produce high-quality, consistent and comparable monitoring data.

After spending a lot of time in factories environments, we saw the pain it was to make sure products were safe. Traditional quality control has heavy constraints and long waiting times. To change that, we decided to build Spore.Bio, a new generation of microbiological testing.

Our team is dedicated to bringing technology and developing a cutting-edge solution, based on advanced optical and deep-learning technologies, to detect bacterial contamination within seconds.

Spore Bio is seeking a talented and passionate **R&D Microbiology Lab Technician** to contribute to the development of our cutting-edge biophotonics and data science solutions.

### **About the role**

* **Bacterial culture preparation and execution:** Prepare and conduct bacterial culture techniques on Petri dishes, ensuring adherence to established protocols.
* **Protocol development, data acquisition, and analysis:** Assist in developing and improving culture protocols, collect experimental data, and conduct preliminary analyses to optimize results.
* **Sample management and traceability:** Handle and manage samples with precision, ensuring complete traceability and proper documentation.
* **Laboratory operations and maintenance:** Involvement in managing laboratory tasks, including supply orders, equipment maintenance, and adherence to safety and quality standards.
* **Cross-functional collaboration:** Work closely with hardware and machine learning teams to develop a robust microbiology and food data library.

### **Your Profile**

We value curiosity, initiative, and a growth mindset, not every box needs to be ticked to apply.

* **Educational background :** BAC+2 / +3 in biology / microbiology / biotechnology / quality control.
* **Experience :** minimum 1 year of proven experience as a laboratory technician, ideally with a focus on microbiology. Familiarity with the food industry is a plus.
* **Microbiological culture knowledge:** Understanding of bacterial culture methods and techniques relevant to industrial applications.
* **Data management skills:** Proficiency in data management tools (especially Excel) and experience with laboratory notebook systems for accurate record-keeping.
* **Research and development interest:** Motivated by research and development activities, particularly in developing new lab methods.
* **Excellent communication skills:** Comfortable interacting with different teams and levels of the organization, as well as external stakeholders. English proficiency (B2 level or above) is an asset for effective cross-team collaboration.
* **Personal attributes:** Energetic, proactive, with high attention to detail and an ability to work autonomously.

We don’t expect you to know everything from day one. What matters most is your **curiosity**, **drive to learn**, and **willingness to dive into challenges**.

### **Why joining us?**

* Work in an innovative and rapidly growing startup.
* Participate in exciting and impactful projects.
* Evolve in a collaborative and stimulating work environment.
* Opportunities for professional development and continuous training.

### **What we offer**

We believe that flexibility and trust are important parts of a company. Our work environment reflects this thanks to:

Flexible remote: If you live in Paris, you can work from our office or from your place with no constraints.

On top of that, we offer many perks such as:

* A budget for remote work equipment
* A Gymlib subscription for you to stay in shape wherever you are
* Premium health insurance (Alan in France)
* A Swile card for your meals, if you are based in France
* Frequent team events and in-person gatherings every month!

### **Recruitment process**

* **Screening Interview (~30 min):** A casual call to get to know each other, explore your experience, understand what drives you, and align on expectations. It's also your chance to ask anything about Spore Bio and the role.

* **Culture-Fit Discussion:** A dedicated chat with a Spore Bio collaborator to ensure our values, vision, and team dynamics match what you're looking for.
* **On-site Interview & Lab Visit:** A comprehensive immersion day at our Paris headquarters. You will visit the optics lab and assembly area, see our systems in action, and meet the founders. This final step is as much for you to audit us as it is for us to choose you!
* **Reference calls** A quick chat with one or two people you've worked with before.

You might also be invited to meet other team members at the office for a lab visit and a coffee!

This is a unique opportunity for someone who thrives on curiosity and has a genuine passion for technology. If you enjoy taking on challenges and solving complex problems, this role will provide the perfect environment for growth and impact. The ideal candidate is someone who is self-driven, eager to learn, and excited to contribute to shaping the future of microbiology monitoring. Join our innovative and dynamic team, and let's make a difference together! We look forward to meeting you!

jobs.description:
**Job Description**

Under the supervision of the Head of NMR, you will join a multidisciplinary Structural Biology and Biophysics team supporting pharmaceutical and biotechnology clients in their drug discovery programs.

Working closely with experts in Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR), Native Mass Spectrometry, HDX-MS, Cryo-EM and X-ray Crystallography, you will contribute to the characterization of biomolecular interactions and the structural investigation of proteins and protein-ligand complexes.

You will be expected to:

* Design, perform and interpret advanced biomolecular NMR experiments for protein and protein-ligand characterization.
* Conduct ligand-observed and protein-observed NMR assays to support hit identification, hit validation and fragment-based drug discovery projects.
* Perform multidimensional NMR analyses to characterize binding events, chemical shift perturbations and structural changes induced by ligand binding.
* Independently perform resonance assignments using state-of-the-art methodologies and computational tools.
* Analyze and interpret NMR datasets to provide structural and mechanistic insights supporting client projects.
* Contribute to the development, validation and implementation of new NMR methodologies and applications.
* Prepare protocols, SOPs and technical documentation.
* Present results to internal teams and clients through written and oral reports.
* Participate in troubleshooting activities and continuous improvement of NMR workflows and instrumentation.

**Profile**

jobs.title: Laboratory technician
jobs.description:
**About Orakl Oncology**
========================

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine **cutting-edge biology** and **AI** to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our **AI-powered predictive engine**, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to **bring more effective treatments to patients** who need them - and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a **fast-growing, mission-driven startup** at the intersection of science and technology.

The company is growing fast, and we are now seeking the best talents to come and join our exciting and ambitious team in the fight against cancer - join us!

**Position overview**
=====================

Orakl Oncology works on a large cohort of patient-derived organoids (PDO) to predict clinical outcomes of patients and derisk clinical trials. We are looking for a dynamic and motivated Lab Technician to help us execute large-scale drug screening assays on our semi-automated platform, either for internal or external projects. In this position, you will:

* **Actively participate in our commercial contracts:** you will take care of numerous PDOs of interest and perform drug screening assays to generate high-quality, robust datasets. These results will be leveraged by our data science and computational biology teams to deliver actionable insights and decision-support data to our partners.
* **Work on the expansion of the Orakl biobank:** you will work on patient specimens and organoid cell lines to increase the amount of data collected, thus improving our understanding of cancer.
* **Contribute to the optimisation procedures at Orakl:** you will bring new ideas and approaches to improve automation and accelerate workflows in both 3D cell culture and drug screening experiments.
* **Ensure smooth laboratory operations:** you will play a key role in laboratory maintenance, documentation, and traceability of activities, while proactively anticipating the needs for consumables and reagents.

**Required qualifications**
===========================

* BSc (or equivalent degree such as BTS, BUT, Licence) in cellular biology, biotechnology or any related discipline.
* Hands-on experience in mammalian cell culture, 3D cell culture and preferably organoid culture.
* Hands-on experience in drug screening assays or viability assessment assay.
* Exceptional attention to detail and organisational rigour.
* Flexibility, and a taste for overcoming operational challenges.
* A genuine enthusiasm and passion for teamwork and learning.
* As part of an international team, ability to communicate clearly in English
* Genuine curiosity for cancer biology.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills to interact in an interdisciplinary setting with biologists, ML engineers and researchers.
* Previous experience working in cancer biology
* Fluent in English

**Recruitment process**
=======================

* **HR Call (15 minutes call)** – An initial discussion to better understand your background, experiences, and motivations.
* **Technical Interview (45 minutes call)** – A deep dive into your technical skills and expertise relevant to the role.
* **Lab Case (Around 90 minutes) -** You will be directly manipulating in our labs to demonstrate your ability to follow a specific protocol and to work under aseptic conditions.
* **Founder Interview:** As final step of our recruitment process, you will meet the CTO of Orakl Oncology in person at our office. This meeting is an opportunity for the founders to assess cultural fit and ensure alignment with our company values.

**More about Orakl** **here** **and** **here**
----------------------------------------------

jobs.title: Research Scientist – Foundation Models and Multimodal AI
jobs.description:
**About us**
============

Owkin is an agentic AI company pioneering Biological Artificial Superintelligence to solve problems in biology where human researchers alone have failed.  
Owkin builds K Pro - an AI scientist for pharmaceutical research and strategic decision-making. K Pro orchestrates a suite of AI skills and tools to decode complex biology, accelerate research, and dramatically increase productivity.  
K Pro is built on Owkin’s unrivalled multimodal patient data network, state-of-the-art AI for biology and a decade of experience working with pharmaceutical partners.

***Position is based in our Paris office or remotely in France, UK, Germany.***

***Please submit your CV in English***

**About the role:**
===================

We are seeking a driven **Research Scientist** with hands-on expertise in Foundation Models (FMs) and Multimodal AI to help drive the next phase of our machine learning platform.

In this role, you will bridge cutting-edge AI research and practical application. Rather than training massive base models from scratch, your focus will be on fine-tuning, adapting, and aligning open-weights foundation models across diverse data modalities (e.g. structured tabular data, single-cell scRNA-seq, image representations, and natural language) to build multimodal systems.

**In particular, you will be responsible for:**
===============================================

* **Model adaptation and optimization:** Adapt, fine-tune, and evaluate state-of-the-art open-source foundation models (e.g., domain-specific transformers, vision-language models) using fine-tuning and transfer learning strategies.
* **Multimodal integration:** Design and implement cross-modal alignment architectures (e.g., contrastive learning, projection heads, unified embedding spaces) to fuse structured, sequential, and text/image data layers.
* **Pipeline and evaluation engineering:** Build rigorous, domain-tailored benchmarking frameworks and evaluation pipelines to validate model reliability, generalization, and downstream task performance.
* **Applied R&D collaboration:** Work closely with cross-functional teams (data engineers, domain specialists, and software engineers) to integrate adapted models into scalable production and inference workflows.
* **Low-hanging fruit innovation:** Identify high-impact, incremental improvements in data pre-processing, embedding representation, and fine-tuning to maximize model performance without unnecessary computational overhead.

**About you**
=============

Required qualifications / experience:

* **Education:** Ph.D. or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics or a related quantitative field.
* **Experience:** 2-4 years of post-degree experience applying deep learning and foundation models to complex datasets.
* **Foundation models:** Demonstrated experience adapting and fine-tuning foundation models.
* **Multimodal learning:** Proven experience with cross-modal representation learning, joint embedding alignment (e.g., CLIP-style architectures), or vision-language models.
* **Technical stack:**

  + Advanced proficiency in Python and modern deep learning frameworks (**PyTorch**, Hugging Face ecosystem).
  + Hands-on experience with fine-tuning techniques.
  + Familiarity with data engineering tools for handling large-scale or multi-modal datasets (Parquet, AnnData, HDF5).

Preferred qualifications/bonus:

* Experience working with biological or omics data (e.g., scRNA-seq, spatial transcriptomics, clinical and/or histology data).
* Experience deploying or scaling models using containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP).
* Track record of open-source contributions or peer-reviewed publications at top ML conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR) or domain-specific journals.

#LI-HB1

**What we offer**
=================

* Flexible work organization
* Friendly and informal working environment
* Opportunity to work with an international team with high technical and scientific backgrounds

**Recruitment Process & Security**
==================================

* Please complete the form and submit your CV.
* Owkin is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, gender, sexual orientation, age, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status or on the basis of disability.
* Owkin is a great place to work. As a coveted workplace we are, unfortunately, vulnerable to recruitment phishing scams. We urge all job seekers and candidates to be wary of potential scams. Most of these have individuals posing as representatives of prominent companies, including Owkin, with the aim of obtaining personal, sensitive, or financial information from applicants. These scams prey upon an individual’s desire to obtain a job and can sometimes “feel” like a genuine recruitment process. Some red flags are identified below. Should you encounter a recruitment process that claims to be for Owkin but is not consistent with the below, please do not provide any personal or financial information:
* Legitimate Owkin recruitment processes include communication with candidates through recognized professional networks, such as LinkedIn.
* Communication is always through an official Owkin email address (from the @owkin.com domain), over the phone or through our applicant tracking system (Ashby).
* The Owkin talent team do use platforms such as LinkedIn, however if you have any concern or doubt about this contact, please ask for them to send an email from @Owkin.com.
* The Owkin talent team will not solicit personal data from candidates during the application phase including, but not limited to, date of birth, social security numbers, or bank account information;
* Legitimate Owkin interviews may be conducted over the phone, in person, or via an approved enterprise videoconferencing service (Google Meets). **They will not occur via Signal, Teleg

jobs.title: Bioinformatic Ingenieer in immunology

The AI2B laboratory, led by M. Mahévas and P. Chappert, studies B-cell immune responses in both physiological and pathological settings. As part of the ERC-funded project DIPP-IMMUNE, we are looking for a bioinformatician to join the team. Working closely with the lab’s postdoctoral researchers and PhD students, they will take ownership of the existing analysis pipelines, maintain and extend them to support upcoming developments and integrate new methods from the scientific literature tailored to the needs of individual project leaders.

Researchers benefit from access to state-of-the-art core facilities, including imaging, genomics, histology, flow cytometry, bioinformatics and proteomics platforms.

Master’s degree (or equivalent) in bioinformatics, computer science or applied mathematics. Proven experience in bioinformatics applied to genomic or transcriptomic data, ideally at the single-cell level. Excellent programming skills in R; working knowledge of Python and good knowledge of analysis pipelines for genomic data, BCR repertoires (IgBLAST, IMGT, Immcantation), scRNA-seq (Seurat) and spatial transcriptomic. Strong organizational skills and ability to present scientific results clearly and concisely. Genuine interest in biological questions and ability to work closely with biologists. Team player, good listener and proactive, with the ability to work independently.

**Stage BAC+5 - Data Science & Bioinformatics (Contrôle Qualité des Données Génomiques) - F/H/D**
=================================================================================================

Localisation: Marcy l'Etoile, France
  
Type de Contrat: Stage
  
Fonction: Bioscience R&D

  

Acteur mondial dans le domaine du diagnostic *in vitro* depuis plus de 60 ans, bioMérieux offre des solutions de diagnostic qui déterminent l’origine d’une maladie ou d’une contamination pour améliorer la santé des patients et assurer la sécurité des consommateurs.
  
Rejoindre bioMérieux, c’est choisir une société familiale et humaniste, portée par une vision long terme, au service de la santé publique dans le monde.
  
Chaque stagiaire ou alternant est accompagné par un tuteur expérimenté et formé. Il ou elle bénéficie d’un suivi et d’une évaluation l’aidant à progresser et à se préparer à la vie professionnelle.

  

Le/La stagiaire rejoindra le département Data Science et contribuera à l'amélioration d'un pipeline d'analyse de données de séquençage métagénomique. Le contrôle qualité (Quality Control - QC) des données joue un rôle clé dans le développement des algorithmes de Machine Learning ainsi que dans la validation des résultats générés.

Ce stage offre une opportunité unique de travailler à l'intersection de la bioinformatique, de la génomique et de l'intelligence artificielle, au sein d'une entreprise leader du diagnostic in vitro.

Le/La stagiaire collaborera avec les équipes Data Science basées en France et aux États-Unis afin d'optimiser les stratégies de contrôle qualité appliquées aux données de séquençage génomique complet (Whole Genome Sequencing - WGS) et de contribuer à l'amélioration des processus d'analyse et de restitution des résultats.

  

**Merci de soumettre impérativement votre CV et votre lettre de motivation en anglais.**

  

**Quelle est votre mission chez bioMérieux ?**
----------------------------------------------

Sous la supervision d'un Data Scientist, le/la stagiaire devra :

* Organiser et structurer de larges jeux de données WGS pour les analyses bioinformatiques et le suivi des indicateurs de qualité.
* Développer du code reproductible et partageable permettant l'analyse de données génomiques.
* Collaborer avec les membres de l'équipe Data Science France-US sur les développements techniques et méthodologiques.
* Synthétiser et communiquer les résultats à des publics non techniques.
* Définir des critères de contrôle qualité destinés à la sélection des jeux de données d'entraînement pour les algorithmes de Machine Learning.
* Définir des critères de contrôle qualité permettant de vérifier et valider les résultats générés par les modèles de Machine Learning.

  

**Qui êtes-vous ?**

* Maîtrise de Python, Bash et des outils de gestion de versions tels que GitHub.
* Connaissance des approches de Machine Learning et des bonnes pratiques de reproductibilité des analyses de données.
* Excellentes capacités d'analyse, esprit critique et aptitude à résoudre des problématiques complexes à partir des données.
* Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale en anglais, avec la capacité à évoluer dans un environnement international et collaboratif.

jobs.title: Quality Control Analyst I
jobs.description:
**We Are Teva**
---------------

We’re Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world-class generics business. Whether it’s innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology or delivering high-quality medicine worldwide, we’re dedicated to addressing patients’ needs now and in the future. Here, you will be part of a high-performing, inclusive culture that values fresh thinking and collaboration. You'll have the room to grow, the flexibility to balance life with work, and the opportunity to better health worldwide, together.

**Be Part of an Important Chapter in Our Haarlem Site's Future**
----------------------------------------------------------------

As part of a recent business decision, our Haarlem manufacturing site is expected to remain operational until approximately the end of 2029. The exact timeline will depend on the successful transfer of products and activities to other locations.

While the site is entering its final years of operation, this period will be one of significant activity, complexity, and importance. Our teams will continue to manufacture high-quality medicines for patients around the world while supporting one of the largest transformation initiatives in the site's history.

We are looking for colleagues who are motivated by challenge, collaboration, and the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution during this unique phase of our journey. Working at Haarlem over the coming years will provide valuable experience in business transformation, operational excellence, knowledge transfer, and change management. These are experiences that few professionals have the opportunity to gain during their careers.

This position is offered on a **permanent employment contract**. Should the role become redundant as a result of the site closure, employees will be eligible for the provisions of the applicable **Social Plan**, subject to its terms and conditions.

If you are looking for an opportunity to make a lasting impact while continuing to deliver for patients, we encourage you to apply.

**Our Team, Your Impact**
-------------------------

Are you passionate about microbiology, contamination control, and quality within a GMP-regulated environment? We are looking for an Environmental Monitoring (EM) Specialist to support and continuously improve our Environmental Monitoring program and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.

In this role, you will play a key part in maintaining the qualified state of cleanroom environments and supporting contamination control strategies across manufacturing operations. You will be responsible for monitoring, evaluating, and trending environmental data, investigating microbiological events, and ensuring compliance with GMP requirements. Working closely with Quality Assurance, Manufacturing, Engineering, and external partners, you will help safeguard product quality and patient safety.

**How You’ll Spend Your Day**
-----------------------------

* Evaluate routine Environmental Monitoring activities, including:
* + Air monitoring
  + Surface monitoring
  + Personnel monitoring
  + Utility monitoring
* Trend environmental monitoring data to identify risks, adverse trends, and opportunities for improvement.
* Execute QMS records (Lab investigations, Deviations and CAPAs).
* Contribute to contamination control strategies and microbiological risk assessments.
* Prepare, review, and update SOPs, protocols, reports, and technical documentation related to environmental monitoring and contamination control.
* Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Environmental Monitoring and contamination control during audits, inspections, and regulatory interactions.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives related to contamination control and microbiological monitoring.

**Your Skills and Experience**
------------------------------

* Bachelor's in Microbiology, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, or a related discipline.
* Knowledge of GMP requirements and microbiological quality control.
* Familiarity with Environmental Monitoring programs and cleanroom operations.
* Understanding of contamination control principles and microbiological testing techniques.
* Knowledge of EU GMP Annex 1.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

**How We’ll Take Care of You**
------------------------------

At Teva, better health starts from within, and that includes you. From day one, you’ll be supported with benefits designed to help you thrive in and out of work. This includes generous annual leave, reward plans, flexible working schedules (dependent on role), access to tailored health support, and meaningful ways to give back to the community. When it comes to your career, you’ll be encouraged to explore, evolve, and shape your path. Twist, our one-stop shop for career development platform, gives you access to a wide range of possibilities, from learning programs and short-term projects to opportunities for internal growth. Here, you’ll be part of a culture that empowers you to reach your goals and prioritize your wellbeing every step of the way.

**Already Working @Teva?**
--------------------------

Make sure to apply through our internal career site on Twist—your one-stop shop for career development

**Teva’s Equal Employment Opportunity Commitment**
--------------------------------------------------

Teva Pharmaceuticals is committed to equal opportunity in employment. It is Teva's global policy that equal employment opportunity be provided without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, disability, pregnancy, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, ancestry, veteran status, national or ethnic origin or any other legally recognized status entitled to protection under applicable laws. jobs.title: Unflappable Laboratory Technician
jobs.description:
Vacature ID: 17010

Functie categorie: Niet-wetenschappelijke functies

Aanstellingsomvang in uren min: 38

Aanstellingsomvang in uren max: 38

Standplaats: Leiden

Solliciteren kan tot en met: 30-11-2026

  

**The isolation and identification of valuable compounds are at the heart of natural products research. The analyst position focuses on the isolation and identification of chemical compounds, primarily from natural products. This is a highly specialized position requiring expertise in analytical chemistry, phytochemistry, and instrumental analysis, particularly chromatographic techniques.**

**In this position, you will play a key role in supporting scientists by isolating and characterizing natural compounds for use in a wide range of research projects. If you are passionate about natural products and interested in working with state-of-the-art separation and analytical techniques, including MPLC, HPLC, NMR, GC-MS, LC-MS, and HPTLC, we encourage you to apply for this position.**

**Job Description**
-------------------

* **Perform the extraction, isolation, purification, and characterization of natural products from various biological sources.**
* **Operate and maintain preparative chromatography systems, including MPLC and HPLC or sometimes open chromatography.**
* **Develop and optimize extraction, fractionation, and purification methods to obtain natural compounds with the purity and quantities required for research.**
* **Assess the purity and identity of isolated compounds using appropriate analytical techniques.**
* **Support researchers and students (BSc, MSc, and PhD) in the separation, isolation, and purification of natural products for their research projects.**
* **Ensure a safe, well-organized, and efficient laboratory working environment in accordance with institutional safety guidelines and procedures.**

**Research at our Faculty**
---------------------------

**The Faculty of Science is a world-class faculty where staff and students work together in a dynamic international environment. It is a faculty where personal and academic development are top priorities. Our people are committed to expand fundamental knowledge by curiosity and to look beyond the borders of their own discipline; their aim is to benefit science, and to make a contribution to addressing the major societal challenges of the future.**

**The research carried out at the Faculty of Science is very diverse, ranging from mathematics, information science, astronomy, physics, chemistry and bio-pharmaceutical sciences to biology and environmental sciences. The research activities are organised in eight institutes. These institutes offer eight bachelor’s and twelve master’s programmes. The faculty has grown strongly in recent years and now has more than 2300 {see** **https://www.universiteitleiden.nl/wiskunde-en-natuurwetenschappen** **} staff and almost 5000 {see** **https://www.universiteitleiden.nl/wiskunde-en-natuurwetenschappen** **} students. We are located at the heart of Leiden’s Bio Science Park, one of Europe’s biggest science parks, where university and business life come together.**

**For more information, see** **www.universiteitleiden.nl/en/science** **and** **http://workingat.leiden.edu/**

**The Institute for Biology**

**The research within the Institute of Biology Leiden (IBL) aims to work on the science base of biodiversity and health, which is reflected in our leading principle** ***Harnessing Biodiversity for Health*** **. We perform innovative curiosity-driven research to answer fundamental questions, and solutions-driven research to help solving major societal challenges. The latter include protecting nature’s biodiversity, creating sustainable biotechnology and agriculture and increasing good health. Our research focuses on four Research Themes: Bioactive Molecules, Host-Microbe Interactions, Development & Disease and Evolution & Biodiversity. Located in a thriving scientific environment with our Faculty of Sciences, Naturalis Biodiversity Centre, the Leiden University Medical Centre and the Leiden Bioscience Park, IBL offers an exciting, internationally oriented and inclusive place to work and study.**

**Your profile**
----------------

* **A relevant laboratory qualification at MBO level 3 or higher (or equivalent), preferably combined with at least five years of practical experience in a similar laboratory environment.**
* **Hands-on experience with chromatographic separation techniques, particularly preparative MPLC and HPLC.**
* **Knowledge of natural product chemistry and experience in the extraction, isolation, and purification of natural compounds.**
* **Experience in structural elucidation using NMR and MS data is considered an advantage.**
* **Ability to work independently, with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.**
* **Good command of English; working knowledge of Dutch is an advantage.**
* **A well-organized and safety-conscious approach to laboratory work.**
* **A flexible, service-oriented attitude, with the ability to respond effectively to changing priorities and research needs.**
* **Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to laboratory challenges.**
* **A strong sense of responsibility and enthusiasm for collaborating with researchers and students.**

**terms and conditions**
------------------------

**We offer a temporary employment contract for a period of 1 year with the possibility extending for the full project period upon satisfactory performance. Appointment will be made in accordance with the Collective Labour Agreement for Dutch Universities, based on the UFO profile of education/research assistant. The salary, depending on education and experience, is at least €3,202 and up to €4,159 gross per month for a full-time position (scale 7).**

**In addition, Leiden University offers good employment conditions. These include an end-of-year bonus (8.3%), holiday allowance (8%), excellent training facilities, paid parental leave,

jobs.description:
#### **About GenScript**

Founded in 2002 in New Jersey, GenScript Biotech Corporation accelerates innovation in biotech and healthcare by providing researchers and companies with the building blocks needed to develop groundbreaking treatments and products. Guided by its mission to Make People and Nature Healthier Through Biotechnology, and its role as a well-recognized biotechnology company, GenScript has a team of approximately 6,165 employees and has served more than 200,000 customers across over 100 countries and regions.

GenScript's Europe division, headquartered in Rijswijk, Netherlands, with a branch office in Oxford, UK, was established in 2019 to serve as a hub for commercial, technical support, and logistics in the European and UK regions. As part of our ongoing commitment to enhancing service for our EU clients, we are excited to announce the opening of our first brand new production facility in Delft, Netherlands. We are currently seeking a QC Technician to join our RNA service team. This position will be focusing on performing verities of experiment following protocol and guidance of manager for ensuring the quality of product under production and research in RNA team.

**Job Title:** QC Technician

**Location:** Biotech Campus Delft, South Holland, Netherlands

**Working Arrangement:** On-site

**Time:** Full‑time (40 hours / week) Mon-Fri 9:00-17:30.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Responsible for supporting communication with production manager and team, support a working environment that encourages employee involvement and collaboration.
* Operate QC assays as needed.
* Report out-of-specification results and deviations to the manager. Assists with investigations, root cause analysis, and reports for out-of-specification results and deviations.
* Responsible for timely completion of QC report after production job is finished. Accountable for the QC report compliance with good documentation practices.
* Design plasmids to insert customer ORF's into vectors used for IVT
* Order Gene Synthesis, Subcloning, Plasmid Preps, and Linearization strategically from manufacturing facilities.
* Support process improvement initiatives within in scope of responsibility.
* Monitor supply inventory and identify any products required.
* Maintain work area, equipment, department and all storage areas in a clean, neat and orderly manner.
* Perform other duties as needed.

jobs.title: 1. PhD Position in Fungal Cell Biology
jobs.description:
**Your function**
-----------------

We are looking for a motivated PhD candidate to join the **Nuclear Swarms** project, funded by an NWO Vidi grant and led by Dr Vasilis Kokkoris at Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam.

Arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi form partnerships with plants and play important roles in nutrient uptake and ecosystem functioning. Yet, despite their ecological importance, we know remarkably little about how their cells are organised. Their extensive networks of fungal filaments contain a continuous cytoplasm shared by thousands of nuclei. How these nuclei move, divide and respond to their surroundings—and whether they behave independently or collectively—remains largely unknown.

In Nuclear Swarms, we will investigate nuclear organisation and behaviour across these fungal networks. We want to understand how individual nuclei contribute to the functioning of the cell and how their collective behaviour may change as the fungus grows and encounters different conditions.

As a PhD candidate, you will combine live-cell imaging with experimental and molecular approaches to investigate nuclear dynamics in arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi. You will develop experiments to track nuclei over time, examine their distribution and division, and test how their behaviour responds to changes in the cellular environment. Together with other team members and our collaborators, you will use quantitative analyses to identify patterns in nuclear behaviour and explore whether these are consistent with coordinated or independent responses.

This project offers an opportunity to investigate fundamental questions in cell biology using an ecologically important, non-model fungal system. You will join an interdisciplinary team working at the interface of fungal biology, microscopy, molecular biology and quantitative research.

**Your duties**

* design and conduct experiments to investigate nuclear organisation and behaviour in arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi
* cultivate and maintain fungal material using appropriate experimental systems
* use fluorescence and live-cell microscopy to visualise nuclei and their dynamics in fungal networks
* track and quantify nuclear movement, distribution and division under different experimental conditions
* apply and develop molecular and cell-biological methods to investigate nuclear properties and activity
* analyse microscopy and experimental data using appropriate quantitative and statistical approaches
* work with colleagues and collaborators to integrate experimental observations with quantitative or computational approaches
* contribute to reproducible research practices and the sharing of data and methods
* present your findings at national and international scientific meetings
* write scientific publications and a PhD thesis
* contribute to teaching and supervision of students where appropriate

**Your profile**
----------------

You are curious about how cells work and motivated to explore biological questions in a system that challenges conventional ideas about cellular organisation. You enjoy experimental work, think critically about your results and are enthusiastic about learning new techniques.

* an MSc degree, or equivalent, in microbiology, molecular biology or a related field, with a strong interest in microscopy and data analysis
* **experience with in vitro culturing of fungi (required)**
* experience with microscopy techniques and/or genetic transformation techniques. Experience with confocal microscopy is preferred
* knowledge of image analysis and programming using software such as R/RStudio, Python or MATLAB
* a strong interest in fungal biology, cell biology or the organisation and behaviour of nuclei
* experience with experimental laboratory research and a willingness to work with a challenging non-model organism
* good analytical and problem-solving skills
* the ability to work independently and collaboratively within an interdisciplinary team
* a good command of spoken and written English

Experience with one or more of the following would be an **advantage**:

* experience in bioinformatics
* image processing and quantitative analysis of microscopy data
* molecular biology techniques, such as DNA or RNA analysis, PCR or fluorescence in situ hybridisation
* cell biology methods for studying DNA replication, cell division or intracellular dynamics

As a university, we strive for equal opportunities for all, recognising that diversity takes many forms. We believe that diversity in all its complexity is invaluable for the quality of our teaching, research and service. We are always looking for talent with diverse backgrounds and experiences. This also means that we are committed to creating an inclusive community so that we can use diversity as an asset.

We realise that each individual brings a unique set of skills, expertise and mindset. Therefore we are happy to invite anyone who recognises themselves in the profile to apply, even if you do not meet all the requirements.

**What do we offer?**
---------------------

A challenging position in a socially engaged organisation. At VU Amsterdam, you contribute to education, research and service for a better world. And that is valuable. So in return for your efforts, we offer you:

* a salary of € 3.204,00 (PhD) and maximum € 4.051,00 (PhD) gross per month in the fourth year, for a full-time employment
* an employment contract of initially 1 year. If there is sufficient perspective, this will be extended to a total of 4 years. Your dissertation at the end of the fourth year forms the end of your employment contract.

We also offer you attractive fringe benefits and arrangements. Some examples:

* A full-time 38-hour working week comes with a holiday leave entitlement of 232 hours per year. If you choose to work 40 hours, you have 96 extra holiday leave hours on an annual basis. For part-timers, this is calculated pro rata.
* 8% holiday allowance and 8.3% end-of-year bonus
* contribution to commuting ex

Laura van Niftrik

Bij Olenex hanteren we een oplossingsgerichte aanpak. We werken nauw samen met onze klanten om hun processen, uitdagingen en doelstellingen te begrijpen. **Wij zoeken een zelfstandige**

**voor onze raffinaderij op de Vondelingenplaat in Rotterdam****.**

jobs.title: Laboratory Technician
jobs.description:
**Lab Technician – Barendrecht**

**Jij test de brandstof. Rederijen wereldwijd gebruiken jouw resultaten.**

In ons lab in Barendrecht krijg je scheepsbrandstof op je werkbank. Je bereidt de monsters voor, voert tests uit en legt de resultaten vast. Daarmee help je rederijen om de kwaliteit van hun brandstof te beoordelen en die veilig te gebruiken.

Ken je nog niet al onze testmethoden? Geen punt. Tijdens je interne opleiding leer je ermee werken, samen met ervaren collega’s.

**Wie zijn wij?**

VPS voert tests en inspecties uit voor de wereldwijde maritieme sector en is marktleider op dit specialistische terrein. We hebben laboratoria in Nederland, Singapore, Houston, Shanghai, Fujairah en het Verenigd Koninkrijk. Onze commerciële teams en technisch adviseurs ondersteunen klanten over de hele wereld. Ons hoofdkantoor en ons belangrijkste laboratorium zijn gevestigd in Barendrecht. Engels is de voertaal binnen VPS.

**Wat ga je doen?**

Je volgt een monster van binnenkomst tot testresultaat. Je pakt scheepsbrandstofmonsters uit, registreert ze en bereidt ze voor op analyse. Je voert onder meer XRF- en GC-MS-analyses, viscositeitsmetingen, Karl Fischer-bepalingen en destillaties uit. Daarna leg je de resultaten nauwkeurig vast in het laboratoriuminformatiesysteem (LIMS) en rapporteer je ze.

Samen met je collega’s zorg je dat monsters zorgvuldig en op tijd worden verwerkt en dat het lab schoon, opgeruimd en klaar voor gebruik is. Je werkt volgens de VPS Code of Practice, de veiligheidsvoorschriften en onze kwaliteitsprocedures op basis van ISO/IEC 17025.

**Past dit werk bij jou?**

Je hoeft niet vanaf dag één al onze analysemethoden te kennen. We zoeken iemand die graag leert, rustig en nauwkeurig werkt en makkelijk afstemt met collega’s.

Je hebt een afgeronde mbo-opleiding op niveau 3, bij voorkeur in chemie of een verwante richting, en minimaal één jaar relevante ervaring als laborant. Relevante ervaring uit een stage of vergelijkbaar praktijkwerk is ook welkom. Je beheerst het Nederlands en Engels goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

Je bent bereid om in ploegendienst te werken, van 08.00 tot 16.00 uur of van 14.00 tot 22.00 uur. Bij voorkeur woon je in de omgeving van Rotterdam of Barendrecht.

**Dit kun je van ons verwachten**

Je komt terecht in een ervaren labteam binnen een groeiend, internationaal bedrijf. Tijdens je interne opleiding leer je hoe we scheepsbrandstoffen testen en raak je vertrouwd met onze apparatuur, werkwijze en analysemethoden. Daarna krijg je de ruimte om je verder te ontwikkelen als laborant.

Ook buiten je werk wil je tijd overhouden. Bij VPS werk je 37,5 uur per week: 7,5 werkuren per dag. Je krijgt een marktconform salaris en minimaal 29 vakantiedagen. VPS betaalt je pensioenbijdrage en vergoedt tot € 100 per maand van je zorgverzekeringspremie. Op het werk staat vers fruit voor je klaar.

Voor avonddiensten krijg je 25% toeslag, voor weekenddiensten 50% en voor diensten op zondagen en officiële feestdagen 100%. Als je in ploegendienst werkt, krijg je ook een vergoeding voor je avondmaaltijd.

**Interesse?**

Lijkt het je leuk om als laborant bij VPS in Barendrecht aan de slag te gaan? Stuur je cv en motivatie naar onze HR-afdeling via **recruitment.europe@v-p-s.com.** We maken graag kennis met je!

Soort dienstverband: Fulltime

Werklocatie: Fysiek

**Job title** – Associate Scientist, Analytical Sciences (Spectroscopic Analysis & Characterization)

**Location** – Delft, The Netherlands

Join our science & research team as Associate Scientist working side by side with other technicians and scientists in our high-end Analytical Sciences laboratories. The Spectroscopic Analysis & Characterization team develops and implements (high throughput) NMR based methods to analyze metabolites, lipids, proteins and carbohydrates in complex microbial and food matrices, whereby providing crucial molecular insights to our innovation projects. The team is part of the Analytical Sciences department where other high-end analytical technologies like biochemistry, LC, GC and MS are also applied, and where sample preparation, data handling and development of a state-of-the-art laboratory infrastructure are fundamental for our daily work.

**Your key responsibilities**

* Design, develop and optimize fit-for-purpose NMR spectroscopy based analytical methods, including sample preparation, to provide key insights for R&D projects.
* Plan and execute NMR experiments, including sample preparation, instrument operation, data processing, and method performance assessment.
* Document analytical work and results accurately and work safely and compliantly, following laboratory procedures, quality standards, and applicable SOPs.
* Interpret complex analytical data, troubleshoot analytical challenges, and provide scientifically sound recommendations.
* Communicate key results and findings clearly to project partners by writing reports and giving presentations.
* Collaborate with team members and provide guidance for laboratory work.

**We offer**

* Exposure to cutting-edge Nuclear Magnetic Resonance equipment and analysis methods and the opportunity to make an impact through our innovation projects.

**You bring**

* Master, bachelor or HBO degree in Analytical Sciences, or related sciences, with demonstrable knowledge on NMR spectroscopy and >3 yrs of industrial experience.
* Passion for laboratory work, analyzing complex (food, biotech) matrices, and analytical data interpretation.
* A team-player mindset and eagerness to collaborate in multidisciplinary innovation projects.
* Affinity in using software packages, such as Bruker Topspin and MestreNova NMR, for spectral analyses, programming languages for data automation and lab automation tools (e.g. liquid handling platforms) for sample preparation is an asset.
* A high degree of ownership and independence in lab work and reporting of data.
* A drive to learn, grow, and develop.
* Excellent communication skills, both oral and written, and comfortable in expressing yourself in English.

At dsm-firmenich, we don’t just meet expectations – we go beyond them. Join our global team powered by science, creativity, and a shared purpose: to bring progress to life.

Because real progress only happens when we go beyond, together.

At dsm-firmenich, we believe being a force for good starts with the way we treat each other. When people feel supported, included, and free to be themselves, they do their best work – and that’s exactly the kind of culture we’re building. Ben jij accuraat en kwaliteitsgericht en vind je het een interessante uitdaging om problemen op te lossen? Ben jij een teamspeler die graag initiatief neemt en daarmee een voorbeeld is voor anderen? Ben jij in staat om in een complexe omgeving overzicht te houden? Wil jij werken in een professionele organisatie waarbij er veel ruimte is om jezelf te ontwikkelen?
  
  
**Voor onze locatie Boxmeer zijn wij op zoek naar een:**  
Lab support Technician Quality Control – Microbiologisch
  
  
Welkom in ons team
  
Quality Control Operations (QCO) is een dynamisch team dat alle Integrated Process Teams (IPT’s) ondersteunt bij het tijdig uitvoeren van kwaliteitscontroletesten. QCO is verantwoordelijk voor alle fysische, chemische, biologische en microbiologische analyses van vaccins en farmaceutische eindproducten, antigenen, grondstoffen, API’s en primaire verpakkingsmaterialen binnen de locatie Boxmeer.
  
  
Over de functie
  
DeLab Support Specialist Microbiologie QC vervult een belangrijke rol binnen het microbiologische laboratorium en zorgt ervoor dat de dagelijkse werkzaamheden efficiënt, veilig en conform GMP-richtlijnen worden uitgevoerd. In deze ondersteunende en coördinerende functie draag je bij aan een optimale planning, de beschikbaarheid van materialen en een effectieve afhandeling van afwijkingen en verbetermogelijkheden.Je bent een belangrijke schakel binnen het team en ondersteunt microbiologische analisten, zodat analyses tijdig en volgens planning kunnen worden uitgevoerd. Daarnaast werk je actief aan het verbeteren van processen, systemen en werkwijzen binnen het laboratorium. Wij streven continu naar verdere optimalisatie van onze processen en zetten daarbij actief Lean/Six Sigma-methodieken in, zoals Tier Meetings, Kaizens en Root Cause Analyses. Daarom zijn wij op zoek naar een proactieve en gestructureerde professional die eigenaarschap toont, openstaat voor verandering en denkt in oplossingen.
  
  
Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

* Monitoren van KPI’s, trends en procesprestaties en het signaleren van verbetermogelijkheden.

Jouw profiel

jobs.title: Quality Control Technician II
jobs.description:
**We Are Teva**
---------------

We’re Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world-class generics business. Whether it’s innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology or delivering high-quality medicine worldwide, we’re dedicated to addressing patients’ needs now and in the future. Here, you will be part of a high-performing, inclusive culture that values fresh thinking and collaboration. You'll have the room to grow, the flexibility to balance life with work, and the opportunity to better health worldwide, together.

**Our Team, Your Impact**
-------------------------

As a Quality Control Technician, you will perform routine and non-routine microbiological analyses, inspections, and testing on presented samples. You will also support the implementation of laboratory projects to ensure that quality standards and established timelines are met. Working in a GMP-regulated environment, you will contribute to the quality, safety, and compliance of pharmaceutical products while supporting continuous improvement and operational excellence.

**Duration**
------------

This position is available for up to 3 years.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Independently perform routine and non-routine microbiological analyses according to established procedures.
* Conduct bioburden, endotoxin, sterility, and microorganism testing using approved microbiological methods.
* Perform microbial identification using Gram staining and/or MALDI-TOF.
* Carry out release testing of growth media and work within safety cabinets and isolators.
* Record and report test results in LIMS.
* Manage laboratory media and consumable inventory.
* Clean and maintain laboratory equipment and the working environment.
* Prepare standard reports, including analysis and maintenance reports, under supervision.
* Ensure compliance with GMP, safety, environmental, and hygiene regulations.
* Identify and report deviations, and support investigations and change control activities.
* Contribute to process improvements, standardization of test methods, and documentation updates (SOPs and work instructions).
* Participate in equipment and method validations, qualifications, internal audits, and audit preparation activities.
* Support the training and development of co-workers

**Your Skills and Experience**
------------------------------

* MLO Level 4 or higher with a specialization in Microbiology, or an equivalent scientific qualification.
* Experience working in a GMP and/or GLP-regulated environment.
* Experience using LIMS or other digital laboratory systems.
* Knowledge of microbiological analysis techniques and quality standards.
* Understanding of aseptic practices and laboratory safety principles.
* Good written communication skills in Dutch and English.
* Willingness to wear a full-face mask when required.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Proactive and responsible approach to work.
* Excellent organizational and documentation skills.
* Strong teamwork and communication abilities.
* Commitment to quality, safety, and continuous improvement.

**How We’ll Take Care of You**

At Teva, better health starts from within, and that includes you. From day one, you’ll be supported with benefits designed to help you thrive in and out of work. This includes generous annual leave, reward plans, flexible working schedules (dependent on role), access to tailored health support, and meaningful ways to give back to the community. When it comes to your career, you’ll be encouraged to explore, evolve, and shape your path. Twist, our one-stop shop for career development platform, gives you access to a wide range of possibilities, from learning programs and short-term projects to opportunities for internal growth. Here, you’ll be part of a culture that empowers you to reach your goals and prioritize your wellbeing every step of the way.

--------------------------

Make sure to apply through our internal career site on Twist—your one-stop shop for career development

Teva Pharmaceuticals is committed to equal opportunity in employment. It is Teva's global policy that equal employment opportunity be provided without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, disability, pregnancy, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, ancestry, veteran status, national or ethnic origin or any other legally recognized status entitled to protection under applicable laws. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace for all. jobs.title: Research Technician - Seal Testing
jobs.description:
SKF is a global leader in products and services for rotating equipment. Within SKF Sealing Solutions, the Global Research & Innovation department generates the fundamental knowledge and technologies that enable next-generation sealing systems.

**About the team**

Based at SKF’s research centre in Houten, the Netherlands, our team develops advanced characterisation, simulation and testing capabilities that support product development, drive digital transformation and contribute to more sustainable sealing solutions. To strengthen our team, we are looking for a:

**Research Technician – Seal Testing**

**The role**

You will be part of our seal testing team, working alongside experienced research engineers and laboratory specialists and contributing to research and development projects for a wide range of sealing systems.

This is a varied, hands-on role in which you will prepare and perform tests, analyse results and help improve our products but also laboratory equipment and methods.

**Your responsibilities**

* Prepare seal samples and perform preliminary analyses before testing.
* Conduct established tests to evaluate seal performance, including friction, wear, contamination ingress, leakage and service life.
* Analyse, document and present test results.
* Contribute to the design and development of new test components, systems and methods.
* Take ownership of designated laboratory equipment and ensure it is used in compliance with health and safety requirements.
* Perform routine maintenance and calibrate laboratory equipment.
* Maintain stock levels of laboratory supplies.
* Improve laboratory equipment, methods and working practices.

**What we are looking for**

* MBO+ level technical education or a bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or a related discipline.
* Two to five years of hands-on experience in mechanical testing and experimental verification, preferably involving rotating equipment such as bearings or seals.
* Experience with CAD software such as PTC Creo is a plus.
* Knowledge of electrical or electronic circuits and/or mechatronics is an advantage.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft 365.
* A proactive and practical approach.
* A quality-focused mindset and a drive for continuous improvement.
* Very good spoken and written English.
* Eagerness to learn and develop.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

**What we offer**

You will join a modern international R&D environment within a globally recognized engineering company. This role offers a unique opportunity to combine hands-on laboratory work with participation in the development of next-generation sealing technologies.

You will work with advanced testing equipment, collaborate with experienced researchers and engineers, and contribute to projects that support customers and industries worldwide. Through close interaction with teams across SKF, you will gain exposure to international research and product development activities.

We are committed to your professional growth and offer opportunities to learn, develop new skills and expand your technical expertise, supported by a competitive compensation and benefits package.

SKF is committed to diversity and inclusion. We value your skills, experience and potential. Come as you are and be yourself. **#weareSKF**

**Interested?**

If you are passionate about technology, innovation and hands-on testing, we would love to hear from you. Join us in shaping the future of sealing solutions and contribute to technologies that make industries around the world more efficient and sustainable.

Please submit your application and CV in English. We review applications continuously and encourage early applications.

To ensure a fair and inclusive recruitment process, assessments and background checks may form part of the selection procedure, subject to local laws.

Job Types: Full-time, Contract, Permanent

Pay: €3.800,00 - €4.700,00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Laborant - 5 ploegen (m/v/x)
jobs.description:
Cargill is een familiebedrijf dat zich inzet voor het bieden van voedsel- en landbouwoplossingen om de wereld op een veilige, verantwoorde en duurzame manier te voeden.

Wij bevinden ons in het hart van de toeleveringsketen en werken samen met producenten en klanten om producten in te kopen, te produceren en te leveren, die van vitaal belang zijn.

Door klanten te voorzien van levensbehoeften, stellen we bedrijven in staat om te groeien, gemeenschappen om te bloeien en consumenten om goed te kunnen leiden.

Deze activiteit valt binnen ons gespecialiseerde portfolio, waar we diverse bedrijven bedienen die unieke klanten of markten ondersteunen, waaronder dierenvoeding en -gezondheid, bio-industrie, wegenzout en joint ventures van Cargill.

**DOEL EN IMPACT VAN DE BAAN**
------------------------------

**Werk jij graag in een laboratorium waar je analyses direct impact hebben op het productieproces?**

Dan is dit misschien wel jouw volgende stap. Voor onze raffinaderij in Bergen op Zoom zijn we op zoek naar een **Laboratory Technician Operations**. Een mooie rol voor een laborant die het leuk vindt om in een dynamische productieomgeving te werken en energie krijgt van afwisseling, verantwoordelijkheid en samenwerken met collega's in de operatie. Als laborant ben je een belangrijke schakel tussen kwaliteit en productie. Je voert analyses uit op tussen- en eindproducten, beoordeelt resultaten en zorgt ervoor dat de operatie beschikt over de juiste informatie om processen optimaal te laten verlopen. Jouw werk draagt iedere dienst opnieuw bij aan veilige, kwalitatief hoogwaardige producten die wereldwijd worden gebruikt.

**BELANGRIJKSTE VERANTWOORDELIJKHEDEN**
---------------------------------------

**Wat ga je doen?**

Geen dienst is hetzelfde. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

* Het nemen en analyseren van monsters uit het productieproces.
* Het uitvoeren van fysische en chemische analyses volgens vastgestelde methoden.
* Het interpreteren en rapporteren van analyseresultaten.
* Het vrijgeven van producten op basis van specificaties.
* Het registreren van resultaten in laboratorium- en kwaliteitssystemen.
* Het onderhouden en kalibreren van laboratoriumapparatuur.
* Het signaleren van afwijkingen en het meedenken over verbeteringen.
* Het bijdragen aan een veilige, nette en georganiseerde werkomgeving.

**MINIMALE KWALIFICATIES**
--------------------------

Je vindt het belangrijk om nauwkeurig te werken en kwaliteit staat bij jou altijd voorop. Tegelijkertijd voel je je thuis in een omgeving waar het tempo hoog ligt en waar je samen resultaten behaalt.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

* Een mbo 3- of mbo 4-diploma richting laboratoriumtechniek/ chemie
* Ervaring met laboratoriumwerkzaamheden binnen een productie omgeving
* Een proactieve en kwaliteitsgerichte instelling.
* Goede communicatieve vaardigheden.
* Bereidheid om in een 5-ploegendienst te werken.
* Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift.

**Wat maakt deze functie zo leuk?**

Je werkt niet in een laboratorium dat losstaat van de praktijk. Je zit midden in het productieproces en ziet direct wat het effect is van jouw analyses. Daardoor heb je veel contact met operators, hoofdoperators en collega's van FSQR.

Daarnaast krijg je een mooi arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket. Salaris vanaf € 3985 + 30% ploegentoeslag, 13e maand, vakantiegeld en niet te vergeten:

* Veel zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid
* Een afwisselende functie binnen een moderne productieomgeving
* De mogelijkheid om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen
* Een team waarin samenwerken centraal staat
* De kans om te werken voor een internationale organisatie met een sterke focus op veiligheid, kwaliteit en innovatie

**Geïnteresseerd?** Stuur ons dan vandaag nog je CV en motivatiebrief

**Volg ons op LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/company/cargill

Cargill streeft ernaar een inclusieve werkgever te zijn. Klik hier voor meer informatie https://careers.cargill.com/diversity/

jobs.title: Quality Control Coordinator
jobs.description:
**GenDx, where innovation drives diagnostics**  
GenDx is a global leader in molecular diagnostic laboratory solutions for high resolution tissue typing of both donors and patients and monitoring transplant success. We combine our cutting-edge software solutions, reagents for DNA sequencing-based HLA typing and transplant surveillance strategies with our excellent customer support including a comprehensive education program. Our products are sold all over the world through direct sales and distributors. The GenDx office is based at Utrecht Science Park in The Netherlands. Since 2022, GenDx is part of the Eurobio Scientific Group, headquartered in Les Ulis, France.

Being part of the GenDx team means joining a motivated team where everybody delivers their unique contribution to *the quality of life and survival chances of transplant patients.*

Do you want to be part of an innovative company that offers ample time for development?

To strengthen our team, we offer a challenging position for a motivated and detail-oriented **QC Coordinator.**

**As** **Coordinator in the Quality Control (QC) team** **at GenDx,** you will play a key role in coordinating QC procedures for our pre- and post-transplant products. You will be responsible for ensuring that our molecular diagnostics kits and reagents meet the highest quality standards before they reach our customers.

As part of the dynamic Operations team, and the QC team specifically, no two days are the same in this role, but you can expect a combination of hands-on lab work, data analysis, planning and cross-team collaboration. Your work involves a range of molecular biology techniques, including (q)PCR, gel electrophoresis, Sanger sequencing, next-generation sequencing (NGS) and long-read sequencing technologies.

Since we produce high-quality diagnostic products under ISO 13485 standards, precise documentation is an essential part of the role. In addition to planning and releasing QCs, your daily tasks will include analyzing results, performing laboratory tests, documenting findings, and collaborating with colleagues from Production and R&D.

In this role, accuracy, attention to detail, and a strong commitment to patient safety are essential. The work you perform directly supports clinicians and laboratories around the world in making reliable transplant decisions, ultimately impacting patient outcomes.

You will join a motivated and knowledgeable team working in a dynamic, innovative, and internationally oriented environment focused on excellence in molecular diagnostics.

**Responsibilities**

* Planning and approval of QC’s, quality reports, and certification of analysis (COA).
* Supporting and training of the QC technicians in the laboratory.
* Perform QC laboratory procedures, analyze and interpret QC data
* Report and investigate deviations
* Document findings in a clear and traceable manner, in line with ISO13485 requirements
* Maintain QC lab stocks, equipment and ensure a clean, organized work environment
* Execute method validation and process improvements
* Work in compliance with quality standards and internal procedures

**Requirements**

* Applied Sciences degree in molecular biology or equivalent.
* At least 3 years of hands-on lab experience as a technician, with excellent knowledge of molecular diagnostics, especially DNA sequencing, qPCR, amplification technologies.
* > 1 year of experience in a lab coordinator role or equivalent.
* Strong planning, organizational, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently and maintain attention to detail.
* Team-oriented with a proactive and hands-on mindset
* Strong affinity with quality and safety surveillance.
* Experience with working in a (scientific) company, where work is done according to ISO 13485.
* Excellent command of English (written and spoken).
* You currently live near Utrecht Science Park or are willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of the office.
* To be considered for this position, you must be legally permitted to live and work in the Netherlands. Sponsorship for a work visa may not always be possible.

**What do we offer**

* A team of like-minded people who all strive to deliver the highest quality products possible.
* An international working environment.
* New office facilities accommodating the GenDx Café to enjoy lunch together with your colleagues.
* Pension scheme.
* Laptop.
* Compensation for commuting traffic.
* Full-time position of 40 hours/week (1.0FTE).
* Option to work part-time (0.8FTE minimum).
* 25 holidays *and* a week of paid Christmas leave.
* Employee Assistance Program (OpenUp).
* Sport pass for Sports Center Olympos.

**Information**  
For more information you can contact Walinka van Tol, Associate Director Quality Control, at +31 (0)30 252 37 99.

**Do we match?**  
Join the experts in transplant diagnostics! Do you want to be part of an innovative company that offers excellent working conditions and ample time for personal development? **Apply now** via the button below and maybe you will soon be part of the GenDx team.

*If you would like to apply at GenDx, we kindly ask you to contact our HR team directly*

*To be considered for this position, you must be legally permitted to live and work in the Netherlands.*

*We will take all steps reasonably necessary to ensure that your data is treated securely, and confidentially, in accordance with the GenDx*  
*Recruitment Privacy Policy**.*
