jobs.title: Quality Control Analyst - 24/5 Shifts
jobs.description:
**We Are Teva**
---------------

We’re Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world-class generics business. Whether it’s innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology or delivering high-quality medicine worldwide, we’re dedicated to addressing patients’ needs now and in the future. Here, you will be part of a high-performing, inclusive culture that values fresh thinking and collaboration. You'll have the room to grow, the flexibility to balance life with work, and the opportunity to better health worldwide, together.

**Our Team, Your Impact**
-------------------------

As a Quality Control Analyst, you will join a multi-skilled analytical team performing testing across several laboratory areas: In-Process Control (IPC), Environmental monitoring and water testing, raw material testing, release testing, stability testing, validation testing.

You will perform analytical testing in a GMP-regulated environment, review and document results, troubleshoot laboratory equipment, and help ensure timely product release in support of Teva’s manufacturing operations.

**Duration**
------------

The position is available for up to 3 years.

**How You’ll Spend Your Day**
-----------------------------

* Perform in-process control testing using techniques such as (U)HPLC, GC, UV/VIS, TOC, PSD, and other chemical methods.
* Perform daily environmental monitoring and water testing, including conductivity, TOC, and other wet chemical analyses.
* Perform non-routine testing, including finished product release, stability, raw material, and validation-related testing.
* Evaluate, document, and verify analytical results in line with GMP requirements.
* Support laboratory investigations, deviations, and troubleshooting when needed.
* Contribute to daily lab operations and continuous process improvement.

**Shift Pattern**
-----------------

The QAL organization includes day-shift activities and a three-shift pattern. This position follows a 24/5 rotating shift schedule aligned with Teva’s production schedule. The three-week rotation is repeated continuously:

* Week 1: Sunday to Thursday night shifts, 23:00 to 07:30. Each shift ends the following day.

* Week 2: Monday to Friday evening shifts, 15:00 to 23:30.

* Week 3: Monday to Friday morning shifts, 07:00 to 15:30.

**Your Skills and Experience**
------------------------------

**Must-Have Qualifications**

* MLO or HLO degree in Analytical Chemistry, Chemistry, Life Sciences, or a related discipline.
* Willingness to work a 24/5 shift schedule.
* Strong attention to detail and a clear focus on quality.
* Hands-on team player.
* Fluent spoken and written English.
* Flexible and effective in a changing work environment.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in a GMP-regulated laboratory.
* Experience with chromatographic techniques, including HPLC, UPLC, or GC.
* Experience with laboratory systems such as LabWare LIMS v7 and Empower 3.

**How We’ll Take Care of You**
------------------------------

* Competitive Salary: We offer a salary that reflects your skills and experience.
* Shift Allowance: 25,8%
* Bonus based on personal and company performance.
* Comprehensive Pension Plan: Includes occupational disability insurance and partner and orphan insurance.
* Generous Vacation: 25 paid vacation days, plus 92 hours of PKB per year.
* Parental Leave: Benefit from 9 weeks of fully paid parental leave.
* Wellbeing Initiatives: Take advantage of our bike plan, caregiver policy and more.

**Already Working @Teva?**
--------------------------

Make sure to apply through our internal career site on Twist—your one-stop shop for career development

**Teva’s Equal Employment Opportunity Commitment**
--------------------------------------------------

Teva Pharmaceuticals is committed to equal opportunity in employment. It is Teva's global policy that equal employment opportunity be provided without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, disability, pregnancy, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, ancestry, veteran status, national or ethnic origin or any other legally recognized status entitled to protection under applicable laws. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace for all. If you are contacted for a job opportunity, please advise us of any accommodations needed to support you throughout the recruitment and selection process. All accommodation information provided will be treated as confidential and used only for the purpose of providing an accessible candidate experience.

Backed by a competitive salary and compensation package, you will work in a professional setting with clients and team members from all over the world.

jobs.title: Research Assistant
jobs.description:
**Your function**
-----------------

Toxic cyanobacterial blooms close swimming areas and threaten drinking-water supplies, so detecting them early matters. The CYANOSPECTRA project detects these organisms in lakes and waterways from the spectroscopic signatures of their photosynthetic machinery. In 2027 the project moves from the lab towards practice. As a researcher, you will help validate this technology together with partners from the water sector and academia, and contribute to laying the groundwork for a startup.

**Your duties**

* collect water samples in the field and grow cultures of cyanobacteria and algae in the lab
* measure and analyse the fluorescence and absorption fingerprints of blooms
* develop and test new algorithms to extract species composition and abundance from fluorescence and absorption spectra, for example using spectral decomposition and machine learning
* build a reference library of spectral fingerprints and a reproducible analysis pipeline
* measure the spectra of cultures and field samples, and take part in sampling and culturing with the team
* test and validate the technology together with water managers and industry partners
* contribute to outreach and to the preparation of a startup

**Your profile**
----------------

### **Your profile**

* an MSc degree in physics, biophysics, chemistry, data science, computational biology, environmental science or a related field
* demonstrable experience developing your own data-analysis methods in Python, MATLAB or R, beyond applying standard packages
* experience with multivariate analysis or machine learning, such as PCA, non-negative matrix factorisation, multivariate curve resolution, classification or regression models
* experience with spectroscopic or other signal data is a plus, as is experience with microalgae or cyanobacteria
* willingness to work hands-on in the lab and to join fieldwork
* enthusiasm for working with people outside academia
* good command of English

As a university, we strive for equal opportunities for all, recognising that diversity takes many forms. We believe that diversity in all its complexity is invaluable for the quality of our teaching, research and service. We are always looking for talent with diverse backgrounds and experiences. This also means that we are committed to creating an inclusive community so that we can use diversity as an asset.

We realise that each individual brings a unique set of skills, expertise and mindset. Therefore we are happy to invite anyone who recognises themselves in the profile to apply, even if you do not meet all the requirements.

**What do we offer?**
---------------------

**Scale 10 (Researcher 4, €3,706–€5,760 gross per month), at least 0.8 FTE, for one year.** You will join a small, friendly research group within Biophysics of Photosynthesis at LaserLaB, working where research, technology and real-world water management meet. You will gain hands-on experience of how a lab discovery becomes a product.

**About us**
------------

**The Biophysics of Photosynthesis group**  
The Biophysics of Photosynthesis group is part of the Department of Physics and Astronomy and LaserLaB Amsterdam at the Faculty of Science. We use optical spectroscopy and structural methods to understand how photosynthetic organisms capture light and respond to their environment. We apply this knowledge to challenges such as water quality monitoring.

**Faculty of Science**  
Working at the Faculty of Science means collaborating with students, lecturers and researchers who are focused on their field, yet have a broad view of the world. We are proud of a positive and inclusive workplace culture within the faculty, where we work together with great energy and a pragmatic attitude to tackle social challenges. At the Faculty of Science, scientists and students work on fundamental and complex societal issues for a sustainable, healthy and just future.

From forest fires to big data, from obesity to malnutrition, from helium to the universe and from genetics to medicine: our education and research cover the full breadth of science, from molecules to mankind. Our academic education and research are highly experimental, technical and interdisciplinary in nature. That is why we collaborate extensively with leading scientific institutes and industry. The faculty has more than 8,000 students studying in one of the 39 programms and employs more than 1,400 staff across 10 scientific departments, making us one of the largest science faculties in the Netherlands.

**Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam**  
Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam stands for values-driven education and research. We are open-minded experts with the ability to think freely - a broader mind. Maintaining an entrepreneurial perspective and concentrating on diversity, significance and humanity, we work on sustainable solutions with social impact. By joining forces, across the boundaries of disciplines, we work towards a better world for people and planet. Together we create a safe and respectful working and study climate, and an inspiring environment for education and research. Learn more about our codes of conduct

We are located on one physical campus, in the heart of Amsterdam's Zuidas business district, with excellent location and accessibility. Over 6,150 staff work at the VU and over 31,000 students attend academic education.

Diversity is the driving force of VU Amsterdam. VU wants to be accessible and receptive to diversity in disciplines, cultures, ideas, nationalities, beliefs, preferences and worldviews. We believe that trust, respect, interest and differences lead to new insights and innovation, to sharpness and clarity, to excellence and a broader understanding.

jobs.title: QC Analyst
jobs.description:
Ben jij nauwkeuring, analytisch en wil jij graag meer leren over chemie? Dat kan als QC Analyst bij Royal Smit & Zoon. Als QC Analyst bij Royal Smit & Zoon zorg jij ervoor dat onze grondstoffen, halffabricaten en eindproducten voldoen aan de afgesproken kwaliteitseisen.

**Wat je gaat doen**:

Als QC Analyst binnen het QC-team in Amersfoort werk je direct in lijn met het productieproces en speel je een belangrijke rol in het bewaken van de productkwaliteit. Je voert analyses uit op onder andere poeders, controleert steekmonsters van afgezakte batches en afvalwater monsters. Hierbij voer je verschillende laboratoriumanalyses uit, zoals pH-, solids- en asgehaltebepalingen, titraties en HPLC-analyses.

Naast het uitvoeren en beoordelen van analyses voer je ook controles in de fabriek uit. Je beoordeelt de resultaten, signaleert eventuele afwijkingen, verwerkt afgekeurde batches en houdt de betrokken collega’s op de hoogte. Daarnaast draag je actief bij aan het verbeteren van analysemethoden en QC-processen. Met jouw nauwkeurige en zorgvuldige werkwijze help je vertragingen in het productieproces te voorkomen en lever je een directe bijdrage aan een betrouwbare en constante productkwaliteit.

Verder voer je de volgende werkzaamheden uit:

* Je onderzoekt en controleert de kwaliteit van grondstoffen, producten in productie, halffabricaten, eindproducten en afvalwater volgens vastgestelde kwaliteitscriteria en productspecificaties.
* Je analyseert resultaten, signaleert afwijkingen en onderneemt passende actie binnen de geldende procedures.
* Je onderhoudt tijdens analyses en bij verstoringen contact met aanvragers en andere betrokkenen, zodat processen zo snel mogelijk kunnen doorgaan.
* Je organiseert je eigen werkzaamheden en legt resultaten zorgvuldig en volgens de werkprocedures vast.
* Je geeft, na analyse en controle, grondstoffen, halffabricaten en eindproducten vrij voor gebruik en/of verzending.
* Je levert een actieve bijdrage aan verbetertrajecten en aan het continu verbeteren van QC-processen en producten.
* Je valideert, in overleg met R&D, en helpt bij de ingebruikname van analysemethoden en meetinstrumenten.
* Je werkt volgens het Quality Management System en de geldende ISO, QESH- en ESG-richtlijnen.

**Jouw profiel**:

jobs.title: Quality Control Technician
jobs.description:
Cryoport Systems is a comprehensive supply chain partner for the life sciences industry, delivering specialized solutions to meet the challenges of the biopharmaceutical, cell and gene therapy, reproductive medicine, and animal health markets. Our offerings span logistics, BioServices and biostorage, cryopreservation, and consulting, ensuring the highest standards of quality and reliability for sensitive materials. With our expansive platform of management solutions and decades of temperature-controlled supply chain expertise, Cryoport Systems helps Enable the Outcome™ by supporting certainty and precision in the supply chain, whether advancing groundbreaking therapies, supporting families on their reproductive journeys, or enhancing animal health programs.

Cryoport Systems is looking for a **QC Technician** to join our Quality Control team in Villers-le-Bouillet.

This is an excellent opportunity for a laboratory professional who is passionate about quality, science, and GMP-regulated environments. In this role, you will contribute directly to ensuring the quality and compliance of activities supporting both our Kitting and Cryopreservation operations.

**Your Mission**

As a QC Technician, you will perform laboratory and operational Quality Control activities that support the release and ongoing monitoring of critical operations. Working closely with the QC team and operational departments, you will execute testing activities, maintain GMP documentation, participate in investigations, and help ensure compliance with quality standards.

You will have the opportunity to work with a variety of laboratory techniques while supporting innovative therapies that make a difference for patients around the world.

**What You'll Do**

* Perform Quality Control activities supporting both Kitting and Cryopreservation operations.
* Execute Environmental Monitoring activities and other laboratory testing according to approved procedures.
* Perform cell count, viability testing, flow cytometry, and other QC techniques following training and qualification.
* Execute laboratory activities according to established schedules and priorities.
* Maintain accurate GMP documentation and ensure compliance with data integrity principles.
* Support laboratory maintenance and cleaning activities.
* Identify and report quality or compliance concerns, including potential OOS or OOT events.
* Participate in investigations and laboratory event assessments under supervision.
* Contribute to ongoing quality and compliance excellence across the site.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in a Life Sciences related field.
* A first experience in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or CDMO environment within a Quality Control role.
* Basic knowledge of GMP principles, Good Documentation Practices, and data integrity requirements.
* Experience with Environmental Monitoring, cell count/viability testing, and/or flow cytometry is considered a strong asset.
* Strong organizational and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage competing priorities.
* Collaborative and proactive mindset.
* Fluent French and professional English (minimum B2 level).
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams).

**Why Join Cryoport?**

Our offices in Villers-le-Bouillet (Belgium) offer a modern and ergonomic workspace, ideally located between Liège and Namur, with easy highway access. Since moving into our brand-new facilities in November 2023, we've created a comfortable & ergonomic environment.

We foster a friendly and engaging atmosphere, regularly organizing breakfasts and team events because we believe a positive work environment matters.

As part of a global group, you'll operate in an international environment, using English daily to collaborate across sites, broadening your perspective on different cultures and ways of working.

We offer a competitive salary with extra-legal benefits (meal vouchers, hospitalization insurance, equity and more).

Most importantly, you'll contribute to a meaningful mission—advancing therapies in the fight against cancer.

jobs.title: VIE MSAT Lab Associate Scientist
jobs.description:
**Make your mark for patients**

UCB is an international biopharmaceutical company primarily engaged in the research, development, and commercialization of pharmaceutical and biotechnological products. It specializes in researching therapeutic solutions for patients suffering from severe diseases, treated by specialists, particularly in the fields of the central nervous system (including epilepsy) and inflammation (including allergies).

The Braine-l'Alleud site specializes in chemical synthesis, development, manufacturing, and packaging of pharmaceutical products.

More information at: www.ucb.com

We are looking for a dynamic and collaborative Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT) Laboratory Associate Scientist to join our global Biologics MSAT team based at UCB’s campus in Braine-l’Alleud, Belgium.

In this role, you will perform laboratory work to support process development activities and address the needs of commercial manufacturing groups worldwide. You will also build strong technical and scientific partnerships with process development, manufacturing, and external partner organizations, acting as a laboratory expert in downstream processing (DSP).

The MSAT Laboratory Associate Scientist will play a key role in:

* Conducting downstream processing studies to enhance process understanding.
* Providing laboratory support for technology transfers, process validation activities, manufacturing operations, and deviation/investigation support through the execution of DSP and analytical experiments within MSAT.
* Performing product quality analysis on cell culture and downstream process samples using a variety of analytical techniques.
* Planning and coordinating DSP and analytical laboratory activities.
* Supporting the implementation and transfer of analytical methods within the MSAT laboratory for late-stage and commercial products.
* Establishing small-scale DSP laboratory models for commercial products, including chromatography and tangential flow filtration (TFF) processes.

Your Profile:

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Biology, Biotechnology, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
* Experience in downstream processing (DSP) and/or analytical techniques is an asset.
* Prior laboratory experience is a plus.
* Fluency in English is required.
* Basic proficiency in French is required.

**Please note that this program is in partnership with Business France, and we follow the prerequisites required by Business France to carry out a VIE assignment. The main participation prerequisites are as follows:**

* Be between 18 and 28 years old;
* Hold the nationality of a member country of the European Economic Area;
* Have not worked or lived in the country where the mission will take place;
* Be available to dedicate yourself to the mission full-time;
* If you have French nationality or dual nationality, be in compliance with the national service obligations of France (Numéro Identifiant Défense);
* Have a clean criminal record.

If you do not meet all these conditions, we will not be able to consider your application.

jobs.title: Junior Research Associate – Research projects on ‘Chemical analysis of flavour compounds in complex matrices’
jobs.description:
**Company**

**Sciensano is a renowned and leading scientific institute** dedicated to bridging the gap between science, health and society. More than 1,000 dedicated staff members work every day to promote human and animal health within a professional and independent framework. With its long tradition of scientific expertise, Sciensano plays **a key role at the intersection of human, animal and environmental health**. Sciensano’s strength and distinctiveness lie in its holistic and multidisciplinary approach, which leads to scientific research offering unique perspectives, in the interests of everyone’s health.

**Could Sciensano be your employer**? Working at Sciensano means choosing a role where you are fully committed to driving improvements across the broad field of health. If you have the right expertise and the necessary commitment, don’t hesitate to apply. At Sciensano, our staff receive our full attention. With us, you’ll have the opportunity to grow within an institute with a people-centred approach, where staff development is a priority and where excellence is valued, regardless of one’s position. We place great importance on friendliness, inclusion, diversity, respect and openness. Our staff enjoy terms of employment that facilitate a healthy work-life balance, a generous number of annual leave days, a salary in line with government pay scales, plus numerous additional benefits!

Find out more at: https://www.sciensano.be.

  
**Job description**

We are currently looking for a **Junior Research Associate – Research projects on ‘Chemical analysis of flavour compounds in complex matrices’**.

You will be joining the Organic Contaminants and Additives department and will work specifically on the Commaf research project, or ‘chemical analysis of flavourings in complex matrices’, the main objective of which is to establish a quantitative and versatile method for analysing flavouring substances, in order to monitor their presence on the Belgian market.

*The ‘Organic Contaminants and Additives’ department is responsible for identifying and assessing the health risks associated with the presence of new chemical substances in foodstuffs, food contact materials, consumer goods and the environment. Furthermore, the department supports public health through innovative research, analysis, monitoring and expert advice. The unit comprises around twenty scientific staff and laboratory technicians.*

Your duties will include, in particular:

* developing and validating a quantitative analytical method for various food-grade aromatic molecules in complex matrices;
* applying this method to analyse hundreds of samples relevant to the project, whilst ensuring the reliability and quality of the results within the specified timeframes;
* carrying out analytical work, from extraction to GC-MS analysis, of aromatic substances;
* ensuring the progress and quality of the validations required to enable the introduction of new methods;
* ensuring that all analytical instruments used are functioning correctly, in order to guarantee compliance with all quality parameters;
* draft protocols and reports detailing the progress of the work;
* provide support in resolving project-related issues;
* present project results at project progress meetings and at external events, such as symposia.

  
**Profile**  

* A Master’s degree in Science (specialising in **chemistry**), bioengineering or a related field
* A solid grounding in analytical chemistry and a basic understanding of the analysis of aromatic compounds
* Experience in the analysis of aromatic compounds, **mass spectrometry and gas chromatography**.
* Knowledge of general analysis, trace analysis and sample preparation methods
* A technical mindset (understanding how equipment works, basic maintenance, troubleshooting)
* Language skills: French or Dutch; good knowledge of English (scientific literature, writing, oral communication, etc.)
* General skills: rigour, independence, drive, organisation, ability to summarise, ability to work in a team, communication skills
* Place of work: Sciensano site in Ixelles; willingness **to travel to and work regularly at the LIBST laboratory at UCL**

  
**We offer**  

* A fixed-term contract (30 months) starting in mid-January at a renowned scientific institute
* Clear and transparent remuneration: pay scale SW10 (€4,025.92 gross per month)
* Significant benefits: hospitalisation and group insurance, a generous number of days’ leave\*, meal vouchers, and a wide range of attractive offers via the Fed+ card
* An environmentally conscious employer: 100 per cent reimbursement for journeys between home and work by public transport or travel pass
* An attractive working arrangement: option to work from home / flexible working hours on a 38-hour week
* A stimulating working environment: excellent opportunities to develop new soft and hard skills (a digital learning environment: the SciensanoAcademy, as well as opportunities for face-to-face training during working hours).

  
**Contact**

Application deadline: 8th of December 2026

The next steps :

1. your application will be thoroughly reviewed by the recruiter and the experts of the (scientific) unit;

2. you will receive an email with our decision, based on your CV and cover letter, and the published job profile,

3. and if your application is successful, you will be invited for an interview in good time.

Any further questions? Please contact us at jobs@sciensano.be

jobs.title: QC Analyst (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Terumo, we advance lifesaving medical technologies to benefit society. Are you eager to make a difference with us? Here, you’ll grow your expertise while staying true to your personal aspirations.

Guided by our Japanese heritage, we act with respect, take ownership, and pursue continuous improvement. If you see yourself in our values, keep reading; this might be the opportunity you're looking for.

  

**Department Info**
-------------------

Terumo Pharmaceutical Services Germany (TPSG), with sites in Leverkusen and Wuppertal, is part of Terumo’s global Pharmaceutical Solutions division. We support pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies by providing high-quality contract development and manufacturing services.

Within our Quality Control department, we perform analytical testing to support the release and stability assessment of biopharmaceutical products. Our expertise spans physicochemical testing, chromatography, electrophoretic methods, bioassays, and microbiological testing. By bringing together expertise across these scientific disciplines, our teams help ensure that products consistently meet high standards for quality, safety, and regulatory compliance.

**Job Summary**
---------------

As a **QC Analyst**, you will perform hands-on analytical testing of biopharmaceutical products, with a strong focus on chromatographic and electrophoretic separation techniques. You will support routine release, stability and in-process testing as well as analytical method transfers and the related documentation. Through your work in the laboratory, you will directly contribute to the quality and reliability of products that ultimately matter to patients.

This is an **18-month temporary position**, primarily based at our Wuppertal-Aprath site, with occasional support at the Leverkusen site.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Perform routine testing of release, stability, and in-process samples according to approved procedures and specifications.
* Perform analytical testing using separation techniques such as HPLC, UPLC, CE, and/or iCIEF.
* Review, evaluate, document, and report analytical results accurately and according to applicable quality requirements.
* Support analytical method transfers, verifications, qualifications, and validation activities.
* Contribute to the drafting, updating, and review of analytical procedures, test methods, SOPs, and other relevant laboratory documentation.
* Prepare samples, solutions, reagents, and other materials required for analytical testing.
* Support laboratory equipment and instrument management, including maintenance and readiness for testing.
* Contribute to day-to-day GMP laboratory activities, including 5S and general laboratory organization.
* Collaborate with colleagues within QC and across other teams to ensure reliable and efficient laboratory operations.
* Contribute to continuous improvement and remain open to learning new methods, processes, and quality requirements.

**Profile Description**
-----------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Pharmacy, Biochemistry, Life Sciences, or a related scientific discipline, or relevant vocational training (Ausbildung) in a scientific or laboratory field.
* 1 to 2 years of relevant laboratory experience, ideally in a QC GMP environment.
* Hands-on experience with chromatography, particularly HPLC and/or UPLC.
* Experience with other separation techniques, such as CE and/or iCIEF, is an advantage.
* Strong interest in hands-on laboratory work, with good attention to detail, quality, and reliable documentation.
* Adaptability and willingness to learn new analytical techniques, quality systems, procedures, and company-specific GMP requirements.
* Collaborative and responsible mindset, with an interest in continuous learning and professional development.
* Fluency in German and English, both written and spoken.

**Offer**
---------

At Terumo, our purpose is **Advancing Healthcare with Heart**. In this role, your analytical expertise contributes directly to the quality and safety of biopharmaceutical products within an international healthcare company with a strong sense of purpose. You’ll gain hands-on exposure to analytical techniques used in biopharmaceutical Quality Control while further developing your expertise in separations, GMP, method validation, and analytical method transfer. You’ll be part of a collaborative environment where teamwork, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning are valued, with opportunities to contribute your own ideas and help improve the way we work. Guided by our Japanese heritage, our culture is built on respect, ownership, and continuous improvement. We also offer opportunities for professional development, together with a competitive compensation and benefits package.

**Contact Person**
------------------

Marjolein Buyl - Talent Acquisition Partner Business

Working at Terumo means advancing healthcare with heart. Here, you are empowered to grow your own way, inspired to create to innovate, and supported as we get there together. Join us in shaping a healthier future for our patients, society, and each other.

jobs.title: Research Scientist – Agricultural Earth Observation & Modelling
jobs.description:
VITO develops technology that supports the transition towards a more sustainable society and economy. Within this mission, remote sensing is one of our key enabling technologies. By combining Earth observation data from satellites and drones with artificial intelligence, we create practical, science-based solutions for a wide range of application domains.

The Remote Sensing team within VITO Environmental Intelligence now brings together more than 150 motivated colleagues. To strengthen our agricultural research and its contribution to resilient and sustainable food systems, we are looking for a researcher who can connect Earth Observation (EO) with crop productivity, biomass and yield modelling.

**Your role**

As part of the Agriculture research team within VITO’s TERRA department, you will contribute to applied research projects in the agri-food sector for industrial and institutional clients, including the European Commission and the Flemish government.

Your work will focus on developing agricultural monitoring solutions based on Earth Observation (EO), modelling and data science. More specifically, you will:

* Develop and validate EO methods to monitor crop biomass and vegetation productivity, and to estimate and forecast agricultural yields.
* Combine satellite observations with weather, field and agricultural management data.
* Apply statistical, machine-learning and crop growth models, exploring calibration, data assimilation and hybrid modelling approaches.
* Assess the accuracy, uncertainty and transferability of methods across different crops, seasons and regions.
* Translate your research into reproducible Python workflows and collaborate with validation specialists, software engineers and platform teams to develop scalable solutions for operational services.
* Take scientific ownership of your activities and help shape research priorities.
* Contribute to project proposals, reporting, scientific publications and international collaborations.

Our applied research typically operates at TRL 4–6 and covers topics such as grassland productivity, high-resolution vegetation products for the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service, and yield forecasting. Through your work, you will help turn agricultural monitoring into reliable, predictive and actionable agricultural intelligence.

  

* A Master’s or PhD degree in bioscience engineering, environmental sciences, engineering science or a related field

* Expertise in remote sensing data processing, geographic information systems, statistics and big data analysis
* Research experience in applying EO to yield estimation, phenology, carbon sequestration or crop type mapping is an asset.
* Solid experience in Python programming
* Experience in applying machine learning techniques to remote sensing data is a strong asset
* Excellent writing and presentation skills in English
* A thematic background in agriculture or environmental sciences

### **Offer**

At VITO, you will work in a multidisciplinary environment alongside researchers, developers, operators and business developers who share the ambition to turn research into real-world impact.

You will join our **Agriculture team**, a warm and close-knit group of researchers where cooperation, trust, curiosity and open communication are key. We combine high professional standards with mutual support and a healthy work-life balance. As your work also connects you with clients and partners in an international environment, occasional travel may be part of the role.

* **Flexible working:** we work activity-based, with our headquarters in Mol and an anticipated average onsite presence of around 50%. Part-time remote work and working from our satellite offices in Antwerp-Berchem, Genk, Ghent, Leuven, Kortrijk or Ostend are also possible.
* **Attractive conditions:** a competitive salary complemented by allowances, insurance and a modular holiday package.

* **International recognition:** work for an organization known for cutting-edge technological research and scientific consultancy.

* **Healthy work-life balance:** flexibility is an integral part of how we work and collaborate.

**Patient-Centered Research, In-trial qualitative research**

Evidera’s Patient-Centered Research (PCR) group combines a unique portfolio of scientific disciplines, including health sciences, psychometrics, epidemiology, psychology, and many other social sciences. Our PCR staff conduct a variety of studies using quantitative and qualitative approaches to develop clinical outcomes assessments, evaluate patient preferences and utilities, execute various implementation science studies, conduct Delphi panels and do secondary data analysis using advanced statistical techniques.

Within the PCR group, the ITR team conduct qualitative (interviews) studies and/or surveys in the context of a clinical trial to obtain feedback from clinical trial participants (patient, caregiver, investigator or study staff) on various topics i.e., understanding patients’ experience with their condition, its impacts on their lives, exploring treatment benefit, describing trial participant experiences and identifying aspects of burden from their participation. ITR can be implemented using an embedded design (e.g., ITR is defined as clinical trial activity in the clinical trial study protocol and ICF) or associated design (ITR is covered under separate protocol, separate ICF, and IRB/EC approval, with separate site recruitment and contracting). jobs.title: Research assistant position in mechano-immunology
jobs.description:
**Do you want to contribute to top quality medical research?**
--------------------------------------------------------------

*We invite applications for a research assistant position in Dr. Rong Ma’s Group in the Department of Medical Biochemistry and Biophysics. We are looking for an enthusiastic and collaborative research assistant with a strong interest in experimental biomedical research. This position is well suited to an early-career candidate looking to build toward doctoral research in mechano-immunology.*

The lab’s research focus is to decode the mechanical axis of immune activation in T cells and NK cells and use this knowledge to engineer new therapeutic strategies. We value an open, friendly and inclusive working environment where researchers exchange ideas and are encouraged to develop scientifically and independently. The lab will launch in Feb. 2027.

Dr. Rong Ma is an incoming Assistant Professor at KI MBB. She obtained her PhD from Emory University and completed her postdoctoral training at Stanford University as a Stanford Science Fellow. During her training, she developed molecular tools to study the piconewton forces immune cells exert and focused on how T and NK cells leverage mechanical force for activation.

More information about the lab: https://rongmalab.com/

### **Description of the subject area**

Immune cells don't just read the chemistry of what they touch, they also “feel” it. For example, T cells generate piconewton forces when recognizing antigens, and this mechanical force helps them decide whether to get activated. The mechanical information is largely uncharted in immunology and often ignored by today's medicine. Our lab wants to change that. We build molecular tools to measure and control the forces immune cells apply, decode how those forces are turned into decisions like killing a cancer or infected cell, and use what we learn to engineer better diagnostics and next-generation immunotherapies. Apply if you have a strong passion for science and are curious about mechanical forces in immune cells!

### **Your mission**

As a research assistant, you will provide experimental support for ongoing projects and assist with data analysis. The research project you will work on will be within the group's mechano-immunology program, at the intersection of molecular and cell biophysics, immunology, protein and cell engineering, and molecular mechanotechnologies. As one of the first members of a new group, you will also contribute to the lab's technical foundation and research culture.

### **Your profile**

We are seeking a highly motivated research assistant with a strong interest in the role of mechanical forces in immunity. The ideal candidate should also be detail-oriented, eager to contribute to cutting-edge research, and importantly, feel happy when doing research. Personal suitability, initiative, and the ability to contribute positively to a collaborative research environment will be given considerable weight.

To be eligible for the position, you must meet the following requirements:

* a master’s degree in chemistry, biology, biomedical engineering, biotechnology, immunology, or a related field, or an equivalent degree expected to be completed before the start of employment
* documented hands-on research experience in a lab in biological chemistry, bioengineering, or immunology, broadly defined, including relevant thesis research
* curiosity and enthusiasm to solve fundamental biological questions
* ability to follow experimental protocols precisely and maintain structured laboratory records
* good communication skills in English, both spoken and written
* ability to work independently on assigned tasks and collaborate effectively with other team members

**It is considered meritorious if you have one or more of the following qualifications or experiences:**

* research experience or skills in one or more of the following areas: mechanobiology, cell culture and cell-based assays, fluorescence microscopy, DNA nanotechnology, flow cytometry, molecular biology, protein expression, cell engineering, or work with primary human immune cells, including T and/or NK cells
* co-authorship of one or more peer-reviewed publications
* the ability to troubleshoot experimental procedures and establish new methods

jobs.description:
**Do you want to contribute to improving human health?**
--------------------------------------------------------

The Department of Laboratory Medicine consists of seven divisions that conduct both research and teaching. The department is involved in advanced research, encompassing both basic and applied research. All divisions operate in close collaboration with clinicians at the Karolinska University Hospital. The Division of Biomolecular and Cellular Medicine (BCM) focuses on the use of modified biomolecules, cells, and cell products as new therapeutic agents, as well as the identification and study of suitable biomolecular and cellular targets for therapy and diagnostics. The division is also connected to the Karolinska ATMP Center.

The research group of the EL Andaloussi lab is tackling one of the most critical challenges in modern therapeutics: the efficient delivery of macromolecules to target cells in vivo. Despite major advancements in disease understanding and mechanism exploration, many promising therapeutic approaches remain inaccessible in clinical settings due to a lack of effective delivery systems. To address this, we focus on pioneering novel drug delivery technologies that enable the safe and efficient transport of proteins, RNAs, and gene editors to specific tissues.

The lab has established expertise in engineering extracellular vesicles (EVs) such as exosomes, which are optimized for therapeutic delivery and targeting. In our efforts to push boundaries, we also explore other advanced delivery systems, including lipid nanoparticles, to address distinct therapeutic challenges. The lab’s therapeutics platform utilizes biological and synthetic nanoparticles for the targeted delivery of therapeutic agents in relevant cellular and animal models, identifying the most effective approaches for diverse applications.

The Division of Biomolecular and Cellular Medicine is seeking a research assistant with a strong background and hands-on experience in nanoparticle analytics. This role is part of a recently established, grant-funded team led by André Görgens. Building on a decade of experience with a strong track record of assay and method development for extracellular vesicle characterization and process development, the Görgens lab is now aiming to develop a next-generation nanoparticle analytics and sorting platform in close collaboration with the EL Andaloussi lab. One of the main aims of the Görgens lab is to build a dedicated platform for the high-resolution analysis and sorting of Extracellular Vesicles through utilizing flow cytometric and orthogonal methods.

### **Your mission**

We are seeking an ambitious researcher to develop methods for analysis and sorting of Extracellular Vesicles and other nanoparticles, with a focus on developing flow cytometry-based workflows and procedures, optimizing pre-analytical variables for body fluid and cell-derived Extracellular Vesicles as well as for synthetic nanoparticles, in context of development of next generation therapies and diagnostics.

### **Your profile**

The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in biochemistry, biotechnology, bioinformatics, or process development in context of drug development or engineering, ideally with experience in nanoparticle flow cytometry and flow cytometric cell sorting, nanoparticle formulation, or related fields in nanoparticle preparation and analysis.

The candidate must:

This also must include experience using fluorescent probes to label nanoparticles and knowledge of pre-analytical parameter choices).

jobs.title: Doctoral (PhD) student position in natural killer cell biology
jobs.description:
**Do you want to contribute to top quality medical research?**
--------------------------------------------------------------

To be a doctoral student means to devote oneself to a research project under supervision of experienced researchers and following an individual study plan. For a doctoral degree, the equivalent of four years of full-time doctoral education is required.

The Department of Microbiology, Tumor and Cell Biology (MTC) at Karolinska Institutet conducts research and teaching within immunology, infection biology, cell biology and cancer. Our key words are multidisciplinary, bridging, national and international collaborations.

### **The research group**

The position is based at the newly established **Center for Immuno-Oncology** at the Department of Microbiology, Tumor and Cell Biology (MTC), Karolinska Institutet. The Division brings together expertise in fundamental immunology, cancer biology, and cellular immunotherapy, creating a highly interactive and interdisciplinary research environment with strong links to clinical and translational research.

The Malmberg research group has a long-standing interest in human Natural Killer (NK) cell biology and the development of next-generation NK-cell-based immunotherapies. Our research combines advanced single-cell and computational approaches, genome engineering, high-resolution imaging, and functional tumor models to understand the molecular mechanisms governing NK-cell differentiation, cytotoxicity, and persistence.

The doctoral project is embedded in a broader research program aimed at decoding and engineering the intracellular programs that control immune-cell function. Through close collaborations with clinical and translational research teams at Karolinska University Hospital and international partners, we aim to translate fundamental discoveries into innovative cellular immunotherapies for cancer.

### **The doctoral student project and the duties of the doctoral student**

Natural killer (NK) cells are immune cells with an intrinsic ability to recognize and eliminate cancer cells. They are promising candidates for next-generation cancer immunotherapies, but their therapeutic efficacy is often limited by insufficient functional maturation, persistence, and resistance to tumor-associated stress. While considerable efforts have focused on improving how NK cells recognize tumors, less is known about the intracellular programs that determine their capacity to sustain effective tumor killing.

This doctoral project aims to decode and reprogram the **cytotoxic operating system** of human NK cells, the interconnected regulatory networks that control their maturation, cytotoxic function, and persistence. Using primary NK cells and induced pluripotent stem cell-derived NK cells (iNK cells) as experimental platforms, the project combines advanced single-cell analysis, computational modeling, genetic engineering, and functional studies.

The project has three integrated components:

* **Decoding the cytotoxic operating system** by comparing iNK cells with naturally occurring, highly functional NK-cell populations using single-cell transcriptomics, epigenetic profiling, and computational analysis of gene regulatory networks.
* **Engineering improved NK-cell states** through targeted genetic perturbations, including CRISPR/Cas9 editing and controlled gene expression, to identify regulatory programs that promote maturation, sustained cytotoxicity, and resistance to cellular stress.
* **Validating therapeutic potential** by evaluating engineered NK cells in advanced functional assays and preclinical models of hematological malignancies and solid tumors, with particular emphasis on persistence and long-term antitumor activity.

The doctoral student will:

* Work with human iPSCs and develop genetically engineered iNK cells.
* Apply CRISPR/Cas9-based gene editing and targeted genetic perturbation strategies.
* Perform advanced multiparameter flow cytometry and cell sorting.
* Conduct functional cytotoxicity assays, including high-resolution live-cell imaging and serial-killing assays.
* Generate and analyze single-cell transcriptomic and epigenetic datasets in collaboration with computational scientists.
* Investigate NK-cell maturation, metabolic fitness, and functional resilience under tumor-associated stress conditions.
* Participate in preclinical studies evaluating NK-cell persistence and antitumor activity.
* Present results at scientific meetings and international conferences, contribute to scientific publications, and complete doctoral coursework.

The doctoral student is expected to take an active role in experimental design, data analysis, scientific interpretation, and the development of new research hypotheses. The project offers interdisciplinary training at the interface of fundamental immunology, stem cell biology, genome engineering, computational biology, and translational cancer immunotherapy.

### **What do we offer?**

A creative and inspiring environment full of expertise and curiosity. Karolinska Institutet is one of the world's leading medical universities. Our vision is to pursue the development of knowledge about life and to promote a better health for all. At Karolinska Institutet, we conduct successful medical research and hold the largest range of medical education in Sweden. As a doctoral student you are offered an individual research project, a well-educated supervisor, a vast range of elective courses and the opportunity to work in a leading research group. Karolinska Institutet collaborates with prominent universities from all around the world, which ensures opportunities for international exchanges. You will be employed on a doctoral studentship which means that you receive a contractual salary. Employees also have access to our modern gym for free and receive reimbursements for medical care.

jobs.title: Research assistant in Molecular human physiology
jobs.description:
**Do you want to contribute to top quality medical research?**
--------------------------------------------------------------

**Overview of the Position**

The Human Molecular Physiology group, lead by Assistant Professor Ben Stocks, is looking for an ambitous Research Assistant to contribute to our research in the area of mitochondrial quality control in type 2 diabetes. The Human Molecular Physiology group aims to understand the molecular regulators of metabolism, principally in the context of exercise and type 2 diabetes. This position will be available on a one-year basis. It is our intention that the position will start in January 2027.

**Short running title of project:** *Mitochondrial quality control in type 2 diabetes*.

**Research Project**

*Role of optineurin in mitochondrial quality control and metabolic flexibility in type 2 diabetes*

A hallmark feature of type 2 diabetes is reduced skeletal muscle mitochondrial content. Exercise improves mitochondrial volume and quality, however emerging evidence from our laboratory suggests that this may be compromised in individuals with type 2 diabetes. The purpose of this project is to define the molecular mechanisms underlying defective mitophagy in type 2 diabetes. By using exercise as a physiological perturbation, this work will establish how mitochondrial quality control is regulated in human skeletal muscle, and how this regulation is altered in type 2 diabetes. These studies will define how exercise regulates skeletal muscle mitophagy and reveal a mechanism underlying impaired mitochondrial quality control in type 2 diabetes.

**Key responsibilities of the selected applicant:**

* Plan, manage and conduct an agreed academic research project and associated activities.
* Test hypotheses and analyse scientific data from a variety of sources, reviewing and refining working hypotheses as appropriate.
* Develop research questions, analyse detailed and complex quantitative data from a variety of sources, and contribute original ideas for new research projects.
* Coordinate multiple aspects of work to deliver novel research data in accordance with established timelines set between you and the Principal Investigator.
* Adapt existing and develop new scientific techniques and experimental protocols to support research.
* Informally present your research to the group at established meeting

**Selection Criteria**

**Essential**

* Documentred research experience in mitochondrial biology.
* Documented experience with cell biology and/or animal physiology approaches to investigate molecular regulators of mitochondrial physiology and metabolism.
* Experience with techniques to profile mitochondrial physiology in vitro and in vivo, including microscopy, respiration assay, and targeted metabolomics.
* Strong analytical skills and experience in statistical analysis and data interpretation.
* The ability to manage your own academic research and associated activities.
* A strong CV, having published in high impact journals and presented at international meetings.
* Ability to contribute ideas for new research projects and research income generation.
* Ability to work with meticulous attention to detail.
* An enthusiastic interest in diabetes research.
* Evidence of excellent interpersonal skills and leadership, with the ability to communicate research ideas and results in a clear and logical way and the ability to confidently and effectively interact with colleagues and the broader research community.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.
* A conscientious and enthusiastic working approach.
* Excellent planning, organizational and problem-solving skills

The Personal Letter (maximum two pages) should explain your relevant experience which may have been gained in employment, education, or you may have taken time away from these activities as illness, military service, work for labour unions or student organisations, parental leave or similar circumstances. Your application will be judged in part on the basis of how you demonstrate that you meet the selection criteria outlined above and we are happy to consider evidence of transferable skills or experience which you may have gained outside the context of paid employment or education.

The Department of Neurobiology, Care Sciences and Society (NVS) conducts world leading research in aging, dementia, epidemiology and care sciences. This research extends from basic molecular and cell levels to clinical research and societal studies. NVS educates almost a third of KI students at basic and advanced levels. The Department has approximately 540 employees and a revenue 2025 of 580 million SEK. It comprises seven divisions, located at Campus Flemingsberg and Campus Solna.

The Division of Clinical Geriatric, with over 200 employed and affiliated researchers are located both in Neo, Campus Flemingsberg and in the Q-building in Solna. We conduct research focusing on cognitive impairment, dementia, and other aging related disorders, and education, among other medical graduates. Our research is multi-faceted and is in close collaboration with leading institutions and clinics worldwide. The research is clinically oriented with an emphasis on diagnosis, prevention and treatment. The division has a close cooperation with the Medical Unit Geriatric Medicine within Theme Inflammation and Aging at Karolinska University Hospital.

**Do you want to contribute to top quality medical research?**
--------------------------------------------------------------

Nordic Brain Network (NBN) is seeking a motivated research assistant to contribute to research on sex differences in dementia and Alzheimer’s disease. You will work under the supervision of Associate Professor Shireen Sindi, who is part of the NBN within the division of Clinical Geriatrics at the Center for Alzheimer Research, Department of Neurobiology, Care science and society (NVS).

The Nordic Brain Network, under the leadership of Professor Miia Kivipelto, conducts research broadly focused on the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of dementia and Alzheimer’s disease. The team is actively engaged in several international collaborations and networks. The majority of this multidisciplinary research team is based at Karolinska Institutet (Q-building in Solna), with additional members at the Karolinska University Hospital, as well as in Finland and the UK.

Within this network, Dr. Sindi conducts research on sex differences in dementia and Alzheimer’s disease, including the underlying biological mechanisms. Her research also focuses on less established risk factors for dementia, such as chronic stress and sleep disturbances.

As part of a project recently funded through the Wellcome Leap CARE programme, her research aims to investigate the associations between hormonal and reproductive factors (e.g., hormonal therapies, reproductive history, and menopause) and Alzheimer’s disease, as well as the underlying mechanisms.

The project will also examine how these hormonal and reproductive factors interact with other dementia risk factors, including sleep disturbances and chronic stress, to influence Alzheimer’s disease risk and progression.

The research will integrate neuroimaging measures, Alzheimer’s disease biomarkers in cerebrospinal fluid and plasma (including amyloid-beta and tau), genetic factors, and other relevant biological markers.

Ultimately, this research aims to improve our understanding of the mechanisms underlying Alzheimer’s disease, enhance the identification of individuals at increased risk of dementia, and inform the development of future personalised and multidomain preventive interventions.

jobs.title: Research assistant in personalised lifestyle consultations within digital health research
jobs.description:
**Do you want to contribute to improving people´s health?**
-----------------------------------------------------------

The IMPACT research group – Marie Löf, Department of Medicine, Huddinge, Karolinska Institutet, consists of 35 people and includes both senior and junior researchers, postdoctoral fellows and doctoral students. This research assistant position will be part of Ioannis Ioakimidis team within the IMPACT research group. The group has more than ten years of experience in developing digital lifestyle interventions (diet and physical activity) for the primary and secondary prevention of obesity and lifestyle-related diseases in children and adults that can be delivered by healthcare. The group also leads several Swedish data collections in large international studies.

We are now recruiting one research assistant for a position focusing on personalised lifestyle consultations, as part of different ongoing RCTs in adults.

### **Your mission**

You will be part of the team running a research study in which participants receive personalised, in-person consultations on diet, physical activity and other key lifestyle parameters, individualized based on algorithmic recommendations, driven by behavioural data collected in real-world settings. Data are being collected using eHealth methodologies. Your main tasks will include:

* Planning and carrying out individual lifestyle consultations with study participants, in Swedish, according to the study protocol
* Taking part in recruiting, screening and scheduling participants
* Collecting data at study visits, for example questionnaires, dietary and physical activity assessments, and body measurements
* Interacting with the dedicated digital platforms (mobile or web-based), in order to extract and evaluate data on different aspects of the study (behavioural, adherence etc)
* Supporting participants’ use of the digital tools in the study and following up the data collected through them
* Documenting your work carefully and helping to manage and quality-check study data
* Taking part in common tasks in the research group and in project meetings with researchers in Sweden and internationally

The position is a fixed-term employment for 6 months and 100% employment with a possible extension. Keep in mind that some consultations may take place outside regular office hours to fit participants’ schedules, so flexibility in work scheduling is going to be appreciated. The position cannot be supported distance or hybrid working.

### **Your profile**

You hold a master’s degree in nutrition, dietetics, physical activity or exercise science, sports science, public health, or another field relevant to lifestyle and health. You must have excellent spoken and written Swedish, documented at least at level C1 (CEFR). Good English is also required, because the group works in an international environment.

Experience in one or more of the following is a merit:

* Individual dietary, physical activity or lifestyle counselling, for example as a licensed dietitian (legitimerad dietist), in health promotion or in healthcare
* Behaviour-change methods such as motivational interviewing
* Data collection in clinical or intervention studies, including body measurements or dietary and physical activity assessments
* Handling of biological samples as part of a research study or clinical practice
* Digital health tools or mobile data collection
* Working with participants from different age groups and backgrounds
* eHealth data analytics
* Systems for electronic data collection and record-keeping (e.g., Redcap)

You are empathetic and communicative, and you find it easy to build trust with the people you meet. You are meticulous and structured, and you can work both independently and as part of a team. We place great importance on the ability to collaborate, flexibility in new situations, and fit with the research team.

Great emphasis will be placed on personal suitability for the position.

### **What do we offer?**

A creative and inspiring environment with wide-ranging expertise and interests. Karolinska Institutet is one of the world's leading medical universities. Our vision is to pursue the development of knowledge about life and to promote a better health for all. At Karolinska Institutet, we conduct successful medical research and hold the largest range of medical education in Sweden. Karolinska Institutet is also a state university, which entitles you to several good benefits through our collective agreement. And you get to practice freely in our modern wellness facilities, where trained staff are on site.

**Location:** Flemingsberg

Choose to work at KI – Ten reasons why

The IMPACT research group

### **Application**

KI applies individual and differentiated salary setting in accordance with our collective agreements RALS and RALS-T.

The application is to be submitted through the Varbi recruitment system.In this recruitment, you will apply with your CV without a personal letter. Instead, you will answer some questions about why you are applying for the job in the application form.

jobs.description:
*Örnsköldsvik, Sweden* Apply until: **7 Dec 2026**

*På Nouryon tar vårt globala team positiva åtgärder varje dag för att nå högre kollektivt och individuellt. Vi skapar innovativa och hållbara lösningar för våra kunder för att möta samhällets behov – idag och i framtiden.*

*Vi söker nu en Laborant / Laboratory Technician till vårt QC-laboratorium i Örnsköldsvik. Vi söker dig som trivs med varierande laboratoriearbete, tar ansvar för kvalitet och säkerhet och uppskattar en roll där du arbetar både självständigt och tillsammans med andra. Låter det som du?*

**Om** **jobbet**
-----------------

Som Laborant blir du en del av vårt QC-laboratorium som ansvarar för kvalitetskontroller av vår egen produkt Bermocoll, leveranser, råvaror, miljöprover och bioreningsprover samt kvalitetskontroll åt externa kunder. Laboratoriet arbetar mot både interna och externa kunder och verksamheten bedrivs i enlighet med våra krav på kvalitet, säkerhet och ackreditering.

Arbetet sker i en miljö där säkerhet är grundläggande och där laboratoriet arbetar enligt relevanta lagkrav och standarder, bland annat ISO 17025, ISO 9001 och ISO 14001.

**I din** **framtida** **roll** **som****Laborant****kommer** **du** **att:**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

* Utföra kvalitetskontroll av vår egen produkt Bermocoll samt kvalitetskontroll åt externa kunder.

* Ansvara för provtagning, analyser, kontroll och rapportering i olika system.

* Utföra bland annat bullermätningar och gaskromatografiska analyser av yttre och inre luftmiljö.

* Delta i utredningar, metodutveckling och lösningsberedning.

* Bidra till laboratoriets kvalitetssäkring och ackrediteringsarbete samt delta vid revisioner.

* Initiera och dokumentera miljöavvikelser och tillbud.

* Medverka vid underhåll, service, kontroll och kalibrering av laboratoriets analysutrustning.

**Vi** **tror****att** **du** **har**
-------------------------------------

* Eftergymnasial utbildning inom kemi, laboratorieteknik, processteknik eller motsvarande, omfattande minst två års studier.

* Goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift.

* Goda kunskaper i engelska, både i tal och skrift.

* God datorvana och förmåga att arbeta i olika digitala system.

**Bra om du** **har**
---------------------

* Erfarenhet av laboratoriearbete.

* Erfarenhet av kvalitetskontroll, provtagning eller kemiska analyser.

* Erfarenhet av arbete enligt kvalitetssystem eller standarder, exempelvis ISO 17025.

**Vi** **tror****att** **du** **är**
------------------------------------

Du arbetar noggrant och strukturerat och tar ansvar för kvaliteten i ditt arbete. Du har lätt för att anpassa dig när förutsättningarna förändras och kan prioritera mellan olika arbetsuppgifter.

Samarbete är en viktig del av rollen och vi tror därför att du trivs med att arbeta tillsammans med andra, samtidigt som du är trygg med att självständigt driva dina arbetsuppgifter framåt. Du har också ett serviceinriktat förhållningssätt och förståelse för både interna och externa kunders behov.

**Vi** **erbjuder** **dig**
---------------------------

Hos oss får du en varierad roll i ett QC-laboratorium där kvalitet, säkerhet och samarbete står i centrum. Du får arbeta med flera olika typer av analyser och provtagningar och samtidigt bidra till utvecklingen och kvalitetssäkringen av laboratoriets verksamhet.

På Nouryon erbjuder vi inte bara en spännande roll och trevliga kollegor utan även förmåner utöver din lön. Nouryon har kollektivavtal med IKEM, men utöver det erbjuder vi även förmåner som bonus, arbetstidsförkortning, friskvårdsbidrag, kostförmån och mycket mer.

**Har vi** **fångat****ditt****intresse****?**
----------------------------------------------

Detta är ett vikariat på cirka 1 år på heltid med placeringsort Örnsköldsvik. Du kommer att rapportera till Laboratoriechef.

Vänligen ansök via vårt rekryteringsverktyg med ett jobbspecifikt CV. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via e-post. När din ansökan nått oss kommer vi att granska för att se om vi har en matchning mellan din kompetens och rollen!

För mer information om vår rekryteringsprocess, vänligen besök: nouryon.com/careers/how-we-hire/

Som sökande kan det bli aktuellt med en bakgrundskontroll innan anställning, beroende på rollens krav. Du kommer att få information om detta senare i rekryteringsprocessen.

Vi arbetar aktivt och strukturerat med HSE-frågor för att skapa en säker och hållbar arbetsmiljö för våra medarbetare. Som anställd kan du därför, vid slumpmässiga tillfällen, komma att genomföra drogtester. Allt för att värna säkerheten och välmåendet för våra anställda.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

**Om Nouryon**
--------------

Om du letar efter ditt nästa steg i karriären, sök idag och gå med i Nouryons globala team för att erbjuda viktiga lösningar som våra kunder använder för att tillverka vardagsprodukter som personlig vård, rengöring, färger och beläggningar, jordbruk och livsmedel, läkemedel och byggprodukter.

Våra anställda drivs av viljan att göra skillnad och aktivt driva positiv förändring. Om det gäller dig, ger vi gärna plats för dina ambitioner. Från dag ett stöttar vi dig i din personliga utveckling, genom utmanande positioner och omfattande möjligheter till lärande och utveckling, i en dynamisk, internationell, mångsidig och proaktiv arbetsmiljö.

**Kontakt**
-----------

För ytterligare information om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Kristina Sundlöf, Laboratoriechef, kristina.sundlof@nouryon.com

För information om rekryteringsprocessen, din ansökan eller om du behöver support, vänligen kontakta Recruiting.SE@Nouryon.com

**För fackliga frågor:**

IF Metall: Niclas Nyberg niclas.nyberg@nouryon.com

**#WeAreNouryon #GrowWithUs**

*Då vi inför denna rekrytering redan tagit ställning till de rekryteringskanaler vi önskar använda undanber vi oss vänligen men bestämt kontakt gällande ytterligare erbjudanden om kompetensförmedling, annonserings- och rekryteringshjä

jobs.title: Laboratory Technician
jobs.description:
**Crane Currency söker en Labtekniker till sitt pappersbruk i Tumba!**
----------------------------------------------------------------------

**Vilka vi är:**  
Crane Currency är ett globalt företag som är ledande inom sedeltillverkning och säkerhetsteknik. Chansen är stor att du redan har vår produkt i din plånbok!  
Vi arbetar med modern utrustning och egenutvecklade program för att använda våra viktigaste tekniker inom detektering och identifiering. Våra kunder världen över litar på oss för att leverera innovativa, pålitliga och högkvalitativa lösningar – precis som vi har gjort i generationer. Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta med spännande teknik i en internationell miljö och bidra till att skapa säkra produkter som används varje dag. Läs mer om oss på: www.cranecurrency.com

**Så här kan du påverka:**
--------------------------

Som laboratorietekniker spelar du en avgörande roll för att säkerställa noggrannhet och tillförlitlighet i testresultaten, vilket direkt påverkar produktens kvalitet och säkerhet. Ditt noggranna arbete med att genomföra experiment och analysera prover hjälper till att upprätthålla höga standarder och efterlevnad av branschregler. Genom att identifiera potentiella problem tidigt förhindrar du kostsamma fel och produktionsförseningar. Din expertis stödjer forsknings- och utvecklingsinsatser, driver innovation och kontinuerlig förbättring.
