jobs.title: Material Testing Lab Technician
jobs.description:
**About Bodycote**

At Bodycote, we’re more than the world’s leading provider of heat treatment and specialist thermal processing services. We’re a people business at heart. Our commitment to innovation and sustainability shapes everything we do. With a global footprint and a culture built on collaboration, curiosity, and continuous improvement, we create an environment where you can grow, contribute, and make a meaningful impact. Sustainability is central to our future. We’re on an ambitious journey to reduce our environmental impact through advanced technologies, smarter processes, and ongoing innovation, with our teams around the world playing a key role in making that happen.

**The Role**

As a Material Testing Lab Technician, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of materials through testing, analysis, and reporting. You will prepare and test material samples, operate and maintain laboratory equipment, and use digital tools to record and evaluate test results.

You will work closely with the Laboratory Manager and cross-functional stakeholders to support quality assurance, product development, and continuous improvement activities. In addition to conducting standardized tests, you will help maintain laboratory equipment, contribute to the accuracy and integrity of laboratory data, and ensure that all work is carried out in accordance with established safety and quality standards.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys practical laboratory work, has a keen eye for detail, and takes pride in producing accurate and reliable results.

**Responsibilities**

* Sample Preparation: Collect, handle, and prepare physical samples for testing.
* Conducting Tests: Perform standardized physical, mechanical, and minor chemical tests (e.g., strength, hardness, density, and corrosion properties) using digital tools and laboratory machinery.
* Equipment Maintenance: Clean, maintain, and calibrate testing devices regularly to ensure accuracy.
* Data Analysis & Reporting: Record test results, analyze data for compliance or failure causes, and draft technical reports.
* Safety Compliance: Follow strict laboratory safety protocols and wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE).

**Who We’re Looking For**

We’re looking for someone who brings:

* A technical high school diploma or similar
* Experience in materials testing and laboratory testing within the metals or manufacturing industry.
* Familiarity of relevant standards and quality requirements, including ISO 9001 and ISO 17025.
* Excellent ability to document, analyse and report technical results.
* Good command of both Swedish and English, verbally and in writing.
* Basic math and computer proficiency

**What’s In It for You**

* Career progression opportunities within a global business
* Exposure to operational development and continuous improvement initiatives
* A supportive, inclusive culture where your growth and development matter
* The opportunity to play a key role in daily operations and team performance
* Competitive salary and benefits package

**Location & Work Pattern**

This role is a full time, permanent position based in **Västerås**, with onsite expectations. Some travel may be required depending on business needs.

**Ready to Apply?**

If you’re ready to join Bodycote and make a real impact, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and start your journey with us.

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered regardless of characteristics protected by local law, including (where applicable) gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, religion or belief, and ethnic origin. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment.

jobs.title: Research Scientist - L21
jobs.description:
### **General Information**

**Locations**: Stockholm, Stockholm County, Sweden

Role ID

216099

Worker Type

Regular Employee

Studio/Department

Other

Work Model

Hybrid

### **Description & Requirements**

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

At EA, we believe games are powerful because they bring together multiple ways people engage: play, watch, create, and connect.

Creator-made content is already a part of EA's history — from community creation tools in Battlefield to The Gallery in The Sims 4. We believe creative technologies will expand how players engage with and contribute to our experiences, supported by thoughtful product design, safety systems, and global reach. Our focus is on helping more players participate in creative expression by making creation easier, safer, and more rewarding.

We are looking for a **Research Scientist** to create the next generation of *game AI in interactive entertainment*. Our work centers on the latest technologies, including *Reinforcement Learning, Language Models,* and *Imitation Learning*. The team works directly in game engines to develop agent solutions today, while also advancing our long-term goal of developing the next generation of interactive and reasoning agents for players. The team has a track record, having deployed machine learning (ML) agents in FC26 and testing ML agents for the Battlefield franchise. This is an applied role, and you will translate your ideas into functional demonstrations (e.g., demos) to guide innovation in a very practical way.

This is a hybrid remote/in-office role: 3 days/week at our EA office in Stockholm, Sweden.

You will report to our Director of Research.

**Responsibilities**

  

* **Develop novel ideas** by researching and implementing solutions to some of the most complex challenges in video game AI.
  
* **Contribute to applied research** in areas such as Language Models, Reinforcement Learning, and reasoning. This includes proposing new use cases and algorithms for player-facing game AI agents, while targeting real-time, on-device performance.
  
* **Build compelling demos** that highlight novel applications of AI agents, NPC behaviors, and game AI bots, with a focus on integration into modern game engine technologies.
  
* **Scientific Leadership:** Share your impact by publishing your work in peer-reviewed conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR), contributing to open-source, and speaking at industry events.
  

**Qualifications**

  

* **Advanced Research Background:** 7+ years of experience, with a degree in Computer Science, a STEM field, or equivalent practical experience related to game AI.
  
* **Agents related technology expertise:** Experience with Language Models (LMs), Reinforcement Learning, and Imitation Learning.
  
* **Practical experience:** Experience turning ideas into functional prototypes or demos that showcase concepts in practice.
  
* **Programming Proficiency:** Excellent programming abilities in Python and ML frameworks (PyTorch or TensorFlow), alongside experience in C++ for real-time systems. Experience with AAA game engines (e.g., Unity, Unreal, Godot, Frostbite, or proprietary).

  
  

***About Electronic Arts***

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

  

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

  

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

jobs.title: Research Scientist
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on research scientist with deep expertise in medical imaging and strong technical skills in programming, data analytics and AI?

Do you enjoy combining scientific research with practical technical development, taking ownership and driving complex research collaborations towards successful outcomes?

Collective Minds is looking for a Research Scientist to drive scientific and technical contributions in public and private research consortia. This is an opportunity to combine research, technology and project ownership in a growing international healthtech company.

**About Collective Minds**
--------------------------

Collective Minds is based in Stockholm/Danderyd and we operate globally across clinical trials and life sciences. We are an imaging platform for clinical trials that connects hospitals, experts, and industry - including CROs, pharma, biotech, medtech, and eClinical vendors - enabling trials with imaging endpoints and the generation of high-quality evidence faster and more efficiently. We are a fast-moving, commercially minded team focused on collaboration, accountability, and impact. By combining deep domain expertise in medical imaging with novel cloud technology, we help customers reduce risk, ensure compliance, accelerate and scale research.

**About the role**
------------------

As Research Scientist, you will combine scientific expertise in medical imaging with hands-on technical development and ownership of selected research consortia.

Collective Minds currently participates in more than 10 public and private research consortia spanning medical imaging, big data, analytics and AI modeling and validation. These collaborations bring together academic hospitals, research organizations and industry partners across therapeutic areas such as oncology, immunology, cardiovascular and musculoskeletal research.

Acting as a data manager and platform provider, Collective Minds plays a central role in these collaborations. You will be responsible for our contributions in two to three consortia, with the opportunity to apply your scientific and technical expertise, work independently and contribute to impactful research.

*Your main responsibilities:*

* Lead Collective Minds' contributions in selected research consortia, ensuring delivery within agreed budgets, timelines and scope.
* Develop and implement technical solutions, including scripts, data pipelines, analytical tools, dashboards and AI-based applications.
* Make scientific and technical decisions across medical imaging, data analytics, AI modeling and validation.
* Ensure effective use of the Collective Minds platform, prioritizing standardized and scalable solutions over unnecessary custom development.
* Manage project scope and stakeholder expectations, clearly defining deliverables and commitments.
* Take ownership of work package delivery, reporting to consortium partners, coordinators and funders, and efficient project close-outs.
* Collaborate with internal teams and external research partners, coordinating additional resources when needed.

**Who are we looking for?**
---------------------------

We are looking for a scientifically experienced and technically skilled professional who combines deep expertise in medical imaging with the ability to independently develop solutions and deliver complex research projects.

You are analytical, pragmatic and hands-on, with a proactive approach to problem-solving. You enjoy taking ownership, collaborating across disciplines and driving results in a fast-moving environment.

*We believe you have:*

* A strong scientific background in life sciences, medicine, biomedical engineering or a related field, with deep expertise in medical imaging research.
* Strong hands-on technical skills in Python, SQL, DICOM and AI frameworks, with experience developing scripts, data tools and analytical solutions. Familiarity with dashboarding tools such as Superset or Metabase is a plus.
* Experience delivering work packages in research consortia or grant-funded projects, including grant execution, reporting and project close-outs.
* A proven ability to independently manage research projects within agreed budgets, timelines and scope, and make informed scientific and technical decisions.
* Experience coordinating work across academic, clinical and industry partners, with strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
* Willingness to travel internationally as required, typically approximately every two months.
* Ability to work regularly from our Stockholm/Danderyd office.

**Why join Collective Minds?**
------------------------------

At Collective Minds, you will join an innovative and ambitious company where technology, science and collaboration come together to make a meaningful difference in healthcare.

You will be part of an entrepreneurial environment with short decision-making processes, engaged colleagues and the opportunity to influence how things are done.

This is an opportunity to work with leading scientific and industry partners, contribute to innovative research collaborations and play an important role in the continued growth of an international healthtech company.

**We look forward to receiving your application!**
--------------------------------------------------

We believe in a transparent and engaging recruitment process that gives both sides the opportunity to get to know each other. The process typically includes:

* Discovery call with recruiter
* Hiring manager interview
* Case study
* Leadership/ stakeholder talk
* Reference checks

If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, please contact Lotta Modin Jakobsson at lotta.modin@cmrad.com or +46 70 330 11 30.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Do you want to furnish the future with innovative solutions?

With us, you can feel at home in your work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, discover new tech possibilities, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our Data Analyst, you'll have many opportunities to try things you've never done before.

IKEA Supply is responsible for the supply chain strategy, supply planning and logistics services that ensure IKEA products are available to customers around the world in a cost efficient, sustainable way. Every day, we strive to make our supply chain smarter, faster and more resilient.

You will belong to the Supply Data & Analytics team, reporting to the Data & Analytics Manager. We are enabling data democratisation through scalable self-service capabilities and AI enablement, while ensuring high quality, timely and cost efficient data solutions that support IKEA Supply in making more informed and effective business decisions.

Our Analyst team is based in Älmhult. We believe that your presence with the team and working the majority of the time in the workplace is important.

 **Job Description**

As a Data Analyst, you'll play an important part in the team and bring valuable IKEA and supply chain knowledge into a new setting. The Data Analyst function supports the transformation of IKEA Supply into a more data driven organisation by extracting and sharing deep insights from complex internal and external data sources. It enables cross functional data product teams to make evidence-based decisions through advanced data exploration, analysis, visualisation, performance measurement and hypothesis testing, ultimately improving supply chain performance and delivering a better customer experience. The impact of our work continues to resonate in homes and hearts across the world.

On a typical working day, you will:

* Understand business requirements in depth and work closely with the product team to interpret and enhance them, shaping how the data products should be designed and delivered.
* Ensure and promote data informed decision making to improve business performance, working within cross functional data product teams.
* Ensure solutions continuously deliver value to IKEA Supply by working closely with stakeholders across different functions and adapting to evolving business needs.
* Evaluate the usability and potential of structured internal and external data sources for product analytics and data driven decision making.
* Write complex SQL queries to extract, transform and load data as part of robust data processing pipelines, using joins, nesting and advanced operations.
* Conduct advanced data exploration and analysis using modern data mining techniques (including machine learning) and visualisation tools to generate actionable insights.
* Build and maintain scalable analytics and insight products in Power BI, translating business needs into technical requirements and compelling data stories.
* Apply AI assisted tools (for example Copilot style coding assistants and agent-based workflows) to accelerate SQL development, automate data quality checks, and review and validate code, while using good judgement on when and how to use them responsibly.
* Promote agile ways of working, performance measurement, hypothesis testing and OKRs.

  
**Qualifications**

What we'd like you to bring to the table

The role as a Data Analyst requires you to have:

* A bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science or a related quantitative field; an advanced degree is preferred.
* 4+ years' experience as a Data Analyst or in a similar role, ideally within a supply chain, logistics or manufacturing environment.
* A strong ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical requirements, helping product teams interpret needs and design fit for purpose solutions.
* Expertise in building scalable visualisation products (for example Power BI), with a good ability to translate business needs into actionable data solutions and storytelling driven dashboards.
* Advanced proficiency in SQL, including use of notebook environments to analyse data, share insights and enable reproducible workflows. Ability to read and understand object orientated programming languages (ideally Python & Pyspark) is also a requirement.
* A strong understanding of data mining techniques and data exploration across large datasets to support decision making and uncover business opportunities.
* A solid foundation in probability and statistics, including hypothesis testing and experimental design (for example A/B testing) to validate business hypotheses.
* Experience with data engineering concepts and end to end data pipelines, with the ability to understand the full lifecycle from raw data sources to business insight (for example cloud data platforms such as Databricks and modelling with dbt).
* Familiarity with collaborative software engineering practices (Agile, DevOps, version control) and data product development principles focused on iterative delivery and continuous improvement.
* Working knowledge of AI powered development tools and coding agents (for example GitHub Copilot or equivalents) for writing, reviewing and validating code, with an understanding of their capabilities, limitations and responsible use in a data governance context.

It's a plus if you also:

* Have experience shipping data products at scale in a large enterprise or complex matrixed organisation.
* Have experience partnering with Data & Digital Product Leaders (or equivalent)
* Have applied generative AI or agent based workflows to automate data analysis, testing or documentation.

  
**Additional Information**

We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity.

**This team is located in Älm

jobs.title: Data Analyst & Steward
jobs.description:
Scope and Impact You are an autonomous contributor holding end-to-end stewardship accountability for an assigned scope, on behalf of the business owners of that data. You balance stewardship responsibilities, analytics delivery, and self-service enablement while maximizing business value from data through trusted metrics, high-quality data products, and adoption of analytical solutions. You may sit within a regional IT organization or directly within the business domain, depending on structure. As a domain resource, you receive governance standards, tooling, and escalation support from the central Data & AI Governance function, Global Data & AI Platform team and the visualization engineering CoE.
  
  
What you do Metrics & Data Products Align existing and new metric definitions across teams so everyone works from the same numbers. Curate metric definitions, metadata, and the semantic layer so they're reliable enough for AI agents to answer business questions directly, not just for human dashboard users. Act as Data Steward for all data products within your assigned sub-domain. Monitor and improve data quality through controls and remediation activities, elevating data quality and data management from source to the analytical layer.
  
  
Maintain metadata, data lineage, business glossaries, and ownership information within the enterprise data catalog. Track and demonstrate the business value and ROI realized from the data products you steward, using this evidence to prioritize improvements or retirement. Partner with Data Engineers to define the semantic layer in the global data and AI platform and understand how they built data models and pipelines. Review and coordinate data access approvals and stewardship workflows in accordance with governance policies and business ownership responsibilities.
  
  
Analytical Solutions Support business stakeholders with complex, non-standard analytical questions that go beyond self-service, applying analytical rigor to validate findings before they inform decisions. Drive adoption of self-service analytics developed with data engineers. Build and maintain complex dashboards and analytical solutions. Validate that self-service and analytical outputs remain accurate when consumed by AI agents, not only by human users.
  
  
Data Literacy Take ownership for growing data literacy within your sub-domain. Train and support business users on self-service analytics solutions AI-readiness & Ways of Working Proactively automates routine parts of their own workflow (quality checks, documentation updates, recurring reporting) using agentic AI, and prototypes solutions live with business stakeholders using AI instead of running a traditional multi-week build cycle. Where you will be This is a full-time position based in Electrolux Group's headquarters in Stockholm in the Stadshagen district of Kungsholmen. We offer 20% workplace flexibility, while maintaining the collaboration, connectivity, and team spirit that come from working together at our Global Headquarters.
  
  
With more than 60 nationalities under one roof, you will be part of a dynamic international environment where English is the common language and diversity is part of everyday life. Benefits highlights Generous vacation allowance and a range of family-friendly benefits, including extended paternity leave. Comprehensive insurance coverage. Discounts on our award-winning Electrolux products and services.
  
  
Extensive learning and development opportunities, with flexible career paths. Access to in-house sports facilities. As part of Electrolux, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you.

jobs.title: Data Analyst (Early Careers)
jobs.description:
Job Overview
  
  
**About the Role:**  
This entry-level role is your chance to turn raw data into critical insights that guide decision-making across our entire organisation. You'll collaborate directly with Sales, Product Owners, and Senior Management and others, gaining exposure to a wide range of business functions.
  
We are looking for a motivated, collaborative, kind, and humble individual to join our team. You'll get hands-on with our modern data stack—think GCP, BigQuery, DBT, and Airflow—to build robust data solutions. This is more than just running queries; you'll help teams define their data needs and build the data models and Looker dashboards that answer their most pressing questions.
  
For a recent graduate, this is a unique opportunity to apply your knowledge, master in-demand technologies, and see your work make a tangible impact. We foster a collaborative environment where you'll be encouraged to learn, communicate effectively, and leverage our AI-assisted development workflow to enhance analysis and build solutions more efficiently.
  
  
**Responsibilities and impact:**  
OSTTRA has the largest financial institutions in the world as clients. **Our approach is built on three core pillars:**

jobs.title: Research Assistant in Nanopore sequencing and DNA methylation
jobs.description:
Do you want to work with Nanopore sequencing and DNA methylation? And do you see yourself as a team player who is strong in collaboration? If yes, we look forward to reading your application to our position as Research Assistant.

At the Faculty of Engineering and Science, Department of Chemistry and Bioscience, a position as Research Assistant in Nanopore sequencing and DNA methylation is open for appointment from 1st of January 2027 or soon hereafter. The position is available for one year.  
  
**Your work tasks**  
You will develop new bioinformatic algorithms for the detection and analysis of DNA methylation motifs in Oxford Nanopore sequencing data and apply these methods to a range of tasks related to metagenomics. Your work will include the development, implementation, testing, and evaluation of computational methods as well as the analysis and interpretation of sequencing data.

You will contribute to the ongoing research activities within the group and collaborate with colleagues on relevant bioinformatics and metagenomics projects. In addition, minor contributions to teaching, supervision, knowledge sharing, and outreach activities may be expected.

**Your competencies**  
Extensive experience with development of workflows for large-scale metagenome methylation data. This includes hands-on experience with library preparation and sequencing of Oxford Nanopore data and development of bioinformatic tools and packages related to methylation analysis.

* A master's degree, in Biotechnology or Bioinformatics
* Excellent oral and written English language skills are a requirement
* The applicant must be interested in working in an interdisciplinary research environment.

**Qualification requirements**  
Appointment as a research assistant requires academic qualifications at master's degree level.

If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

jobs.title: Laboratory Technician in the Plant Section of the Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics
jobs.description:
The Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics at the innovative Universitetsbyen invites applications for a dedicated laboratory technician. Join our inclusive laboratory and contribute meaningfully as a core member of a research team, mentored by Professor Simona Radutoiu.

We are at the forefront of researching plant-bacterial symbiosis with the goal of unlocking the full potential of both plants and bacteria to foster sustainable and climate-friendly agricultural practices. Our research is funded by ambitious programs, and our team consists of dedicated scientists and students committed to advancing knowledge and achieving project goals efficiently. Our research focuses on understanding the intricate interactions between plants and bacterial communities is pivotal in current research and agricultural needs.

  

### **Expected start date and duration of employment**

This is a fixed-term position to start on 1 February 2027 and end on 30 September 2028.

  

### **Job description**

The laboratories within the Plant Molecular Biology section conduct analyses of experimental plants interacting with various soil bacteria or beneficial fungi, supporting research projects focused on plant genetics and plant responses to microbes.

These analyses include, among other things, DNA and RNA analysis (via amplification and sequencing), the assessment of physiological responses in plants and microbes, and the microscopy of plant cells and organs.

Key responsibilities will include:

* Preparing and conducting experiments in accordance with research hypotheses and objectives.
* Preparing samples from plants and microbes.
* Performing various analyses on samples using DNA/RNA techniques or microscopy.
* Maintaining and operating laboratory equipment and facilities.
* Tasks related to the local work environment, including the preparation of workplace instructions and chemical risk assessments, as well as the labeling of chemicals.
* Updating and maintaining the department’s databases.
* Providing support to postdocs, students, and visiting researchers.

We are a large, international section with a wide variety of tasks; consequently, the actual duties may vary from those listed above.

  

### **Your profile**

Our ideal candidate:

* Has completed a laboratory technician education (laborant in Danish).
* Has strong experience in molecular biology.
* Has experience with plant research and plant tissue culture.
* Has experience preparing and handling synthetic microbial communities (SynComs) or multi-strain microbial experiments.
* Is proficient in molecular biology techniques such as DNA extraction, PCR, qPCR, gel electrophoresis, and sample preparation for sequencing.
* Can independently design and execute research projects that require care, attention to details and careful observations.
* Is curious, systematic, and thrives in a collaborative, international environment.
* Wants to contribute to cutting-edge plant-bacterial interaction research.
* Can handle complex tasks and maintains overview during periods of intense activities.
* Can assist with data entry and laboratory database maintenance.
* Can manage laboratory inventory, coordinate supply orders, and handle basic purchasing tasks.
* Communicates effectively in English (the working language of our group).
* Has a driving license (min. category B) – preferred.

This position is perfect for someone who enjoys both hands-on lab work and maintaining a well-functioning research environment. If you're passionate about science, enjoy working in a team, and are ready to take on a variety of tasks, we encourage you to apply!

  

### **Who we are**

The Plant Molecular Biology section's activities focus on genetic, molecular and biochemical research in the model plant Lotus japonicus as well as several crop plants such as cassava, barley, maize, and wheat.

The research seeks to elucidate and understand the mechanisms behind genetic control of signal transduction, cell differentiation, developmental processes, local adaptation and plant-microbe interactions. Key research areas include symbiotic nitrogen fixation, plant perception of microbial signaling molecules, susceptibility to pathogens and colonization by symbiotic and endophytic bacteria/fungi.

  

### **What we offer**

The research at the Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics (MBG) at Aarhus University spans from basic to applied research within molecular biology. The department is organised in six research sections (Plant Molecular Biology, Bioinformatics, Neurobiology, RNA Biology and Innovation, Protein Science and Cellular Health, Intervention and Nutrition), a number of centres of excellence and various interdisciplinary centres.

Here, you can:

* Be part of a lively and engaging research environment.
* Work with a large international research network.
* Gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge plant molecular biology research.
* Engage in a mix of specialized research tasks and routine activities suited to your learning path.
* Develop project professional skills through coordinating lab logistics and vendor relationships.
* Collaborate across research groups, building valuable professional connections and expanding your institutional knowledge.
  

### **Place of work and area of employment**

The place of work is Universitetsbyen 81, 8000 Aarhus C, Denmark. The area of employment is Aarhus University with affiliated institutions.

  

### **Contact information**

For further information, please contact Professor Simona Radutoiu, radutoiu@mbg.au.dk

  

### **Deadline**

Applications must be received no later than 7 December 2026.

  

### **Formalities and salary range**

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Union of Commercial and Clerical Employees in Denmark/State (HK/Stat) for clerical staff, laboratory technicians and IT employees and the joint collective agreement concluded between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Or

jobs.title: Project coordinator, Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics, Aarhus University
jobs.description:
Applications are invited for a two-year, fixed-term position as Project Coordinator in Professor Daan van Aalten’s research group at the Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics, Aarhus University.

  

### **Expected start date and duration of employment**

This is a two-year position, starting on 15 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The working hours are 30 hours per week.

  

### **Job description**

As Project Coordinator, you will support Professor Daan van Aalten’s research group and its externally funded projects at the Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics, Aarhus University.

Your main tasks will be to:

* Coordinate the administration of an international research project with the University of Aberdeen and the Telethon Institute of Genetics and Medicine (TIGEM) in Pozzuoli, Italy. This includes arranging partner meetings and following up on agreed actions and deadlines.
* Assist researchers with organizing and structuring research data, including patient data received from collaborators at TIGEM.
* Support grant applications and prepare and update project budgets, including staff costs, employment periods and overheads.
* Keep project documentation up to date and work with AU finance and research support staff on budget changes and reporting requirements.
* Support recruitment and contract extensions in cooperation with HR, and coordinate practical arrangements when researchers, students and visiting staff join or leave the group, including AU access, introductions and handovers.
* Organize group meetings, workshops and retreats, and arrange visits by collaborators and prospective group members.
* Prepare and update internal guides and onboarding materials, including information about group contacts, equipment responsibilities and practical laboratory routines.
* Prepare staff surveys and follow up on feedback about communication, working routines and the working environment.

You will also help group members with AU administrative systems and procedures, put them in contact with the relevant university services and handle other administrative tasks as needed.

  

### **Your profile**

Applicants must hold a master’s degree or equivalent qualification. A PhD is an advantage, particularly in relation to working in an academic research environment.

We are looking for a proactive, well-organized colleague with good communication skills. You should be able to work independently, prioritize your tasks and keep track of deadlines.

Experience with research administration, grant applications and project budgets, including staff costs and overheads, is an advantage. Knowledge of university HR and finance procedures and experience with recruitment support and onboarding would also be useful.

You should be fluent in written and spoken Danish and English and enjoy working with researchers, students and administrative staff. Knowledge of Italian is an advantage when working with colleagues at TIGEM.

  

### **Who we are**

The Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics is part of the Faculty of Natural Sciences, Aarhus University and comprises research within the areas of Plant Molecular Biology, Neurobiology, RNA Biology and Innovation, Protein Science,

Cellular Health, Intervention and Nutrition. There are currently 75 full-time scientific staff and 95 PhD students. The department is responsible for two educations: Molecular Biology and Molecular Medicine with a yearly uptake of 160 students in total.

Please refer to http://mbg.au.dk/ for further information about The Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics and to https://nat.au.dk/ and http://www.au.dk/ for information on Faculty of Natural Sciences and Aarhus University, respectively.

  

### **What we offer**

We offer a varied administrative role in an international research environment, with close collaboration with researchers, students and university administrative staff. The position provides opportunities to develop experience in research administration, grant support and project coordination, and to contribute to the organization and working environment of the research group.

  

### **Place of work and area of employment**

The place of work is at Universitetsbyen 81, 8000 Aarhus C, and the area of employment is Aarhus University with affiliated institutions.

  

### **Contact information**

For further information, please contact: Professor Daan van Aalten, +45 93 58 82 72, daan@au.dk

  

### **Deadline**

Applications must be received no later than 26 November 2026.

  

### **Formalities and salary range**

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions. You will be employed as an Administrator (fuldmægtig) with an availability allowance on basic salary grades 4–8.
  
  
Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.
  
  
*The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.*

jobs.title: One or more Assistant Professors in Molecular biology, Cellular biology, or Genetics
jobs.description:
At the Faculty of Medicine, Department of Health Science and Technology, one or more positions as Assistant Professor in molecular biology, cellular biology, or genetics are open for appointment from March 1. 2027, or soon thereafter.

The employment will be for a 3-years period.

About the Department of Health Science and Technology

The Department of Health Science and Technology (HST) at Aalborg University is an interdisciplinary research and teaching environment where engineering, medicine and health sciences come together to improve people's lives.

Our research spans biomedical engineering, medicine, neuroscience, rehabilitation, digital health, robotics, sports science, physiotherapy and public health. Working closely with hospitals, industry and public-sector partners, we develop knowledge and technologies that address major health challenges and contribute to better healthcare for society.

As part of the Faculty of Medicine, HST contributes to advancing research and education within digital health through close collaboration between clinicians, engineers and health professionals. We offer an ambitious international research environment with excellent opportunities for interdisciplinary collaboration, external partnerships and access to state-of-the-art research facilities.

The department is home to approximately 180 academic staff members, around 100 PhD fellows and more than 1,700 students across bachelor's, master's and postgraduate programmes.

At HST, you will join a collaborative community where curiosity, innovation and knowledge sharing are valued. Guided by our values – Share. Care. Dare. – we work together to create research and education that make a meaningful difference to people's lives.

Learn more about the department on our web page, and our researchers and divisions in our research portal.

**Job description:**  
The successful candidate will join the Department of Health Science and Technology and contribute to research within biomedical sciences related to human health and disease.

We welcome applicants with a strong research profile in one or more of the following areas:

* Molecular biology
* Cell biology
* Genetics and genomics
* Molecular mechanisms of disease
* Gene regulation and cellular signalling
* Experimental biomedical sciences
* Translational biomedical research

Applicants should have experience with laboratory-based research and wet-lab methodologies relevant to the study of human physiology, pathophysiology, and disease mechanisms. The successful candidate is expected to establish and develop a research profile that complements and strengthens the existing activities within the department while contributing to interdisciplinary collaborations across health science, medicine, and biomedical research.

**Teaching responsibilities:**  
The position includes teaching and supervision primarily within the Bachelor's and Master's programmes in Medicine and Medicine with Industrial Specialisation (MedIS). The position is 50% teaching and 50% research time.

Teaching activities are expected to include:

* Case-based teaching within biomedical and medical sciences at the bachelor's level.
* Supervision of student projects, particularly on the 4th semester bachelor, where students conduct experimental laboratory-based projects in the wet laboratories.
* Teaching, supervision, and examination within courses related to molecular biology, cell biology, genetics, physiology, pathophysiology, and related biomedical disciplines.
* Contributing to the continued development of teaching activities within Aalborg University's problem-based learning (PBL) framework.

As most teaching activities at the bachelor's level are conducted in Danish, proficiency in Danish is considered an advantage, but not a requirement.

**Qualifications:**  
Applicants must hold a PhD degree in Biomedicine, Molecular Medicine, Molecular Biology, Cell Biology, Genetics, Biomedical Sciences, or a closely related field.

The ideal candidate will:

* Engage actively in teaching, supervision, and curriculum development.
* Conduct research of high international quality.
* Contribute to the development of the Biomedicine section's research activities.

jobs.title: Research Assistant in Marine Taxonomy
jobs.description:
Do you have a sharp eye for marine species and want to put your taxonomic skills to work in both research and national monitoring? The Department of Ecoscience at Aarhus University, Denmark, invites applications for a 2-year position as research assistant in marine taxonomy, focusing on phytoplankton, macroalgae and benthic fauna. The place of work is Aarhus, and the position starts on 1 January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

  

### **Expected start date and duration of employment**

This is a 2-year fixed-term position from 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

### **Job description**

Taxonomic expertise is the foundation of reliable knowledge about marine biodiversity, and of the monitoring that Danish authorities use to assess the state of the marine environment. You will help maintain and develop the department's taxonomic expertise and link it to new methods such as eDNA, ROV-based surveys and model-ling. Your tasks will include:

* Identification and quantification of phytoplankton, macroalgae and benthic fauna in samples from field surveys and monitoring programmes
* Data management, quality assurance and reporting as part of the department's advisory work for the Danish Environmental Protection Agency
* Contributing to research projects on marine biodiversity, e.g. in cultivated seaweed

You will work in close collaboration with experienced taxonomists and researchers at the Department of Ecoscience.

### **Your profile**

Applicants should hold a Master's degree in biology, marine biology or a related field. We expect that you have:

* Documented experience in identifying marine organisms, preferably within phytoplankton, macroalgae and/or benthic fauna
* Experience with marine field work
* Experience with laboratory work and good laboratory practice
* Experience with data handling, quality assurance and reporting
* Good English skills, written and oral
* A structured and careful approach to your work and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team

It will be an advantage if you have:

* Experience with national monitoring programmes, e.g. NOVANA
* Experience with molecular methods such as eDNA, or with ROV or other image-based survey methods
* Skills in data analysis, e.g. in R
* An interest in research-based advice to authorities

### **Who we are**

The Department of Ecoscience conducts national and international research and advisory projects covering all major subdisciplines within marine, freshwater and terrestrial ecology. The department is a recognised authority in research-based advice to Danish authorities and is responsible for large parts of the national monitoring of the marine environment. We are currently about 340 employees.

You will join the Section for Marine Ecology.

### **What we offer**

The department offers:

* the opportunity to work with experienced taxonomists and to develop your skills within both classic and new methods
* a combination of field work, laboratory work, research and advice to authorities
* a well-developed research infrastructure, laboratories and access to shared equipment
* a work environment with close working relationships, networking and social activities
* a workplace characterised by professionalism, equality and a healthy work-life balance.

### **Place of work and area of employment**

The place of work is Aarhus University, C.F. Møllers Allé 3, 8000 Aarhus C, Denmark, and the area of employ-ment is Aarhus University with related departments.

### **Contact information**

For further information, please contact: Head of Section, Annette Bruhn, +45 2963 8034, anbe@ecos.au.dk.

### **Deadline**

Applications must be received no later than Tuesday 1 December 2026.

### **Application procedure**

Short-listing is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the assessment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. The selection is made on the basis of an assessment of who of the candidates are most relevant considering the requirements of the advertisement. All applicants will be notified within 6 weeks whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee and will receive his/her assessment.

### **Formalities and salary range**

Natural Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.
  
  
The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.
  
  
Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.
  
  
Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.
  
  
Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.
  
  
*The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.*

**Research Assistant with opportunity for PhD-fellowship continuation at the Department of Biomedical Sciences, Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, NNF Center of Stem Cell Medicine (reNEW), University of Copenhagen**

The Friesen group is looking for a motivated research assistant (RA) with experience in mammalian cell culture starting on January 15, 2027 (or after agreement). The successful candidate will have the opportunity to transition into a funded PhD position, pending evaluation and mutual agreement.

**About us**

The newly established Friesen lab aims to understand, treat and prevent metabolic disease. We want to explore how a cell transitions from a healthy state to insulin resistance to type 2 diabetes and to reverse this process. Our group leverages human pluripotent stem cell (hPSC)-derived in vitro disease models that accurately represent the in vivo cell state. We study the molecular underpinnings of metabolism and insulin signaling in a variety of cell types, improving in vitro hPSC-derived metabolic disease models, and applying these for translational research.

**Your role**

You will initially work on one or multiple projects involving the establishment of our hPSC-derived metabolic disease models, genome editing of hPSC tool cell lines including reporter lines, setup optimization of translational screening experiments, and analysis of existing and new -omics data.

After the initial RA period of 12 months and upon positive evaluation and mutual agreement, you will get the opportunity to transition into a funded 3-year PhD position. At this point, we will decide together on a focused PhD project based on your interest and the preliminary data acquired during the RA period. As a founding team member in a new lab, you will have a hand in shaping the lab’s culture and research direction. You will have early ownership of projects in the lab and help set up systems that enable the future success of our group.

**Profile**

Essential experience and skills:

* You have a MSc degree in biology, biomedicine, biochemistry, or similar
* Experience with human cell culture
* An interest in fundamental or translational research, including disease mechanisms, hPSC biology, and metabolic disease
* Demonstrated wet-lab experience
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively
* Good interpersonal and communication skills in English
* High level of intrinsic motivation, responsibility, and reliability
* Enjoyment of international and diverse work environments

Desirable experience and skills:

* You have experience with hPSC culture
* You have experience with genome editing and related molecular/cell biology techniques
* You have experience with or an aptitude for bioinformatic analysis

NNF Center of Stem Cell Medicine (reNEW), University of Copenhagen.

Candidates from abroad may be eligible to reduced tax payment, according to the Special Tax Scheme for Researchers. More information about this can be found here: Tax – University of Copenhagen

jobs.title: Research Assistant in Learning Design
jobs.description:
The **Center for Industrial Software** **(CIS)** at the **Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute** **, University of Southern Denmark** , invites applications for a **Research Assistant position** . The position is based at SDU’s campus in Sønderborg and is available from **March 1, 2027,** or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is for 12 months.

The position is funded by the **Novo Nordisk Foundation** and is part of **PREPARE — Pedagogical Alignment for Responsible AI in Software Engineering Education** , a joint project between SDU and the IT University of Copenhagen (ITU).

CIS is a young but fast-growing unit whose research groups span cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, embedded systems, and software engineering. Our students and staff come from Denmark, the rest of the EU, and beyond, and our working language is English.

**About the position**

Generative AI has arrived in our classrooms faster than our pedagogy has adapted to it. Students increasingly delegate the very things we are trying to teach them — verification, trade-off reasoning, judgment, accountability — to tools whose reasoning they cannot inspect. Most institutional responses so far have been restrictions or isolated policies, and neither addresses the underlying problem. This project takes the opposite route: if AI is here to stay in software engineering practice, responsible AI use should be deliberately taught, practiced, and assessed.

This position sits where those ideas become things people can actually use. You will take responsibility for designing and creating content — reusable set of pedagogical modules that instructors can adopt without redesigning a whole course — and for the hands-on work of redesigning selected software engineering courses at SDU. The project’s research produces findings; this role turns them into activities, materials, rubrics, and guidance that survive contact with a real semester. Implementation is iterative rather than one-shot. Modules go into classrooms, evidence comes back through classroom interventions, surveys, artifact analysis, and educator feedback, and the next version is better for it. If you like building educational material and watching it improve under real use — and you would rather serve teaching than only write about it — this is a role with unusually visible results. **Responsibility and opportunities**

Concretely, you can expect to:

* **Design and produce reusable pedagogical modules** — guided scenarios, reflection and verification activities, assessment tasks, rubrics, and instructor guidance — that courses can adopt on demand.
* **Redesign selected SE courses at SDU.** Work with course responsibles and programme leaders to rework intended learning outcomes, activities, and assessment so that responsible AI use is explicitly taught and examined.
* Coordinate classroom deployments across semesters, keeping instructors supported and the logistics from eating the pedagogy.
* **Gather and act on evidence.** Administer surveys, analyze student artifacts (decision notes, verification evidence, reflections), collect structured educator feedback, and feed it into the next iteration.
* **Document and release.** Maintain the toolkit as open, well-documented material others can pick up after the project ends, and contribute to project reporting and publications.

**Required scientific qualifications**

* A master’s degree, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree, on Game Development and Learning Technology, Design and Interaction, Educational Technology, Media and Communication, or a closely related field. The degree must be completed before the starting date — this is a firm requirement.

**Qualifications** **Required**

* Demonstrated experience creating educational content — course materials, learning modules, exercises, assessment tasks, e-learning components, or training programmes — with examples you can show us. Please, share a link to your portfolio if available.
* An educational or pedagogical background, whether through your degree, formal training in teaching or learning design, or substantial practical experience.
* Excellent written and spoken Danish and English, and the ability to write clearly for two audiences at once: students and the instructors who will use your materials.

**Personal competences**

* **Craft in making things others will use.** You care whether an activity actually works in week seven of a busy semester, not only whether it reads well in a design document.
* **A service orientation towards instructors** . Course responsibles own their courses and have limited time. We value someone who makes adoption easy and earns agreement through evidence and patience rather than argument.
* **Organized and self-directed.** You will be coordinating deployments across courses at SDU and several semesters, and much of the scheduling discipline will rest with you.
* **Comfort with iteration.** The first version of a module will be wrong in interesting ways. Treating that as information rather than failure is most of the job.
* **Integrity and care in working with students.** You will be collecting data from people who are also being taught and assessed. That asymmetry has to be handled thoughtfully.

**Workplace description**

The **Center for Industrial Software (CIS)** is part of the **Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute** at SDU’s **Faculty of Engineering** . We are a young unit that has grown quickly, with close ties to industry in the region. We take our international workplace seriously.

You will be based at SDU’s campus in **Sønderborg** , sitting on the strait that separates the island of Als from the mainland. Sønderborg is a coastal town of around 27,000 in a municipality of 76,000, built around an 800-year-old castle and shaped by its position on the Danish–German border. It is small enough to cross by bike and rich enough in coastline, forest, and cultural life that people who come for a few years often stay longer. The internati

jobs.title: Research Assistant within Trapped Ion Quantum Technology (re-advertisement)
jobs.description:
The Department of Physics and Astronomy (IFA), Aarhus University, Denmark (www.phys.au.dk) invites applications for a 2-year research assistant position with focus on establishing and maintaining trapped ion quantum technology setups. The work will partly be carried out in the newly established Quantum Tech-nology Lab (QTL) and within the Ion Trap Group.

The position is open from 1 February 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

  

### **Your profile**

The candidates are expected to have experience in cold trapped ion research, and hence both have experience in ion trap and laser technology. We are seeking enthusiastic candidates with a keen interest in setting up a new teaching ion trap setup in QTL as well as participate in maintaining and running ion trap experiments within the Ion Trap Group. More specifically, the candidate should have a solid background in construction and operating rf ion traps, CW laser systems including control of output powers, polarization states, linewidths and frequencies, as well as an understanding of analog and digital electronics for experimental control. Relevant methodology includes UHV vacuum handling, rf circuity electronics, laser frequency stabilization using optical frequency combs, rubidium atomic clocks, and GPS synchronization.

Applicants must be able to document relevant experience, as outlined above.

  

### **Who we are / The department**

The Department of Physics and Astronomy is a department at the Faculty of Natural Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark. The main objectives of the Department are to carry out research at the highest interna-tional level, to offer research based teaching at Bachelor of Science, Master of Science and PhD levels, and to exchange knowledge with other areas of society, e.g. by offering our expertise to industrial partners and the business world.

The Department is an attractive workplace for researchers, teachers, technicians, laboratory technicians and administrators and has a good study environment with many talented and active students at all levels. The research at the Department of Physics and Astronomy is of high quality, attracts significant international attention – in several fields the Department is within the world elite – and is characterized by many international collaborations with other high-ranking universities and research institutions around the world.

The place of work is Ny Munkegade 120, 8000 Aarhus C and the area of employment is Aarhus University with related departments.

### **The successful candidate is offered**

* a working climate inviting lively, open and constructive discussion within and across different fields of research
* a working environment with teamwork, close working relations, and social activities
* a workplace characterized by professionalism, equality and a healthy work-life balance
* a job where the overall environment in Denmark is family-friendly, safe and relaxed – contributing to Denmark consistently being voted amongst the happiest nations in the world.

### **Job description**

Your tasks include:

* Establishing and running a novel linear rf ion trap setup for teaching purposes
* Handling existing CW laser systems including commercial external cavity diode laser systems, TiSa-lasers, fiber-lasers for trapped ion experiments
* Handling (electro-)optical setups for controlling the frequency and shaping the power level of CW laser
* Help developing experimental control systems based on the platform ARTIQ (ARTIQ)

### **Contact information**

Further information can be obtained from Michael Drewsen (drewsen@phys.au.dk)

The application deadline is 13 December 2026.

Short-listing is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the assessment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. The selection is made on the basis of an assessment of who of the candidates are most relevant considering the requirements of the advertisement. All applicants will be notified within 6 weeks whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee and will receive his/her assessment.

  

### **Formalities and salary range**

Natural Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.
  
  
The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

#### **Research Assistant in Explainable and Causality Informed Reinforcement Learning**

We invite applications for a full-time, one-year position as Research Assistant in the Section of Distributed, Embedded and Intelligent Systems (DEIS), Department of Computer Science, Aalborg University. The position focuses on developing reinforcement learning methods that produce understandable control strategies and provide insight into the underlying system dynamics and causal relationships. The research will address safe and effective control of cyber-physical systems, with particular emphasis on UPPAAL Stratego and collaboration with domain experts and external partners.

Expected starting date: **01.12.2026.**

**Your work tasks**

You will develop and evaluate methods for explainable and causality informed reinforcement learning. The aim is to make learned strategies transparent to human domain experts, support well-founded trust in their decisions, and improve understanding of hidden dynamics and causal relationships in the systems being controlled. Your tasks will include:

* Developing compact, interpretable representations of learned control strategies, including strategy minimisation with guaranteed preservation of safety properties.
* Investigating how causal information can inform reinforcement learning and help explain the behaviour and decisions of learned strategies.
* Working with reinforcement learning and recurrent neural networks in UPPAAL Stratego, including implementation and experimental evaluation.
* Applying and evaluating the methods on safety-critical cyber-physical systems, with relevant case studies in water and wastewater infrastructure.
* Collaborating with DEIS researchers, the UPPAAL development team and external partners, and contributing to scientific publications and dissemination.

The work builds on DEIS research in safe reinforcement learning and practical experience with UPPAAL Stratego for modelling and optimal control of wastewater infrastructure, including collaboration with HOFOR continuing the DIREC Bridge project Verifiable and Safe AI.

**Your competencies**

You should have a strong background in reinforcement learning and machine learning, solid programming skills, and experience implementing and evaluating research methods. Knowledge of explainable AI, causal reasoning, recurrent neural networks, or interpretable policy representations is particularly relevant. Experience with UPPAAL or UPPAAL Stratego, formal verification, and modelling and control of cyber-physical systems is an advantage. You should be able to work independently, collaborate with researchers and domain experts, and communicate research clearly in English.

**Qualification requirements**

Appointment as a research assistant requires academic qualifications at master’s degree level. A relevant degree in computer science or a closely related discipline is expected.

**Who we are**

You will join Section DEIS at the Department of Computer Science, Aalborg University. The position brings together research in formal methods, machine learning and cyber-physical systems, with opportunities to contribute to the UPPAAL tool suite and its applications.

Your application must include the following:

* An application stating your reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position.
* Curriculum Vitae (CV).
* Diplomas.
* A list of publications. You may attach a maximum of five publications (optional).
* Documentation of teaching qualifications, following the relevant faculty guidelines for teaching portfolios.
* Dissemination qualifications, including participation in committees, boards or organisations.
* Additional qualifications relevant to the position.
* References or recommendations.

Please consult Aalborg University’s application requirements for further guidance.

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University’s website.

jobs.description:
The Department of Computer Science invites applications for one-year research assistant positions focused on developing innovative robot control and navigation techniques using simulation-based learning for medical robotic endoscope devices.

**Project Background**
  
This project addresses two critical challenges in the field of medical robotics to improve patient care through advanced simulation and control:

* Image-Based Navigation: Creating reward functions for scoring navigation policies for medical robotic devices moving inside the human body, relying solely on image information and accounting for environment changes through interaction models.

* Soft Robot Control: Developing learning-based methods to control a soft robot endoscope via high-level navigation policies to perform clinical procedures inside the human body, including quality assessment of these methods during in-vivo interventions.

The successful candidates will join a multidisciplinary and collaborative team renowned for cutting-edge research in medical imaging and simulation technologies, operating within a global network across France, Germany, and Spain.

**Roles and Responsibilities**
  
The successful candidates will play a central role in the project’s technical and scientific success. While the level of autonomy will vary by position, both roles will share the following core responsibilities:

* **Technical Development & Implementation**: Designing and implementing machine learning methods for motion planning and control. This includes integrating simulation-based learning frameworks and demonstrating the resulting systems on real robotic hardware and soft robot endoscopes.
* **Research & Scientific Contribution**: Contributing to the project’s core objectives by producing impactful research outputs. This includes writing high-quality papers for peer-reviewed journals and presenting findings at international conferences.
* **Collaboration & Knowledge Exchange**: Facilitating collaborations with industrial partners and academic collaborators to ensure that the developed methodologies are meaningful and translatable to real-world clinical practice.
* **Professional Growth & Mentorship**: Engaging in a high-growth research environment. The positions can be extendable and towards a PhD depending on the future funding status. The project has a trackrecord of landing members in top PhD program and faculty positions.
* **Interdisciplinary Integration**: Actively participating in team discussions and workshops to integrate expertise across medical imaging, physics simulation, and robotics control.

**Profile**
  
We are looking for a highly motivated and enthusiastic scientist with the following competencies and experience:

**Essential experience and skills**

* MSc in the fields mentioned above.
* You have a strong foundation and track record in robotics simulation, robot control, computer vision and/or machine learning for physical systems.
* You are highgly experienced in numerical optimization algorithms, preferably applied to motion planning or reinforcement learning. Hands-on experience on real robots especially soft robot systems is a plus.
* Proficient scientific computing and programming (C++/Python) and experience with libraries such as PyTorch, JAX, Warp, Taichi, or ROS.
* Excellent communication skills and a high level of motivation to work in a multidisciplinary, international research environment.

**Desireable experience and skills**

* Experience in publishing peer-reviewed research in top-tier robotics or AI venues.
* Familiarity with physics simulation such as MuJoCo, Isaac Sim, Newton Physics, SOFA etc.

**Terms of employment**
  
The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.

The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of 1 year. The starting date is 15 February or after agreement

jobs.description:
**Biomarker Scientist, Preclinical Fluid Biomarkers and Occupancy**

  

Can you turn advanced bioanalytical data into decisions that accelerate neuroscience drug discovery? Connect fluid biomarkers with in vivo pharmacology and clinical translation.

  

**Your new role**

  

You will develop and apply fluid biomarker strategies that inform critical decisions across Lundbeck's discovery and translational neuroscience programmes. Using LC-MS/MS, quantitative proteomics, peptidomics and other emerging methods, you will design, qualify and implement targeted and untargeted bioanalytical workflows for CSF, plasma, blood, brain and other relevant tissues. You will plan and lead *in vivo* pharmacology studies, linking drug exposure, target engagement and pharmacodynamic effects to biological readouts. You will critically interpret complex datasets and translate the findings into clear project recommendations. As scientific lead or Study Director, you will take ownership of internal and external studies, working with discovery, DMPK, translational medicine, clinical biomarkers, CROs and academic partners.

  

**Your future team**

  

You will join our 13-person Preclinical Fluid Biomarkers and Occupancy department at Lundbeck's R&D headquarters in Valby, Copenhagen. Our team brings together scientists, research assistants, laboratory technicians and students to investigate compound effects in mechanistic animal models and measure related fluid biomarker changes. We combine hands-on science and a translational mindset to generate data that support project decisions.

  

The position is based in Copenhagen, Denmark.

  

**What you bring to the team**

  

You enjoy solving scientific problems, working across disciplines and turning complex findings into clear recommendations. We are looking for:

* A PhD in neuroscience, pharmacology, biochemistry, bioanalytical sciences, biomedical sciences or a related field.
* Strong hands-on experience with LC-MS/MS and mass spectrometry-based proteomics, including the development and qualification of bioanalytical assays in biological matrices.
* Experience designing, planning and executing in vivo pharmacology studies, together with FELASA B certification or equivalent.
* Understanding of translational biomarkers, PK/PD and target engagement, and the communication and collaboration skills to lead studies and work effectively with project teams and external partners.

  

**Our promise to you**

  

Lundbeck offers an inspiring workplace and innovative culture, where our curiosity, accountability and adaptability enable us to transform lives. We want to go faster and further on addressing the big unmet needs of people living with brain disorders. We offer rewarding careers with a mix of exciting tasks and development opportunities that are balanced with initiatives focused on your well-being.

  

We need every brain in the game, and at Lundbeck, we are committed to building a workforce that is as diverse as the people we serve. Read more about our commitment at www.lundbeck.com/global/about-us/our-commitment/diversity-and-inclusion.

  

Annual base salary range: 582 000 - 799 700 DKK gross.

At Lundbeck, we are committed to fair and transparent pay. Please note that the final base salary within the stated range will be based on relevant qualifications, skills, competencies, and level of proficiency as well as internal pay equity.

  

**Apply now**

  

Can you see yourself in this role? We want to hear from you. Does this sound like your dream job, but you're not sure if you meet all the requirements? We still want to hear from you!

Upload your CV and include a few lines about your motivation for applying. No separate cover letter is needed. We ask you not to include a photo or personal information that does not relate to your professional experience.

  

If you have questions, please contact Ayodeji Asuni at AARA@lundbeck.com.

  

Applications must be received by 30 November 2026.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the process once we find the right candidate.

  

Learn more about us at www.lundbeck.com, LinkedIn or Instagram (@h\_lundbeck).

At Lundbeck, our most important contribution is easing the burden of the millions of people living with brain disorders. Whether it is migraine, depression, or other brain disorders, patients, their carers, and society as a whole depend on us.

jobs.title: Laborant til vores analyse og præparationslaboratorier
jobs.description:
Til vores analyse og præparationslaboratorier i Ejby, Lille Skensved tæt på Køge, søger vi en laborant til analyse og præparationsarbejde i henhold til Good Laboratory Practice (GLP).

Afdelingen har ansvar for modtagelse og opbevaring af teststoffer, præparation af vehikler og formuleringer, samt analyse af formuleringer og biologiske prøver fra prækliniske studier. Analysemæssigt arbejder vi med en bred vifte at teknikker herunder HPLC, LC-MS/MS, ELISA, flowcytometri samt fuldautomatiserede analyseenheder til klinisk kemi, hæmatologi og koagulation.

  

**Dine arbejdsopgaver består blandt andet i:**

* Modtagelse, registrering og regnskab af reagenser og teststoffer.
* Præparation og analyse af formuleringer.
* Analyse af biologiske prøver til klinisk kemi, hæmatologi og koagulation.
* Skrive SOP’er og anden dokumentation, i henhold til GLP og efter regulatorisk guidance.
* Varetage opgaver for daglig drift af analyselaboratoriet.
  

**Den ideelle kandidat:**

Du er uddannet laborant eller bioanalytiker og har gerne min 5 års erfaring med laboratoriearbejde i forbindelse med udvikling af lægemidler. Har du erfaring med analyse, f.eks. HPLC, LC-MS/MS, ELISA og/eller fuldautomatiserede analyseenheder til klinisk kemi, hæmatologi og koagulation betragtes dette som en fordel.

Du har praktisk erfaring med kvalitetssystemer (gerne GLP eller andre anerkendte kvalitetssystemer) herunder kendskab til QMS og LIMS.

Du har en naturlig interesse for præparation af formuleringer, og arbejder systematisk, struktureret og engageret. Du besidder basale engelskkundskaber, og har et ønske om at være en del af et team hvor højt humør og godt kollegialt fællesskab præger dagligdagen.

  

**Vi tilbyder:**

Vi kan tilbyde dig et job med en høj grad af selvstændighed i et fagligt og personligt udviklende miljø, hvor du har mulighed for indflydelse og for at bruge og udvikle dine kompetencer. En afdeling hvor laboranter og akademikere arbejder tæt sammen i en travl og inspirerende hverdag.

Afdelingen er bemandet i tidsrummet 6 – 18 på hverdage, og der er i stillingen inkluderet weekend tilkaldevagt ca. hver 6 uge.

  

**Hvem er vi:**

Scantox Group er nordens førende kontraktforskningsvirksomhed indenfor præklinisk forskning. Virksomheden er i Life Science branchen, og udfører studier for producenter indenfor medicinalindustrien (pharma / medico / biotek) og har dermed en vigtig rolle i udviklingen af nye lægemidler.

Hovedkontoret er beliggende i Ejby, Lille Skensved tæt på Køge, og beskæftiger i dag ca. 170 medarbejdere med en bred vifte af kompetencer og uddannelsesmæssige baggrunde. Derudover har Scantox tre datterselskaber i Sverige, et i Østrig og et i UK. Firmaet blev grundlagt i 1977, og har en ambitiøs vækststrategi i samarbejde med firmaets investor Impilo - nationalt såvel som internationalt.

  

**Sådan søger du:**

Har du lyst til at fortsætte din karriere i en spændende virksomhed præget af en uformel omgangstone og en travl hverdag, så send venligst din ansøgning og CV hurtigst muligt.

Ansøgningsfrist: 3. december 2026

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.
