jobs.title: Lab Technician
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

Would you like to apply your laboratory and analytical skills to support the development and testing of innovative dairy products in a global food ingredients company?

**IFF** er en global leder inden for smagsstoffer, duftstoffer, fødevareingredienser samt health & biosciences. Vi udvikler bæredygtige løsninger, der hjælper vores kunder med at skabe produkter, som anvendes af millioner af mennesker verden over.

  

I vores **Food Ingredients** -forretning arbejder Dairy Applications-teamet med udvikling, test og evaluering af mejeriprodukter. Teamet understøtter både kunder og interne interessenter gennem teknisk ekspertise, produktudvikling og applikationstest.

Stillingen er placeret i **Brabrand, Danmark (onsite)** og tilbydes som en **10-måneders tidsbegrænset ansættelse med opstart i januar 2027** . Du bliver en del af et **samarbejdsorienteret, kvalitetsbevidst og engageret** team, hvor du får mulighed for at arbejde med innovative mejeriløsninger i et internationalt miljø.

  
  

**HVOR DU GØR EN FORSKEL**
--------------------------

  

* Udføre laboratorieanalyser på en bred vifte af mejeriprodukter, herunder drikkevarer, flødeprodukter, is, desserter, fermenterede produkter og smelteost.
* Betjene analytiske instrumenter til evaluering af produkters kvalitet, funktionalitet og stabilitet.
* Gennemføre teksturmålinger, stabilitetstests og andre funktionelle analyser.
* Indsamle, registrere og organisere forsøgs- og analysedata på en struktureret og præcis måde.
* Udarbejde rapporter og dokumentation til støtte for produktudviklingsprojekter og tekniske evalueringer.
* Klargøre prøver og understøtte testaktiviteter i Dairy Pilot Plant.
* Samarbejde med teknologer, applikationsspecialister og andre interessenter om projektaktiviteter og udviklingsopgaver.
Bidrage til overholdelse af laboratoriets kvalitets-, sikkerheds- og arbejdsgangsprocedurer.  

  

**HVAD GØR DIG TIL DET RETTE MATCH?**
-------------------------------------

  

* Relevant uddannelse som laborant, fødevareteknolog eller tilsvarende inden for fødevarevidenskab, laboratorieteknologi eller et relateret område.
* Erfaring med laboratoriearbejde og brug af analytiske instrumenter gennem uddannelse, praktik eller erhvervserfaring.
* Evne til at indsamle, analysere og rapportere data på en struktureret måde.
* Interesse for fødevareanalyser og produktudvikling.
* Evne til at arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig bidrage positivt til et team.
* Gode engelskkundskaber, både mundtligt og skriftligt.
* Gode IT-kompetencer og fortrolighed med digitale værktøjer.
* En struktureret, kvalitetsbevidst og ansvarsfuld tilgang til arbejdet.
Positiv indstilling og gode samarbejdsevner.  

  

**HVORDAN KAN DU SKILLE DIG UD?**
---------------------------------

  

* Erfaring med mejeriprodukter eller fødevareapplikationer.
* Kendskab til teksturmålinger, stabilitetstests eller funktionelle fødevareanalyser.
Erfaring fra pilotanlæg, produktudvikling eller applikationslaboratorier.  

  

**HVORFOR VÆLGE OS?**
---------------------

  

* Få erfaring i en global virksomhed med stærke rødder inden for fødevareingredienser og innovation.
* Arbejd med avancerede analyseteknikker og et bredt udvalg af mejeriprodukter.
* Bliv en del af et fagligt stærkt team med erfarne specialister inden for fødevareteknologi og applikationsudvikling.
* Udvikl dine tekniske og analytiske kompetencer i et innovativt miljø.
* Oplev en samarbejdsorienteret kultur med fokus på læring og videndeling.
Bidrag til udviklingen af innovative løsninger til den globale fødevareindustri.  

  

**Bliv en del af IFF i Brabrand og vær med til at støtte udviklingen af fremtidens mejeriløsninger gennem laboratoriearbejde, analyser og teknisk ekspertise.**  
  
Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte **Mikael Petersen** på **Mikael.Petersen@iff.com** .

jobs.title: Advanced Research Scientist
jobs.description:
Category: Research

Location:
Måløv, Capital Region of Denmark, DK

**Advanced Research Scientist**

Peptide & Protein Characterization / Analytical Characterization

Måløv, Denmark

  

**Your impact begins here**

As Advanced Research Scientist in Analytical Characterization, you will use mass spectrometry to show exactly what our clinical treatments are made of – from small molecules and peptides to large proteins. Your analysis helps us understand drug substances, drug products and their impurities, and supports the regulatory submissions that move new treatments towards people living with serious chronic diseases. Your expertise will shape decisions across Novo's clinical portfolio from day one.

  

**W****hat you’ll bring**

We are looking for a hands-on scientist who enjoys solving complex analytical questions and explaining the answers clearly. Furthermore, we are looking for someone with:

* + A PhD in Mass Spectrometry, Organic Chemistry, or Biomolecular Chemistry
* + Preferably some years of industry experience
* + Strong expertise in mass spectrometry for the characterisation of molecules and their related impurities
* + A flair for diverse instrumentation and software, and the curiosity to keep learning new tools
* + A can-do attitude, a self-driven way of working and strong collaboration skills
* + Good communication skills in English, both in writing and in conversation
  

**Useful experience, but not essential:**

* + Experience with proteomics
* + Hands-on experience operating and maintaining High Pressure/Performance Liquid Chromatography and/or mass spectrometry instruments
* + Basic coding skills for data processing and analysis (e.g. setting up simple apps)
  

**What you’ll do**

You will join a team that turns complex analytical data into clear insights about the molecules in Novo's clinical portfolio. The role is primarily office-based with occasional laboratory work.

  

Your primary tasks will include:

* + Characterise drug substances and drug products across all modalities, from small molecules and peptides to large proteins, using mass spectrometry
* + Identify and characterise active ingredients and their related impurities
* + Apply your mass spectrometry expertise to process-related impurities, such as host cell proteins, and to excipients used throughout the manufacturing process
* + Author and review chapters for CTA and IMPD submissions, and support responses to regulatory questions
* + Interpret data, share findings and recommendations clearly, and keep the work moving with colleagues in the team and across the organisation
* + Contribute hands-on laboratory work when needed, using specialised equipment
  

**Who you’ll work with**

You will join Team 1 in Analytical Characterisation, which is part of the CMC organisation in Global Manufacturing & Supply. Team 1 is mainly responsible for mass spectrometry characterisation of drug substances and drug products across all modalities in Novo's clinical portfolio.

  

Analytical Characterisation is responsible for all characterisation and highly specialised analysis that requires specialised equipment. The department is diverse, and the competences in each team can differ considerably, so you will work closely with colleagues who bring different expertise to shared questions.

  

In Global Manufacturing & Supply, colleagues work across the value chain, from development to marketed Novo products, scaling molecules, processes, devices and products for the people who need them.

  

**What you can expect here**

You will work with specialised equipment and a broad range of modalities, and you will be trusted to take ownership of your work and make your voice heard. You can build new skills through varied scientific questions, regulatory writing and collaboration with colleagues who bring different expertise. We support you to perform at your best and to keep growing, because your growth drives progress for our teams and for the people who rely on our treatments.

  

**Salary**: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 570,200 to 838,100 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

**Incentives and Benefits**: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

  

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now**

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to put your mass spectrometry expertise to work on the characterisation of Novo’s clinical portfolio, apply for the Advanced research scientist in Analytical characterization role by **November 23, 2026**. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

  

For further information, please contact Senior Manager Lasse Bohn Olsen at EEBN@novonordisk.com or +45 34 44 11 06.

  

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.title: Advanced Laboratory Technician - In vivo Research
jobs.description:
Category: Research

Location:
Måløv, Capital Region of Denmark, DK

**Job title:** Advanced Laboratory Technician – In vivo Research

**Department:** Global Research

**Location:** Måløv, Denmark

  

**Your impact begins here**

You will support in building the experimental foundation of a new interdisciplinary team in Global Research, established to generate and validate innovative therapeutic concepts in cardiometabolic disease and healthspan. As one of two Advanced Laboratory Technicians in In vivo Research, you will turn scientific questions into well-executed rodent studies and shape the team’s capabilities from the start. Your work helps bring new projects into the early discovery pipeline.

  

**What you will bring**

You are a trained laboratory technician, hold a relevant technical qualification, or bring equivalent practical experience.

* Strong hands-on experience in rodent research, including mouse and rat handling, dosing and sampling.
* Relevant training and authorisation for the animal procedures you will undertake, as applicable.
* A careful, organised approach to experimental work, documentation and data quality.
* The ability to work independently within agreed study plans and to coordinate with colleagues.
* Curiosity, practical problem-solving skills and an interest in learning new methods.
* Confidence in sharing observations, suggesting improvements and asking questions.
* The ability to communicate and document your work in English.
  

**Useful, but not essential:**

* Metabolic phenotyping, including food intake, body composition, glucose regulation or indirect calorimetry.
* Behavioural testing and neuroscience-related experimental methods.
* Rodent surgery and postoperative care.
* Tissue dissection, sample processing and ex vivo methods.
* In vitro assays supporting pharmacological or mechanistic studies.
* Establishing new laboratory methods or workflows.
  

You are not expected to bring experience in every technique. We welcome complementary profiles.

  

**What you will do**

Working closely with scientists and fellow laboratory technicians, you will contribute to studies that test new ideas and help set up how the team works in the lab. More specifically, you will:

* Plan, coordinate and perform mouse and rat pharmacology experiments, including dosing, observations, sampling and relevant physiological measurements.
* Perform metabolic phenotyping and contribute to behavioural studies, according to your expertise and training.
* Collect and process biological samples for ex vivo and laboratory analyses.
* Contribute to developing, optimising and troubleshooting experimental methods.
* Record, quality-check and organise experimental data, and flag observations that may affect interpretation or later studies.
* Bring practical expertise to study planning and to discussions of results.
* Help establish laboratory workflows, maintain equipment and coordinate materials and study activities, working to relevant procedures, animal welfare requirements and the principles of replacement, reduction and refinement.
  

Depending on your experience, you may also contribute to rodent surgery, specialised neuroscience methods or in vitro assays. Training will support the introduction of additional techniques.

  

**Who you will work with**

You will join a new interdisciplinary team in Global Research, part of Research & Development, working alongside scientists and laboratory colleagues with expertise in physiology, pharmacology, neuroscience and molecular innovation. Scientific and technical colleagues plan experiments together, deliver them together and interpret the observations together, so your view counts at every step. The team is headed by Christoffer Clemmensen.

  

You will also work with animal facility staff and laboratory specialists across the organisation.

  

**What you can expect here**

You will help shape the experimental practices of a new team. Your technical judgement, observations and suggestions will be valued as part of the research process, and you will be trusted to work independently within agreed study plans.

  

**Salary and Benefits****:** The Annual Base Salary ranges from 499,600.00 to 734,400.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

  

A competitive benefits package is offered, including a pension scheme (currently 13% employer contribution and 5% employee contribution) in accordance with the applicable Collective Agreement for Salaried Employees (Indutriens Funktionæroverenskomst or “IFO”).

  

Benefits package also include a free choice account of currently 10% and 4% holiday allowance.

  

**Start now**

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn scientific questions into well-executed studies and help build a new team’s lab from the ground up, apply for the Advanced Laboratory Technician – In vivo Research role by **22 November 2026.** We review applications on an ongoing basis, so apply as soon as you can.

  

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.title: Research Scientist, Experimental Quantum Photonics
jobs.description:
Sparrow Quantum is seeking an experimental physicist to develop deterministic entanglement sources for photonic quantum computing. You will build and automate experiments on single quantum emitters coupled to photonic nanostructures, taking responsibility for the optical setup, the supporting electronics and the control software, and translate the results into technical direction for device and system development.

**Your role**

* Design, build and operate quantum optics experiments combining integrated photonics, cryogenics and single-photon detection
* Take ownership of the software for instrument control, experiment automation and data acquisition, and keep it maintainable, versioned and usable by the rest of the team
* Design and build simple electronics and hardware for the lab, such as driver circuits, interface boards, interlocks and mechanical fixtures
* Contribute to research activities on photonic quantum computing and share results clearly with the team
* Collaborate with academic and industrial partners in national and European projects

**Must have**

* PhD in physics or a closely related field
* Hands-on experience in an optics lab, in academia or industry
* Strong practical skills in free-space and fibre optics, lasers and spectroscopy
* Solid programming skills, ideally in Python, for controlling hardware and automating experiments, and a genuine drive to write good code rather than just enough to get by
* Curiosity and the persistence to track down problems and refine the final result
* Willingness to collaborate and deliver results in a clear and structured way
* Strong focus on the final goal, self-discipline and prioritisation

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Git and GitHub, including code review and collaborative development
* Experience with single quantum emitters, such as quantum dots, colour centres, atoms, ions or molecules
* Experience with cryostats, single-photon detectors and time-tagging electronics
* Familiarity with FPGA or real-time control, electro-optic modulators and fast electronics
* Experience with InAs/GaAs quantum dots and integrated quantum photonics, including waveguides, photonic crystals or cavities
* Knowledge of quantum information, including multiphoton entanglement, cluster states or photonic quantum computing
* A track record of scientific publications

**What you can expect**

* A central role in building the experimental and software infrastructure of a company at the forefront of photonic quantum computing
* A high-performance team of highly motivated people working towards photonic quantum computing
* Contributing to scientific publications and patents
* Competitive salary
* Lunches paid by the company
* The possibility of travelling to our collaborators for new insights and knowledge sharing
* A steep learning curve in a supportive environment at the boundary between research and industry

**How to apply**

If you share our passion for delivering a real-world impact through the development of unique quantum photonic technology and have the skills we believe are essential for future Sparrows, we would love to hear from you.

We are committed to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace at Sparrow Quantum and welcome applicants from all backgrounds and identities.

**How to apply:** Scroll down to apply with your CV and a short cover letter (in English).

**Application deadline:** November 23.

**Starting date:** As soon as possible.

**Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis**

Short-listed candidates will be invited for an in-person interview in Copenhagen. Travel and accommodation will be covered.

For questions, contact Alexey Tiranov.

**About Sparrow Quantum**

Sparrow Quantum is a Danish quantum technology company dedicated to advancing light-matter interfaces for quantum technologies. We are recognized globally for our high-performance single-photon sources and our foundational contributions to the quantum internet and quantum computing.

jobs.title: Scientific programmer and data analyst in Environmental Science
jobs.description:
Would you like to apply your programming and data analysis skills to research and environmental advisory work addressing air pollution and climate change? We are looking for a scientific programmer and data analyst to help develop, modernize and operate atmospheric models and analyze complex environmental datasets. You will join the Section for Atmospheric Emissions and Modelling at the Department of Environmental Science, Aarhus University, working closely with researchers on both scientific projects and research-based advice to public authorities.

The Section for Atmospheric Emissions and Modelling conducts research and provides research-based advice on atmospheric processes, emission inventories, air pollution and climate modeling, integrated impact assessment for health, nature and climate, and land-use and remote-sensing research. You will play an important role in advancing this work through the development and improvement of scientific models and the analysis and interpretation of complex environmental data.

This is a permanent position based in Roskilde, Denmark, with an expected starting date of February 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

### **Expected start date and duration of employment**

  

This is a permanent position starting 1 Feb 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

### **Job description**

You will participate in research and advisory projects, the latter mainly for the Danish Ministry of Environment. Both research and advisory projects aim to understand atmospheric processes, helping ministries and environmental agencies regulate air quality and protect our environment. You will work in a dynamic and multidisciplinary team of researchers.

Together with researchers, your main task will be to restructure, improve and modernize existing air quality models and forecast systems as well as to contribute to the development of new integrated air pollution models. A key part of your role will be to help modernize our scientific codebase by introducing and applying good software development practices, making our models and workflows easier to maintain, document, test and reproduce. Your tasks will also include developing and automating workflows for computationally demanding model simulations, including parallel computing, and the processing of large datasets, as well as developing and maintaining applications and scripts in Linux and Windows environments.

You will have the opportunity to collaborate with various research groups and shape the Section’s data science strategy. In addition, you will take part in department-wide initiatives such as workshops, presentations and events related to data science, and contribute to reports and scientific publications.

### **Your profile**

We welcome applications from candidates who meet most, though not necessarily all, of the following qualifications:

* An MSc or PhD in computer science, software engineering, physics, applied mathematics or a related field
* Advanced programming skills in languages such as Python, R, Fortran, C/C++ or similar, including experience with scientific computing, data analysis and visualization libraries
* Experience with implementing and applying modern software development practices for scientific computing, including code organization, version control, documentation, testing, maintainability and reproducibility, as well as experience with parallel computing
* Experience in handling and analyzing large datasets

We are looking for a curious, proactive and motivated colleague who is keen to develop new technical skills and acquire knowledge of atmospheric and air pollution science. Experience with the development and application of air quality models would be welcome, but is not required.

You should enjoy working both independently and collaboratively, sharing knowledge and providing technical guidance to colleagues. Good communication skills and excellent written and spoken English are important. Danish language skills are an advantage, but not a requirement.

Additional experience in any of the following areas would be an advantage, but is not required:
  

* GIS and geospatial data
* Development and integration of APIs and web-based applications
* Working with and modernizing legacy scientific software, including Delphi or similar technologies
* Machine learning and AI methods

  

### **About the Department**

  

The Department of Environmental Science is an interdisciplinary department within the Faculty of Technical Sciences at Aarhus University. Our research covers a wide range of fields, including physics, chemistry, microbiology, social sciences, geography, and environmental economics. The department conducts research and provides research-based advice to ministries and public authorities. Our work addresses major societal challenges such as pollution control, land and water management, climate change, biodiversity protection, and ecosystem services.

We have a highly collaborative work environment, where all employees contribute to securing the research and advisory projects that fund the majority of the department’s activities. We value equality, diversity, and a strong work-life balance.

  

### **The Research Group**

jobs.description:
**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Laboratory Technician I is responsible for performing microbiological processes and techniques to support the testing and analysis of Customer samples. They will be multiskilled in a variety of laboratory test areas and operate a range of different equipment and machinery. The Laboratory Technician I is responsible for abiding to defined quality procedures, ensuring all test records are accurately completed and for supporting an efficient and on time service to the STERIS Customer base.

**Duties**
----------

* Complete the testing of Customer samples within the Laboratory environment; meticulously adhering to procedures and Customer specific requirements.
* Perform microbiological and chemistry procedures and techniques, including, but not limited to use of aseptic technique, microbiological identifications, culture preparation, LAL Endotoxin testing, bioburden, environmental monitoring, biological indicator testing, product inoculations and sterility testing.
* Operate laboratory equipment and machinery, including, but not limited to autoclaves, balances, heating mantles, gas chromatographs, incubators, laminar air flows, cleanrooms, pH meters, filtration apparatus, temperature monitoring systems, pipettes, thermometers, kinetic and gel clot equipment, MALDI-ToF.
* Manage, record, and monitor consumable stocks relating to the Laboratory to ensure adequate stocks of supplies are maintained at all times, observing FIFO (First in first out) If applicable to ensure no time sensitive stock is wasted.
* Generate accurate certificates of analysis following Customer testing to enable them to be subsequently approved right first time and on time for the Customer.
* Ensure individual tasks as per the daily schedule are completed to guarantee on-time-delivery for the Customer.
* Maintain clear communication with senior laboratory personnel, promptly raising any issues encountered.
* Perform routine quality control checks and calibrate laboratory equipment for optimal performance.
* Maintaining accurate and sufficiently detailed records of all tasks performed, ensuring all documentation meets Good Document Practice (GDP) including protocols, reports, procedures, policies, test reports, logbooks and internal records.
* Ensure the Laboratory unit is maintained in a clean and orderly condition, completing general housekeeping tasks in test rooms including the disposal of laboratory waste (cardboard, glass, waste containers).

**Duties - cont'd**
-------------------

* To ensure all laboratory work is carried out in compliance with local Safety, Health and Welfare regulations and all relevant statutory provisions in conjunction with the laboratory staff and under the direction of the laboratory senior management team.
* Ensure personal protective clothing equipment is worn in accordance with the Health & Safety policy and continuously monitor work area for unsafe acts or conditions taking immediate action to correct.
* To ensure all work in the laboratory is carried out in compliance with Good Laboratory Practice, ISO13485 (Current Revision), ISO17025 (Current Revision) accreditation requirements, internal procedures and in conjunction with the laboratory staff and under the direction of the laboratory senior management team.
* To deal with all STERIS, Customer, and internal parties’ information with strict confidentiality at all times and in a professional manner.
* Play an active role in contributing towards the facility achieving monthly on time delivery targets and adhering to Customer lead times.
* To alert a member of the senior laboratory management team to any process, job related problems or discrepancies. To be proactive in highlighting and resolving situations to support turnaround time adherence and testing requirements.

**Education Degree**
--------------------

Bachelor's Degree in Science

**Required Experience**
-----------------------

* Knowledge of general microbiology techniques
* Knowledge of Good Laboratory Practice (GLP)
* Competent using Microsoft Office (i.e. PowerPoint, Word, Excel)
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Excellent interpersonal skills including cooperation and teamwork
* Meticulous attention to detail
* Analytical and problem-solving skills

jobs.description:
Our client, the Department of Agriculture, Food and the Marine, is currently hiring for Laboratory Analysts Chemistry based in their Backweston Laboratory Location.

  
  

**About the Department**

The Department of Agriculture, Food and the Marine (DAFM) is a multi-functional organisation which provides a wide range of services both directly and through specialist state agencies operating under its aegis. The Department has a wide and diverse customer base which includes farmers, consumers, food processers and other commercial operators, those involved in sea fishing, forestry, bio-energy, research as well as diverse EU institutions, other State Bodies and special interest groups. The Mission of the Department is to serve ‘the government and people of Ireland by leading, developing and regulating the agri-food sector, protecting public health and optimising social, economic and environmental benefits.’

  
  

**About the role**

DAFM has an embedded laboratory service comprising a central laboratory complex at Backweston, together with a network of regional laboratories in 5 locations (Cork, Limerick, Athlone, Kilkenny and Sligo) and a research farm facility. DAFM laboratories have an overall staff compliment of approximately 300 persons engaged in work relating to animal health, food safety and plant and environmental sciences. The laboratories are currently undergoing a significant transformation underpinned by the vision statement, “Scientific Excellence – Safeguarding and Enhancing Public, Animal and Plant Health and our Environment”.

The role is for Laboratory Analyst – Chemistry. Successful candidates will be assigned to work in food safety and food authenticity, and animal health. Depending on where they are posted, they will be engaged in the detection of unauthorised substances, contaminants and residues of pesticides and veterinary medicines in a range of different foods and other matrices and compositional analysis of dairy products.

  
  

**Principal Tasks:**

(i) Performance of laboratory analysis, usually under the supervision of a Senior Laboratory Analyst.

(ii) Performance of laboratory techniques to the ISO17025 standard.

(iii) Responsibility for samples received in the laboratory. Recording sample information in a LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System).

(iv) Support maintenance of laboratory accreditation to the ISO17025 standard and assist in method validation and project work.

For a brief description of the tests carried out by analysts in the various laboratories (please see Appendix B at the end of this document).

  
  

**Working Environment:**

The Laboratories are modern facilities compliant with all health and safety regulations. The laboratories at Backweston are state-of-the-art facilities providing a working environment to match the highest standards in Europe.

Special Equipment and facilities available in connection with the work:

A wide range of laboratory instrumentation and facilities are provided to perform the range of testing necessary. For chemistry laboratories, the work is heavily dependent on chromatographic techniques using various detection systems. Examples of equipment used for chemical and residue analysis includes GC, IC (Ion Chromatography) and LC-MS (including triple quadruple and high-resolution accurate mass systems), ICP-MS, ICP-OES, AAS, FTIR, HPLC various detection systems e.g. DAD, fluorescence), GC (FID) and biochemistry analysers.

  
  

**Training:**

All Laboratories provide training on the job relevant to the duties of the Laboratory Analyst. Participation in additional training courses is encouraged. Laboratory Analysts are encouraged to seek higher qualifications where relevant courses are available in 3rd level institutes.

**Competencies**

Applicants should have all the attributes required of a Laboratory Analyst – Chemistry and they must demonstrate, by reference to specific examples from their career to-date, that they possess or have the capacity to acquire the qualities, skills and knowledge required for the role of Laboratory Analyst as identified in the following competency framework.

  
  

1. Specialist Laboratory Knowledge and Expertise

2. Teamwork

3. Analysis and Decision Making

4. Interpersonal and Communication Skills

5. Commitment and Delivery of Results

  
  

**Location**

The Department currently has two vacancies for the role of Laboratory Analyst Chemistry located at **Backweston Campus, Celbridge, Co. Kildare**

Further vacancies may arise over the lifetime of the Order of Merit.

It is planned to interview potential candidates to fill these vacancies. Following an assessment process, candidates who achieve the qualifying standard will be placed on an Order of Merit and assigned to fill vacancies as they arise. The Order of Merit remains in force for a period of up to two years from the date of the first appointment or until exhausted.

  
  

**Temporary Vacancies**

If temporary vacancies for this post arise during the lifetime of the Order of Merit, the Department reserves the right to offer such temporary posts based on the results of this competition. Candidates who accept such a temporary post retain their placing on the Order of Merit and the acceptance of such a temporary appointment in no way interferes with the normal process of appointing candidates to permanent posts that may arise.

  
  

**Who we are looking for**

**Essential Requirements - Educational Qualifications:**

  

**On or before 10th December 2026** , candidates must hold a qualification of at least an ordinary level degree (level 7 consisting of 180 credits on the National Framework of Qualifications) in one of the following:

* Chemistry.
* Analytical Chemistry.
* Chemical and Pharmaceutical Science.
* Science with chemistry/analytical chemistry being a major component of the qualification.

Or

* Hold a qualification that would be acceptable to the Department as being at least equivalent.

The Josep Carreras Leukaemia Research Institute (IJC) is a comprehensive **cancer research center** dedicated to conduct research and drive innovation in the epidemiological, preventive, clinical, translational, and basic aspects of leukaemia and other hematologic malignancies, with the final aim of finding a cure for these diseases. It was created in 2010, and since then has experienced an exponential growth.

The IJC is also part of the network of Excellence Research Centers of Catalonia **(CERCA)** and was accredited as a **Severo Ochoa Center of Excellence** by the Ministry of Science, Innovation, and Universities in 2024. Since 2018, the Institute has also been accredited by the Scientific Foundation of the Spanish Association Against Cancer **(FCAECC)** Additionally, IJC is one of the centers integrated into the Institut de Recerca Germans Trias i Pujol (IGTP) accreditation as Accredited Health Research Institute (IIS) by the Carlos III Health Institute **(ISCIII)**.

The IJC's main headquarters is located within the Can Ruti Biomedical Campus, alongside other leading biomedical institutions, providing direct access to cutting-edge scientific and technological facilities, as well as complementary community services. The IJC has **six locations integrated into reference hospitals**: Hospital Germans Trias i Pujol, Hospital Clínic, Hospital Sant Pau, Hospital Josep Trueta, Hospital del Mar and Hospital San Joan de Déu. This facilitates close collaboration between basic and clinical researchers, fostering translational research that integrates basic science with clinical practice in clinical settings.

The Josep Carreras Leukemia Research Institute is looking for a Laboratory Technician for the Chromatin, metabolism and cell fate group, led by Dr. Marcus Buschbeck in our Can Ruti Campus.

**RESEARCH DESCRIPTION**

Myeloproliferative neoplasms (MPN), myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS), and acute myeloid leukemia (AML) are related malignant disorders of the bone marrow that disrupt normal blood cell production. MPNs are typically chronic diseases characterized by excessive proliferation of relatively mature myeloid cells, such as in polycythemia vera, essential thrombocythemia, and primary myelofibrosis, and may progress over time to AML. MDS are marked by ineffective and dysplastic hematopoiesis, leading to cytopenias and an increased risk of transformation to AML, particularly in older patients. AML represents the most aggressive end of this disease spectrum and is defined by the rapid accumulation of immature myeloid blasts that replace normal marrow function, causing severe anemia, infections, and bleeding, and requiring urgent treatment.

The Laboratory technician will be involved in several projects in the Buschbeck lab with the focus on multi-omic approaches to identify and characterize new drug targets and validate them in vitro and in vivo.

* Experience in basic computer tools: Excel, Word, PowerPoint.

* Attitude to learn and work independently.
* Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work with other team members.

jobs.title: PhD Position: Translational Immunomics in Hematological Neoplasms Group
jobs.description:
The Translational Immunomics in Hematological Neoplasms Group, led by Dr. Bruno Paiva at CIMA Universidad de Navarra (Pamplona, Spain), is looking for a highly motivated PhD student to join our team.

https://cima.cun.es/en/research/research-programs/research-programs-hematological-oncology/research-group-translational-immunomics-hematological-neoplasms

The translational model that governs our group is based on the hybrid nature of our flow cytometry laboratory, with its dual focus on diagnosis and research. First, we conduct research to improve the methods we use for the differential diagnosis, staging, and monitoring of patients with hematological malignancies. Second, our goal is to understand the biology of the tumor cells that we routinely detect in diagnostic settings (e.g., circulating tumor cells [CTCs], measurable residual disease [MRD], and immune monitoring).

Our laboratory is recognized for its leadership in translational research across the spectrum of monoclonal gammopathies. Our most notable scientific contributions are, as expected, in the clinical application of flow cytometry. Although multiple myeloma is the tumor we have studied most extensively (>150 publications in leading hematology journals over the past 10 years), we have also defined the clinical utility of flow cytometry in other malignancies, such as primary systemic amyloidosis (Paiva, Blood 2011; Paiva, Blood 2016; Puig, Leukemia 2019) and Waldenström macroglobulinemia (Paiva, Leukemia 2014; Paiva, Blood 2015).

In terms of innovative research in immunogenomics, within the field of multiple myeloma, we have contributed to advancing the field of clonal hematopoiesis (Maia, Blood 2020) and lymphopoiesis (Rodriguez, ASH 2020), monitoring of circulating tumor cells (CTCs) (Garces, J Clin Oncol 2022; Termini, Clin Cancer Res 2022), and the biology of clonal dissemination (Paiva, Blood 2013; Mishima, Cell Rep 2017; Garces, Leukemia 2020 [2]); measurable residual disease (MRD) monitoring (>15 publications in, for example, J Clin Oncol and Blood); and the biology of resistant clones (Paiva, Blood 2016; Goicoechea, Blood 2021), immune profiling (Paiva, Blood 2016 [2]; Botta, Blood Adv 2022; Termini, Clin Cancer Res 2022), and preclinical research in immunotherapy (Seckinger, Cancer Cell 2017; Moreno, Clin Cancer Res 2019).

In Waldenström macroglobulinemia, we were the first to identify its normal cellular counterpart (Paiva, Blood 2015) and to describe the presence of mutated MYD88 in normal lymphopoiesis in these patients (Rodríguez, Science Advances 2022). In light-chain amyloidosis, we pioneered the use of single-cell studies to identify unique transcriptional programs in this disease (Alameda, Blood 2021).

Much more important than our scientific output is its clinical impact. For example, our contributions to the study of solitary plasmacytoma (Paiva, Blood 2014) and MRD contributed, in part, to the subsequent development of new diagnostic criteria (Rajkumar, Lancet Oncol 2014) and response criteria (Kumar, Lancet Oncol 2016).

The successful candidate will work at the intersection of translational research applied to patients. Depending on the candidate's interests and background, the PhD project may involve:

* Identify the plasma cell clone responsible for dissemination, resistance, and relapse, by studying circulating tumor cells (CTC) and minimal residual disease (MRD).
* Identify extreme phenotypes: cure vs. resistance.
* To define the role of the immune system and the microenvironment in the pathogenesis of multiple myeloma and acute leukemia, and in their drug resistance.
* Preclinical evaluation of new anti-myeloma compounds and monitoring of clinical trials
* Characterization of immune biology and response to immunotherapy in experimental models of multiple myeloma

The candidate will join a highly collaborative and international research environment. The project combines advanced genomics and flow cytometry technologies with a clear translational objective, offering the opportunity to contribute to a field with potential clinical impact.

**Recent publications:**

* MRD dynamics predicts progression and reveals a vulnerable state for immunotherapy interception in multiple myeloma. Blood. 2026 Jul 24:blood.2026033878. doi: 10.1182/blood.202603387
* Idecabtagene vicleucel and endogenous T-cell phenotypes linked to progression-free survival in relapsed multiple myeloma. Hemasphere. 2026 Jul 2;10(7):e70423. doi: 10.1002/hem3.70423
* Immune biomarkers of increased infection risk in multiple myeloma. Blood. 2026 Apr 30;147(18):2081-2088. doi: 10.1182/blood.2025031744

  

**Essential requirements**

* Bachelor's/University degree in Biology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, Biomedical Sciences or a related field.
* Minimum average grade of 8.5/10 or equivalent. Candidates with grades less than 8.5 will not be accepted.

For those studies outside of Spain, we would need the equivalent marks through https://universidades.sede.gob.es/pagina/index/directorio/Equivalencia\_notas\_medias/language/en

* Master's degree providing access to PhD studies, either completed or expected to be completed during 2027.
* Strong interest in taslational projects
* Good level of written and spoken English.
* Ability to work independently while being part of a collaborative team.

**Desirable qualifications**

* Previous laboratory research experience.
* Experience with flow cytometry and genomics.
* Knowledge of bioinformatics/computational biology.
* Previous experience in an academic research environment.

We are particularly interested in candidates who are curious, creative, scientifically rigorous and motivated to develop their own ideas

**What we offer**

* A PhD project at the forefront of genomics and flow citometry.
* A highly collaborative and international research environment.
* Opportunities to collaborate with leading international groups in the field.
* Participation in scientific meetings, conferences

We also coordinate the international Variant Curation Expert Panel (VCEP) for Neurofibromatosis and Schwannomatosis within ClinGen (NIH).

The Barcelona Institute for Global Health (ISGlobal) is a cutting-edge institute addressing global public health challenges through research, translation into policy and education. ISGlobal has a broad portfolio in communicable and non-communicable diseases including environmental and climate determinants, and applies a multidisciplinary scientific approach ranging from the molecular to the population level. Research is organized in five programs: Climate, Air Pollution, Nature and Urban Health; Environment and Health over the Lifecourse; Global Viral and Bacterial Infections; Malaria and Neglected Parasitic Diseases and Maternal Child and Reproductive Health. ISGlobal is accredited with the Severo Ochoa distinction, a seal of excellence of the Spanish Science Ministry.

###### **WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

ISGlobal is seeking a Research Technician to assist the design, production and dissemination of a free online capacity-building course on how urban green interventions can:

1) Contribute to improved air quality and reduction of population exposure to pollutants;

2) Mitigate urban heat and improve thermal comfort in public spaces and school environments;

3) Support healthier, more liveable and climate-resilient urban environments; and

4) Generate co-benefits for public health, wellbeing and environmental equity.

The course will be tailored to the needs of municipal technicians, school communities, parent associations and local initiatives, with content grounded in ISGlobal's research expertise and adapted to the policy context of the revised EU Air Quality Directive. At Syngenta Vegetables, we're cultivating tomorrow's diversity through innovative breeding that brings nutritious vegetables to tables worldwide.  **Qualifications**

**What you will bring**

* Knowledge of seed processes, seed production and pollination; familiarity with solanaceous crops is beneficial.
* Practical experience or strong interest in in-vitro culture and/or pollination activities, ideally in solanaceous or cucurbit crops.
* Understanding of sterile working practices for cell biology and tissue-culture activities, as well as biosafety requirements.
* Awareness of quality and continuous-improvement standards, including GSPP and ISO 9001.
* Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel and PowerPoint; experience with Smartsheet is an advantage.
* Strong attention to detail, organisation and ability to maintain accurate records.
* Ability to manage changing priorities, work constructively under pressure and make sound decisions in situations of ambiguity.
* A proactive, collaborative and results-oriented approach, with the ability to share knowledge and work effectively across teams without direct reporting lines.
* Ability to perform practical, manual work in greenhouse and laboratory environments while maintaining safe and clean ways of working.

* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* A role that contributes to valuable and impactful work in a stimulating and international environment.
* Learning culture and a wide range of development options, including access to learning platforms (Degreed and LinkedIn Learning).

**Research Assistant - NanoElectrocatalysis and Sustainable Chemistry**

As a flagship research center in nanoscience and nanotechnology, our mission is to open and explore new frontiers of knowledge at the nanoscale and bring value to society in the form of new understanding, capabilities, and innovation, while inspiring and providing broad training to the next generations of researchers. Our values are Commitment, Collaboration and Transformation.

Our research lines focus on the newly discovered physical and chemical properties that arise from the behaviour of matter at the nanoscale. ICN2 has been awarded the Severo Ochoa Center of Excellence distinction for three consecutive periods (2014-2018, 2018-2022 and 2023-2026). ICN2 comprises 20 Research Groups, 7 Technical Development and Support Units and Facilities, and 2 Research Platforms, covering different areas of nanoscience and nanotechnology.

**Job Title:** Research Assistant

**Department:** NanoElectrocatalysis and Sustainable Chemistry

**Description of Group/Project:**

The NanoElectrocatalysis and Sustainable Chemistry Group combines electrochemistry, materials science, and advanced in situ characterisation techniques to understand the fundamental processes governing electrocatalytic reactions and to develop novel materials for sustainable energy conversion and chemical production. The group focuses on elucidating the relationship between the structure, properties, and catalytic performance of electrocatalytic materials, with particular emphasis on understanding electrochemical interfaces and reaction mechanisms under operating conditions. We offer a stimulating working environment within an interdisciplinary and international research community. The Research Assistant will contribute to ongoing research activities focused on the in situ characterisation of electrocatalysts and electrochemical interfaces involved in the electrocatalytic reduction of nitrate and carbon dioxide.

**Main Tasks and responsibilities:**

The successful candidate will contribute to the experimental investigation of electrocatalysts and electrochemical interfaces for the electrocatalytic reduction of nitrate and carbon dioxide.

The main tasks and responsibilities will include:

* Performing the in situ and operando characterisation of electrocatalytic materials and electrochemical interfaces using scanning electrochemical microscopy and vibrational spectroscopy.
* Conducting electrochemical experiments to investigate the activity, selectivity and behaviour of electrocatalysts during nitrate and carbon dioxide reduction reactions.
* Processing, analysing and interpreting experimental data, and contributing to the preparation of scientific reports, presentations and manuscripts for publication in peer-reviewed journals.
* Contributing to the maintenance, optimisation and development of experimental setups and characterisation methodologies.
* Collaborating with researchers within the group and external research institutions and participating in scientific meetings and research discussions.

  + Knowledge of electrocatalysis and electrochemical energy conversion.

* **Professional Experience:**
  + Previous laboratory experience in electrochemical experimentation and characterisation of electrocatalytic materials.
  + Experience with electrochemical techniques and instrumentation, including the development and optimisation of experimental protocols.

  + Experience in experimental data processing, analysis and interpretation.
  + Relevant publications within electrochemistry are desirable.
* **Personal Competences:**

jobs.description:
#### **JOB DESCRIPTION**

DM1-Hub aims to be the basis for the implementation of precision medicine aspects in Spain for the benefit of patients with Myotonic Dystrophy type 1 (DM1), prioritizing better diagnosis and optimization in the use of soon-to-be-available treatments. The DM1-Hub project brings together a group of 130 professionals in the areas of research and clinical monitoring of DM1. Together they form a multidisciplinary work team with extensive experience in this pathology at the research level, which includes predoctoral, postdoctoral and senior researchers, including renowned research groups in the field of rare neuromuscular diseases and DM1 in particular.

Specifically, the team is made up of specialists in genomics, epigenetics, bioinformatics, biostatistics, proteomics, applied research and scientific dissemination. In turn, the team makes up an important network of around 70 health professionals (neurologists, neuropediatricians, neuropsychologists and nurses), in more than 50 hospitals in 10 different Autonomous Communities, who follow up with DM1 patients in their consultations. We are looking for a compromised enthusiastic and compromised nurse for DM1-Hub project. He/she would interact with nurses and other health professionals around Spain that will be doing the same tasks in another Autonomous Communities.

We're Fever, the world's leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we're revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

At Fever, People decisions run on data. As part of the People Analytics team, you'll turn data into actionable insights that shape our talent strategy and employee experience!

**Who You Are**

jobs.title: Analyst-Compliance GFCSU Quality Control Review
jobs.description:
The Global Risk & Compliance (GRC) organization serves as American Express’ independent risk management function. GRC maintains the enterprise risk framework, provides oversight and challenge, and monitors key risks. By embedding risk discipline into strategy and operations, GRC enables responsible growth, innovation, and long-term value creation while protecting customers and shareholders.American Express's Global Financial Crimes Surveillance Unit (GFCSU) is part of the broader Global Risk & Compliance organization, operating within Global Financial Crimes Compliance (GFCC), and provides end-to-end oversight and support of global financial crimes investigations.

The GFCSU Quality Control Review (QCR) Team performs ongoing monitoring of Financial Crimes investigations to support adherence to applicable legal and regulatory standards, internal procedures, and established quality requirements.

The QCR B30 Analyst is an individual contributor responsible for independently reviewing completed investigative casework and decisions, applying sound risk-based judgment, identifying quality gaps and errors, challenging investigative conclusions when appropriate, and supporting consistent application of investigative and quality standards.

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

* **4+ years of combined relevant experience in Financial Crimes and/or Risk Operations** , including areas such as Anti-Money Laundering (AML)/Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), Know Your Customer (KYC), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), Sanctions Screening, Anti-Corruption, Operational Risk, Credit Bust-Out (CBO), Fraud Prevention, Credit, Collections, or other directly relevant Financial Crimes or Risk Operations disciplines.
* **Proven analytical and critical-thinking skills** , with demonstrated ability to research, assess, interpret, and synthesize information from multiple sources; apply sound judgment; and reach logical, well-supported conclusions on matters with potential regulatory or financial-crime risk impact.
* **Proven experience independently making and defending complex risk-based decisions with limited direction** , including interpreting procedures and standards where facts require judgment rather than straightforward application of prescribed criteria.
* **Strong stakeholder communication and influencing skills** , including the ability to influence without direct authority, clearly articulate and substantiate findings and conclusions, objectively evaluate differing perspectives or challenges, and resolve questions through evidence-based discussion.
* **Strong written and verbal communication skills** , with demonstrated ability to clearly articulate findings, rationale, recommendations, and conclusions to investigators, leaders, and relevant stakeholders.
* **Excellent time-management and organizational skills** , with demonstrated ability to independently manage workload, balance competing priorities, and meet quality and productivity expectations in a deadline-driven environment.
* **Strong attention to detail** , with demonstrated ability to identify inconsistencies, documentation gaps, errors, and other quality concerns within investigative casework.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience independently assessing alerts, cases, investigations, or other risk decisions; challenging investigative conclusions when appropriate; identifying quality gaps or errors; and delivering effective, constructive feedback to support case quality and consistent application of investigative standards. Relevant experience may include Quality Control (QC), Quality Assurance (QA), Business Self-Testing (BST), peer review, or other case-quality/review functions.
* Relevant Financial Crimes, fraud, compliance, or risk industry certification, such as Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS), Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE), or equivalent.
* Bachelor's degree preferred, consistent with the knowledge, skills, and responsibilities of the role.
Knowledge of American Express products, systems, investigative processes, and applicable Financial Crimes regulatory framework.  

Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the Spain is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions.

  

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

  

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

* Bonus incentives

We’re live with **Santander, Revolut, BBVA** and dozens others. We’ve proven the product in large-scale pilots with top-tier banks. And now we need to move fast to **secure leadership in this $300Bn+ industry**.

#### **About the Role**

We're looking for a **Data Analyst** to turn every transaction into the reliable analytics. You'll work directly with the co-founders and will own the metrics, models and dashboards behind every decision we make.

#### **What you'll do**

* **Own the numbers.** Define the KPIs every team runs on, and make sure everyone calculates them the same way.
* **Build the source of truth.** Write the data models and dashboards that turn raw call, debt and payment data into answers people trust.
* **Automate invoicing.** Turn billing every bank, in every currency, into a pipeline that runs itself.
* **Prove what works.** Design and read the experiments that tell a real lift in recovery from noise.
* **Dive deep and problem solve.** Get to the root cause of every number that looks off, and fix it at the source.

#### **Who you are**

* **Highly analytical, and precise.** You've built metrics and models a business actually ran on.
* **You're fluent in SQL and Python.**
* **You own outcomes, and you never settle.** You don't stop at the chart — you chase the number until it changes a decision.
* **You have a STEM degree, and you were top of your class.** You're technical, you're rigorous with numbers, and you have a strong philosophy of a champion.
* **AI-native, ruthless on quality.** You reach for AI to automate and streamline by default. You know exactly where it gets sloppy. You never let that through, and you control quality rigorously.
* **You don't need a collections or fintech background.** We'd rather teach the domain to a killer than hire a lifer who can't ship — you'll pick up the data, the domain and the regulation cold, fast.

#### **What we offer**

Fair equity with **enormous upside potential.**

Salary at the **top of the benchmark**.

**Real ownership** — Murphy's numbers are yours to define and defend.

️ Small team, high autonomy, and outsized impact.

The founding team's direct attention, and a category with a $300B+ industry behind it.

**Healthy meals**: No more boring tupperware – enjoy daily meals with **Nora Foods**. We cover 50% of each order!

**Cobee card**: Flexible compensation for **transport and restaurants**, so you can make the most of your net salary.

**Hybrid & Flexible**: Our default setup is hybrid – 3 days a week at our office in Poblenou, surrounded by a thriving tech scene, and 2 days of remote work. But if there’s one thing that defines us, it’s flexibility: we trust you to organize your time and space in the way that helps you do your best work.

#### **Our Process**

We believe that hiring is a two-way street: while we get to know you, you also deserve the chance to understand who we are, how we work, and what makes Murphy AI special. Here’s what you can expect:

1️⃣ **First Interview – Getting to Know You**  
A conversation with a future teammate who’s excited to find a new colleague. We’ll talk about your story, what drives you, and what you’re looking for next—no trick questions, just a genuine exchange.

2️⃣ **Second Interview – Deep Dive**  
You’ll meet the Hiring Manager and potentially another team member. This is a more technical discussion where we explore your skills in detail, walk through real scenarios, and answer any questions you might have about the role.

3️⃣ **Tech Assessment or Business Case**  
A practical exercise to see how you approach challenges similar to those you’d tackle at Murphy. You’ll have time to reflect and showcase your thinking—no rush, no surprises.

4️⃣ **Coffee at the Office with the Founders**  
Finally, you’ll join us in our Barcelona office for a relaxed coffee with the founders and the Hiring Manager. It’s the perfect opportunity to experience our culture firsthand and meet more of the team who could soon be your colleagues.

*We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where everyone, regardless of background, identity, or experience, feels valued and empowered to thrive. We believe that different perspectives drive innovation and success, and we actively foster an environment where all voices are heard and respected.*

**Biomedical Data Scientist / Bioinformatician: Immunotherapy & AI (m/f/d)**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------

*We are recruiting an ambitious Biomedical Data Scientist or Bioinformatician for EU-funded research that employs AI methods to accelerate development and clinical translation of CAR T cell immunotherapies. The successful candidate will join the research group led by Christoph Bock at the CeMM Research Center for Molecular Medicine (Austrian Academy of Sciences) and the Institute of Artificial Intelligence (Medical University of Vienna), broadly contributing to several European consortia through data-driven biomedical research, analysis of complex datasets, support and co-mentoring of students and postdocs, computational methods development, and contributions to project and data management.*

### **Your Profile**

We are seeking researchers eager to contribute to cutting-edge research, with a strong commitment to scientific excellence and collaboration. We are open to candidates pursuing a classical academic career, but also to those looking for opportunities outside the PhD postdoc professor track, who may be interested in building the foundations for a start-up company or a career in AI-driven biomedical and translational research. We welcome early-stage candidates who have recently completed their PhD, as well as candidates with initial postdoctoral research experience who are ready for the next challenge. Final-year PhD students are encouraged to apply early; the contract will start once the PhD has been completed.

**Required skills**

* PhD in bioinformatics, computational or quantitative biology, machine learning / artificial intelligence, data science, or a related field
* Strong programming and data analysis skills (Python and/or R) and experience analyzing complex biological or biomedical datasets
* Prior experience with high-throughput biology data, such as single-cell, spatial, or other multi-omics datasets, or with biomedical research
* Good communication skills in English and the ability to work collaboratively in an interdisciplinary, international team

**Desirable skills**

* Experience with machine learning / deep learning frameworks and AI methods for biomedical data
* Software and data engineering skills, including workflow management tools and good software development practices
* Familiarity with FAIR principles and data standards, and with integrating data across multiple sites
* Experience with clinical or health data, including GDPR-compliant data handling
* Publications in the field, and experience in mentoring or co-supervising students

### **The project**

This position sits at the computational center of several European research consortia that together pursue one goal: making CAR T cell immunotherapy faster to develop, better understood, and more broadly applicable. The main focus is on data science — analyzing complex multi-omics and clinical datasets produced across partner sites, developing AI methods for predicting immune cell function and therapeutic response, and establishing the data infrastructure and standards that let partners throughout Europe work together effectively, contributing expertise from fundamental biology to clinical practice. The role is correspondingly broad: deep analytical work on research questions, development of computational methods and software systems, and close interactions with biologists, clinicians, and computational colleagues across Europe.

### **The Bock Lab** **(****https://bocklab.org****)**

We seek to advance biomedicine with technology-driven research, combining experimental and computational approaches to understand and program epigenetic cell states and to develop cell-based therapies for cancer and immune diseases.

Main areas of research include:

* *Bioinformatics*. Computational methods are essential for data-driven biomedical research. We develop algorithms and software for large-scale data analysis, and we pursue clinical collaborations to establish medical impact.
* *Single-cell biology*. Epigenetic cell states contribute broadly to the regulation of human organs. As part of the Human Cell Atlas, we use single-cell and spatial sequencing to dissect their role in tissue homeostasis and pathogenesis.
* *Machine learning*. Huge datasets pose new analytical challenges. As part of the European Laboratory for Learning and Intelligent Systems, we develop methods for interpretable deep learning and artificial intelligence in biomedicine.
* *Biotechnology*. Groundbreaking discoveries are often enabled by new technology. We develop and apply innovative methods in the areas of single-cell sequencing, CRISPR screening, epigenome editing, and synthetic biology.
* *Cell therapy*. CAR T cells have shown dramatic efficacy for blood cancers and spearhead a broader shift toward personalized cell-based therapies. We use high-throughput technology to design synthetic immune cells as therapeutics

**The****Principal Investigator** (https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=9qSsTcIAAAAJ)

Christoph Bock is a Principal Investigator at the CeMM Research Center for Molecular Medicine of the Austrian Academy of Sciences and Professor of [Bio]Medical Informatics at the Medical University of Vienna. He is also the scientific coordinator of the Biomedical Sequencing Facility at CeMM, member of the Human Cell Atlas Organizing Committee, fellow of the European Lab for Learning and Intelligent Systems (ELLIS), and co-founder of two Vienna-based start-up companies (Myllia, Neurolentech). Our Vienna team is part of Biosynth, a global life sciences company supporting customers in pharmaceutical, diagnostic and other science-led industries. The Austrian site focuses on enzyme projects, bringing together development and production to help turn scientific ideas into practical solutions. Joining the team gives you the opportunity to contribute to hands-on laboratory work while collaborating as part of an international organisation.

**The opportunity**

Are you scientifically curious, practical and keen to build your experience in a laboratory environment? We are looking for a Technician to support our development and production team in Vienna. You will contribute to enzyme development and a varied range of laboratory activities, from fermentation and molecular biology analyses to protein purification. This is an opportunity to apply your scientific knowledge, learn new techniques and play a part in the development of our enzyme projects.

This role is intended for candidates with 1+ years of relevant industry experience gained after completing a university degree, rather than recent graduates entering the industry for the first time

* Participation in the development of new enzymes.
* Fermentation of microorganisms such as bacteria and yeast.
* Molecular biological analyses and co-development of enzymatic assays, from sample preparation to analysis.
* Protein purification by chromatography.
* Participation in all laboratory operations.
* Precise documentation of the experiments carried out.

* Excellent knowledge of German (spoken and written), very good knowledge of English (spoken and written) and computer skills (MS Office).
* Independent and accurate way of working, communication and team skills.
* High level of initiative and flexibility.

Biosynth® is an innovative life sciences reagents, custom synthesis and manufacturing services company headquartered in Staad, Switzerland. Our main production laboratories are located in Switzerland, the UK, Slovakia and China, with peptide and antibody production in the US, the Netherlands. Bioconjugation projects are based in Germany, Enzyme projects are based in Austria and biological IVD reagents in Ireland.

jobs.title: Laboratory Technician || Sample Preparation & Lab Operations (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
**The mission at sequestra**
----------------------------

At sequestra, we develop cutting-edge technology to permanently store CO₂ in industrial mineral residues, turning waste into high-value, climate-friendly materials. Our solutions sit at the core of a sector with the potential to reduce global emissions by 4 gigatons.

We are building the global leader in Carbonation Intelligence, and we're looking for a full-time Laboratory Technician for our carbonation analytics lab. You'll prepare samples, run carbonation tests and standard analyses, and keep the lab running smoothly day to day. Your results are the data our scientists and engineers rely on to decide which materials go to our plant – and because every sample passes through your hands, your care and precision really count.

We're headquartered in Vienna, with two additional technical sites in Vienna and Upper Austria; this position is based at our lab in 1210 Vienna (Floridsdorf). Join an ambitious team and help take CO₂ mineralization from pilot to industrial scale.

**What you will do**
--------------------

**Sample Preparation**  

* Receive, label and log incoming material samples (industrial mineral residues such as slags, ashes and concrete fines)
* Prepare samples as specified: e.g. drying, crushing, grinding, sieving, filtration
* Keep sample storage organised and every sample traceable

**Lab Testing & Analysis**  

* Run standard analyses following our SOPs (e.g. moisture content, particle size, pH, CO₂ uptake)
* Operate, clean and look after lab equipment (ovens, mills, sieves, balances, reactors)
* Support our science team with whatever is needed

**Data & Documentation**  

* Record measurements and observations accurately in our lab database
* Flag anything unusual - in samples, results or equipment - early

**Lab Organisation & Safety**  

* Keep the lab clean, tidy and safe, including the correct handling and disposal of chemicals and waste
* Keep track of consumables and lab supplies and report when stocks run low
* Bring in ideas to make day-to-day lab work faster and easier

**What we are looking for**
---------------------------

* Motivation beats qualifications – if you like to get hands-on, work carefully and enjoy learning new things, we'll teach you the rest
* Completed HTL (ideally chemistry, chemical engineering, environmental or materials engineering) or an apprenticeship as a laboratory technician (Chemielabortechnik or similar) – no university degree needed
* First lab experience (school lab, internship or job) is a plus, but not a must

You work precisely and cleanly, stick to procedures and document what you do sequestra FlexCo office@sequestra.tech Page 1 of 2 Job Laboratory Technician November 2026 Basic computer skills (Excel or similar)
  

* Reliable and safety-conscious; you don't mind physical work like carrying sample bags or cleaning equipment
* Nice to have: experience preparing samples of minerals, building materials or soils; driving licence B
* Good German and English skills
* A genuine passion for climate solutions – and ideally a healthy sense of humour :)

**Why join us?**
----------------

* Contribute to a mission-driven climate-tech company at the forefront of CO₂ mineralization – your samples and data directly shape our decisions
* Take real ownership of lab routines from day one and help shape how our lab works
* Work closely with a high-performing team of scientists and engineers in a fast-moving startup environment
* Hands-on variety: sample prep, testing, equipment and the occasional trip to our plant
* Targeted training on lab methods and equipment
* Grow with us: as we move to industrial scale, your responsibilities grow too
* Full-time position incl. lab clothing and personal protective equipment
* Fair salary: minimum € 2.534,74 gross per month (paid 14 times a year) under the collective agreement, with overpayment depending on qualifications and experience

**Interested? We are looking forward to hear from you!**

Organizational Setting

The Department of Nuclear Sciences and Applications implements the IAEA's Major Programme 2, "Nuclear Techniques for Development and Environmental Protection". This Major Programme comprises individual programmes on food and agriculture, human health, water resources, environment and radiation technologies. These programmes are supported by laboratories in Seibersdorf, Monaco and Vienna. The Major Programme's objective is to enhance the capacity of Member States to meet basic human needs and to assess and manage the marine and terrestrial environments through the use of nuclear and isotopic techniques in sustainable development programmes.  
  
The Joint FAO/IAEA Centre of Nuclear Techniques in Food and Agriculture assists Member States of the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and the IAEA in using nuclear techniques and related technologies to improve food security, alleviate poverty and promote sustainable agriculture. The Joint Centre consists of five Sections, each with an associated laboratory (located in Seibersdorf, 45 km south-east of Vienna), in the areas of: animal production and health; plant breeding and genetics; insect pest control; soil and water management and crop nutrition; and food safety and control.  
  
The Insect Pest Control Section and Laboratory assist Member States with the development, dissemination and transfer of sterile insect and related environmentally friendly technologies for the area-wide integrated suppression, containment or eradication of major insect pests affecting crops, livestock and human health.

Main Purpose

The Laboratory Technician provides technical support for the activities of the Fruit Fly Rearing and Quality Management group of the Insect Pest Control Laboratory under the USDA/IAEA Agreement entitled Development of Phytosanitary and Regulatory Treatments for Exotic Tephritid Fruit Flies. The Laboratory Technician maintains colonies, establishes new colonies, and provides assistance with the implementation of experimental protocols with data entry in the appropriate databases as required under the USDA/IAEA Agreement.

Functions / Key Results Expected

Maintain fruit fly strains and populations that are the subject of the USDA/IAEA Agreement.  
  
Colonize new populations of fruit flies, as required by the USDA/IAEA Agreement.  
  
Prepare fruit fly infestations in natural and artificial hosts for experimental hot water, cold temperature and other potential post-harvest treatments, as stipulated under the USDA/IAEA Agreement.

Ensure effective functioning of equipment.

Our international teams combine cutting-edge research with strong implementation expertise to create measurable value for industry and society.

  

Our **Center for Digital Safety and Security** is looking for new Ingenious Partners for our location in **Vienna** (Giefinggasse, 1210). In the **Reliable Wireless Communication and Sensing research team**, we develop advanced physical layer 6G technologies. **Junior Scientist (f/m/d) for 6G Wireless Communication and Sensing**
======================================================================

**CENTER FOR DIGITAL SAFETY & SECURITY**
----------------------------------------

* You will contribute to the **development of numerical signal processing algorithms for mobile 5G/6G ISAC scenarios**. The algorithms will be validated using numerical simulations and empirical measurements from a software defined radio (SDR) testbed, combining radio frequency (RF), fiber optic, and quantum sensing.
* Depending on your background you will **conduct algorithm research and participate in designing real-time experiments.**
* You will **engage in establishing a unique 6G distributed MIMO sensing testbed** based on SDR technology using open-source tools such as GNU Radio, RFNoC and LabVIEW for real-time FPGA algorithm design operating from 0.4 – 20 GHz.

* You will work alongside an international team of scientists and **expand your professional network** through **European-wide research projects.** As part of these projects, you will take **responsibility for specific project tasks** and **work packages**.
* You will **evaluate the results** and **prepare them for further studies**
* You will **publish your research results** in international journals and present them at national and international conferences.
* You will gain expertise in a **research field with a wide range of applications**, spanning construction, logistics, aviation, railways, agriculture, robotics, and defence.

**Your qualifications as an Ingenious Partner:**

* **Completed technical studies (Master’s degree)** related to Telecommunications, Computer Science or Electrical Engineering
* **Experience in experimental software defined radio (SDR)** control of quantum sensing with NV centers
    
  *Please describe in the cover letter how your CV and expertise match with this technological area mentioned above.*
    
  **Applications that do not address this point may not be considered further.**

* Hands-on experience in radio frequency (RF) lab experimentation and printed circuit board design for the profiles listed above
* Excellent knowledge in the field of signal processing, RF propagation modeling, AI/ML and numerical simulation software development (MATLAB or Python)
* Good knowledge of electromagnetic field simulation tools, antenna design, and real-time FPGA programming
* Knowledge of European Research Framework projects would be a strong asset
* Interest in reading and writing scientific publications and enjoyment of solving application-oriented questions from industry
* High level of commitment and ability to work in a team
* Very good command of English. German language skills are an advantage
