* **Highlights of our employee benefits** include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, pension fund, additional days off for various life events, family benefits (including two weeks of paid paternity leave “Papa-Weeks” and leisure subsidies), voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events and many more, as well as flexitime models (incl. up to 50% home office), travel support for conferences and networking, and individual training and career development opportunities.
  

At AIT, we create an inclusive and family-friendly working environment that promotes equal opportunities and actively strengthens diversity across our workforce and in leadership positions. Consultant - Laboratory Scientist in Isotopic Applications - (TAL-NAFA20261020-002)

**Organization**
----------------

: NAFA-Animal Production and Health Laboratory

**Primary Location**
--------------------

: Austria-Lower Austria-Seibersdorf-IAEA Laboratories in Seibersdorf

**Job Posting**
---------------

: 2026-11-13, 5:15:01 AM

**Closing Date**
----------------

: 2026-12-04, 4:59:00 PM

Duration in Months: 12

Contract Type: Special Service Agreement - SSA

Full Competitive Recruitment: No

**Organizational Setting**

The Department of Nuclear Sciences and Applications implements the IAEA's Major Programme 2, "Nuclear Techniques for Development and Environmental Protection". This Major Programme comprises individual programmes on food and agriculture, human health, water resources, environment and radiation technologies. These programmes are supported by laboratories in Seibersdorf, Monaco and Vienna. The Major Programme's objective is to enhance the capacity of Member States to meet basic human needs and to assess and manage the marine and terrestrial environments through the use of nuclear and isotopic techniques in sustainable development programmes.  
  
The Joint FAO/IAEA Centre of Nuclear Techniques in Food and Agriculture assists Member States of the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and the IAEA in using nuclear techniques and related technologies to improve food security, alleviate poverty and promote sustainable agriculture. The Joint Centre consists of five Sections, each with an associated laboratory (located in Seibersdorf, 45 km south-east of Vienna), in the areas of: animal production and health; plant breeding and genetics; insect pest control; soil and water management and crop nutrition; and food and environmental protection.  
  
The Animal Production and Health Section and Laboratory assist Member States in improving livestock productivity through the efficient use of locally available feed resources, reproduction and breeding practices, and disease diagnostic tools and control measures.

**Main Purpose**

Within the framework of its activities to support sustainable livestock development and food security, the Animal  
Production and Health Laboratory (APHL) of the Joint FAOjlAEA Centre of Nuclear Techniques in Food and Agriculture  
is engaged in strengthening Member States' capacities to address key constraints affecting animal production and  
health, including poor feed and nutrient utilization, low reproductive efficiency, environmental stress, infectious and  
transboundary animal diseases, antimicrobial resistance (AMR), and inadequate animal identification and traceability  
systems. APHL seeks to advance the use of nuclear and isotope techniques to improve animal production and health  
through enhanced assessment of nutrition, productivity, genetics, disease surveillance, traceability of animals and  
their products, and AMR, thereby supporting evidence-based decision-making and effective interventions .. The  
purpose of this consultancy is to provide technical expertise with regards to the optimization, validation, and standardization of stable isotope  
methodologies for applications in animal nutrition, animal health, AMR detection, and animal traceability with the  
key objective to establish technical and analytical capacity at the animal production and health laboratory of the Joint  
FAOjlAEA Centre.

**Functions / Key Results Expected**

* Review and evaluate existing stable isotope methodologies used in animal nutrition, animal health, antimicrobial  
  resistance (AMR), and animal traceability applications, and identify opportunities for optimization and  
  sta nda rd ization.
* Define analytical applications of stable isotope techniques for assessing feed intake,  
  nutrient utilization efficiency, AMR detection and surveillance, and traceability of animals and animal products.
* Develop and optimize analytical protocols for selected stable isotope methodologies applicable to animal  
  production and health research and services.
* Carry out validation studies to assess the accuracy, precision, reproducibility, robustness, and fitness-for-purpose of  
  optimized stable isotope methods.
* Prepare detailed research protocols for the application and evaluation of stable isotope techniques in animal  
  nutrition, animal health, AMR detection, and animal traceability.
* Prepare Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for validated stable isotope methodologies, including sample  
  collection, preparation, analysis, quality assurance, quality control, and data interpretation procedures.
* Provide technical recommendations on laboratory workflows, analytical requirements, equipment utilization, and  
  quality management systems to support implementation of validated methodologies.
* Prepare training and reference materials to strengthen technical and analytical capacity of the Animal Production  
  and Health Laboratory staff in the application of stable isotope techniques.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Animal Diseases

**Qualifications and Experience**

* University degree (bachelor) in biological, agricultural, environmental, or health sciences.
* Minimum two years' experience in the development and application of stable isotope techniques and/or  
  nuclear-related technologies in animal production, animal health, food systems, or related fields.
* Proven experience in the preparation of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), laboratory quality assurance and quality control systems, and method verification/validation.
* Experience with laboratory procedures, quality assurance and quality control practices, and analytical  
  techniques.
* Experience working with isotope ratio mass spectrometry (IRMS) and other stable isotope analytical  
  platforms would be highly desirable.
* Exposure to stable isotope analysis, including isotope ratio mass spectrometry (IRMS), would be considered  
  an advantage

jobs.title: Laboratory Technician (80980)
jobs.description:
**Vi søker mekaniker/tekniker til mekanisk testing**

  

**Velkommen til selskapet**

Nexans’ visjon er å «elektrifisere fremtiden». I forretningsområdet «Power Transmission» betyr det å levere verdens lengste og mest komplekse høyspente sjø- og landkabler for å koble nasjoner og drive den globale energitransformasjonen. Vi leverer «EPCI» prosjekter over hele verden. Dette innebærer; de beste verktøyene, utstyret og menneskene med kompetanse og ferdigheter til å produsere, installere og reparere disse kablene.

Produksjonsanlegget vårt i Halden omfatter kompetansesenter for R&D, teknisk avdeling, laboratorier, produksjon, testing, support og installasjon, og har ca 1000 ansatte.

  

**Bli med på laget!**

Vil du jobbe i et høyteknologisk miljø med en nøkkelrolle i utviklingen av fremtidens kraftkabler?
  
Nexans søker mekaniker/tekniker til vår avdeling for Mekanisk Test Senter ved fabrikken vår i Halden. Du vil få en sentral rolle i utvikling, gjennomføring og dokumentasjon av mekaniske tester for alle våre kraftkabler – både i leveranse- og utviklingsprosjekter.

  

Mekanisk testsenter består av ingeniører, teknikere og operatører som har ansvar for utvikling, gjennomføring og dokumentering av mekanisk testing av kraftkabler. Det innbefatter kvalifikasjonstester i leveranse- og utviklingsprosjekter. Testing blir mer avansert på grunn av stadig økende krav. Tar du utfordringen sammen med oss?

  

**Ansvar og oppgaver**

* En laboratorietekniker har ansvar for å forberede, gjennomføre og dokumentere tester/terminering ved avdelingens laboratorier. I tillegg til å verifisere og bekrefte at produktene er i henhold til kundenes kvalitetskrav.
* Terminering av prøver før mekanisk testing
* Rigging og klargjøring av testoppsett
* Gjennomføring av mekaniske tester og trykktesting
* Bidra til utvikling og forbedring av prøve- og testutstyr
  

**Ønskede kvalifikasjoner**

Vi ser etter deg som trives med tekniske utfordringer og praktisk arbeid:

* Teknisk utdanning innen mekaniske fag (fagbrev eller teknisk fagskole)
* Erfaring fra industri er en fordel
* Strukturert og systematisk arbeidsform
* Løsningsorientert og samarbeidsvillig
* Høy bevissthet rundt sikkerhet og kvalitet
* Evne til å jobbe selvstendig og tilegne deg ny kunnskap raskt
  

**Vi tilbyr**

* Muligheten til å utvikle deg i et dynamisk og fremtidsrettet miljø:

* En spennende rolle i et høyteknologisk og internasjonalt konsern
* Varierte og utfordrende arbeidsoppgaver
* Vårt interne stillingsmarked gir store muligheter for faglig utvikling
* Meget gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger, samt konkurransedyktige betingelser
* Bedriftsidrettslag med treningsrom
* Bedriftshytter
  

**Arbeidssted**

Fabrikken er lokalisert i Halden med nærhet til en fantastisk skjærgård og flotte turområder.

  

**Andre opplysninger**

Vi jobber aktivt med å sikre mangfold blant våre ansatte på alle nivåer i organisasjonen, og oppmuntrer alle som er kvalifisert til å søke, uavhengig av kjønn og bakgrunn!

  

Nærmere opplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til avdelingsleder Lars Jordal, tlf +47 909 61 140. For informasjon vedrørende rekrutteringsprosessen eller andre spørsmål kontaktes HR Manager Industrial and Engineering, Frode Ødmann Andersen, mobil +47 922 57 679.

  

Du er velkommen til å registrere søknad og CV elektronisk.

  

**Søknadsfrist**: 4 uker fra utlysning.

jobs.title: Lab Employee Molecular Biology
jobs.description:
As a Lab Support in our Molecular Biology department, you will will perform laboratory analyses and tests to diagnose illnesses, injuries and diseases in pets and other animals, process specimens, and release test results. You will handle administrative tasks such as answering phones, preparing parcel deliveries, processing requisitions, and supporting billing, pricing and sample transport.

**Why this role matters:**  
At Movet, part of the global IDEXX Laboratories group in Kuopio, our diagnostic results help veterinarians make the right decisions for animals and their owners. Your daily work keeps our laboratory running accurately and on schedule.

**In this role:**

* You will perform laboratory analyses and tests to diagnose illnesses, injuries and diseases in pets and other animals, process specimens, and release test results.
* You will run instrument test protocols for new and existing products and assist with test research.
* You will manage lab inventory, order supplies, and keep the laboratory and its equipment clean and well maintained.
* You will keep schedules up to date and communicate changes to the team.
* You will support laboratory processes, systems and databases, and carry out record keeping, data collection and analysis.
* You will transcribe and edit dictated medical reports.
* You will handle administrative tasks such as answering phones, preparing parcel deliveries, processing requisitions, and supporting billing, pricing and sample transport.

**What you need to succeed:**

* Reliability: attendance is essential to this role.
* Strong attention to detail, initiative and follow-through.
* Ability to read and follow SOPs, safety data sheets and technical procedures.
* Ability to prioritize and handle several tasks at once.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team, with a high standard of customer service.
* High school diploma or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Preferred skills:**

* Associate degree or equivalent qualification.
* Good computer skills, particularly Microsoft Office and SAP.

**Please note:** The role may involve transporting hazardous waste within the facility, occasionally lifting up to 11 kg, and working with biological material and chemicals, for which appropriate protective equipment is required.

jobs.title: Research Associate, In Vivo Research
jobs.description:
Are you interested in hands-on in vivo research and laboratory work, and motivated to work as part of a multidisciplinary research team?

We are looking for a Research Associate to join our VivOrion VivoCore team within Orion Pharma’s R&D organization in Turku, Finland. The position is permanent and full-time. As a Research Associate, you will work as part of a multidisciplinary research team and participate in the practical execution of in vivo studies. Your work combines hands-on in vivo research, laboratory work, high-quality study execution and ensuring animal welfare.

**Your role**

In this role, you will participate in the preparation, practical execution and follow-up of in vivo studies. You will work closely with scientists, other research assistants and associates, animal care staff and veterinarians.

The role combines hands-on in vivo work with laboratory work in our in-house laboratory, high-quality study execution, careful documentation and a strong commitment to animal welfare.

**Responsibilities**

* practical execution and coordination of in vivo studies
* preparation and planning of study-specific activities together with the study team
* animal handling and study-related procedures
* administration of test compounds using different routes according to study protocols
* collection of blood and other biological samples
* hands-on laboratory work, including processing, preparation and analysis of biological samples in our in-house laboratory
* performing laboratory analyses and ensuring the quality and reliability of results
* clinical observations and study-related monitoring
* active monitoring of animal welfare and identification of any deviations or concerns
* terminal procedures and collection and handling of tissue samples
* participation in studies involving anaesthesia and surgical procedures according to your training and qualifications
* accurate documentation of study procedures, laboratory work and research data
* maintenance and development of research and laboratory methods and practical ways of working

**What you can expect from us**

We offer you the opportunity to work in a diverse in vivo research environment as part of an experienced multidisciplinary team.

The role provides an opportunity to combine and further develop your expertise in laboratory work and a variety of rodent in vivo methods. You will work at the interface of scientific research, practical in vivo work, laboratory analysis and animal welfare as part of Orion’s drug discovery and development activities.

At Orion, your work creates true impact and well-being for our customers, patients and society at large. Our culture of friendliness, respect, mutual appreciation and diversity creates a safe working environment where you can strive for excellence. We offer a wealth of career paths and development opportunities that support the development of innovative solutions and improving the quality of life.

We shape a sustainable future by making research breakthroughs in and across our disciplines, sparking the game changers of tomorrow and creating novel solutions to major global challenges. Our community is made up of 16 000 students and 5 200 employees, including 446 professors. Our campus is in Espoo, Greater Helsinki, Finland. Diversity is part of who we are, and we actively work to ensure our community’s diversity and inclusiveness. This is why we warmly encourage qualified candidates from all backgrounds to join our community.*

We are now looking for a **Research Assistant** at Aalto University School of Business for a project examining how joint versus sole custody affects children’s and parents’ long-term outcomes, including education, health and employment. The applicant must be enrolled in a bachelor’s or master’s degree programme. We hope the selected candidate can start as soon as possible, or by 11.1.2027 the latest.

**Your role**

The main role is to help build a unique research dataset by collecting information on custody decisions from Finnish district courts. This will involve, for example:

* contacting courts
* coordinating access and data collection arrangements
* systematically extracting and recording information from court documents.

**To succeed in this role, you will need**

  

* A proactive, independent approach, with the confidence to take ownership of communication with courts and follow requests through to completion.
* Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and sound judgment when handling confidential information.
* An interest in empirical research in economics or a related social science.
* Strong capability and positive attitude toward data processing and analysis.
* Excellent Finnish and English language skills, both written and spoken, is required.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s level studies in a relevant field.

jobs.title: Research Scientist, Finite-element Modelling
jobs.description:
**Are you an expert in computational multiphysics modelling looking for a new opportunity? Would you like to develop advanced modelling methods with colleagues at the forefront of their fields and create impact in international research and customer projects? VTT might be just the place for you.**

*VTT is one of the leading applied research organisations in Europe. What unites us are curiosity, a passion for learning, and a purpose: to solve the biggest challenges of our time and turn them into sustainable growth and well-being. Our cross-disciplinary community of over 2000 brilliant minds from 55+ different nationalities focuses on creating impact through science-based innovation. In recent years, we have created ground-breaking innovations such as the world's fastest and most accurate radiation detector, a cancer-sniffing sensor device for smartphones, and a headphone set entirely made of microbial materials. Get to know us further by exploring* ***VTT's tech & infra****.*

### **We are now looking for a Research Scientist specialized in FEM to join our soft materials modelling team**

In this role, you will develop advanced multiscale and multiphysics models to predict moisture and heat transfer, biological deterioration, and the long-term durability of wood and other bio-based materials and composites, as well as the mechanics of polymers and bio-based composites. You will combine finite-element modelling, data-driven methods, and experimental observations to build and validate the project’s multiphysics modelling framework.

Our growing and diverse team, ProperTune Soft Condensed Materials, develops advanced modelling methods at the forefront of materials science and contributes to VTT’s ProperTune concept for integrated computational materials engineering. We combine computational approaches, experimental insight, and interdisciplinary collaboration to accelerate materials development and create measurable impact. You will work with highly skilled colleagues and international partners while continuously expanding your own expertise.

### **As a Research Scientist, you will:**

* Develop computational models for coupled moisture transport, heat and mass transfer, fungal growth, and degradation in wood and bio-based materials, as well as constitutive models for polymers and bio-based composites

* Implement and validate finite-element and multiphysics and multiscale formulations using experimental datasets.

* Integrate model parameters derived from molecular simulations, imaging data, and laboratory observations.

* Calibrate models, identify parameters, and assess uncertainty to improve predictive capability.

* Analyse computational and experimental data and collaborate closely with experimental and machine-learning researchers.

* Use high-performance computing environments and develop efficient, reusable scientific workflows.

* Contribute to open modelling tools, scientific publications, research reports, and international project collaboration.

### **Who we are looking for:**

* An MSc or PhD in Computational Mechanics, Materials Science, Civil or Mechanical Engineering, Applied Physics, Computational Science, Applied Mathematics, or another relevant field.

* Strong expertise in finite-element modelling, computational multiphysics, and the numerical solution of coupled partial differential equations.

* Understanding of moisture, heat, and mass transport in porous materials.

* Scientific programming skills in Python or Julia; experience with C++, MATLAB, or similar tools is an advantage.

* Experience in model calibration, parameter identification, and uncertainty analysis.

* Experience with wood, bio-based materials, composites, or other heterogeneous porous materials.

* Good written and spoken English and the ability to collaborate effectively in multidisciplinary and international environments.

* Experience in multiscale modelling, physics-informed neural networks, machine learning, surrogate modelling, biological growth simulations, high-performance computing, or 3D imaging data is considered an advantage.

### **As a person, we hope that you are:**

* Curious, proactive, and eager to learn, with the ability to work independently while collaborating closely across disciplines.

* Motivated to translate scientific questions and customer needs into clear modelling objectives and practical results.

* Open-minded, solution-oriented, and able to move work towards concrete outcomes within clearly defined goals.

### **With VTT, you’ll enjoy:**

* **Visionary work in technology.** We offer positions at the cutting-edge of technology and engineering, from next-generation microelectronics and quantum technology to automation and robotics, energy systems, and more. Our research agenda is dedicated to creating sustainable growth by solving systemic and technological challenges, so your work will go towards creating a real, positive impact. Read more about our strategy – Chain reaction for growth.

* **Fascinating projects, excellent research environment.** Our researchers get to work on a combination of cutting-edge academic research and applied customer projects locally and internationally. At VTT, you'll have state-of-the-art research facilities, such as Micronova, the Finnish research infrastructure for micro-, nano-, and quantum technologies.

* **Great career opportunities, superb colleagues.** At VTT, excellence in research is a strategic priority. We offer long-term positions and stable career paths in top-level research. People tend to stay with us for over ten years since there are always new roles and responsibilities to grow into. Collaborating in a cross-disciplinary community with superb colleagues is a source of learning, inspiration, and fun. jobs.title: People Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Enfuce:**

* Founded in 2016, Enfuce is a female-founded and led global payments partner solving payments complexity for ambitious brands, banks and fintech leaders. Born in the Nordics and built for the world, Enfuce combines deep payments expertise with cloud-native technology to help customers launch and scale with confidence.
* Enfuce is a strategic issuing and licensing partner delivering premium, flexible payment programmes across consumer, commercial and B2B use cases. Built for fast launch and trusted scale, Enfuce designs, launches and runs card programmes supporting debit, credit, prepaid, fleet and fuel propositions, alongside digital wallets and card scheme connectivity.
* Enfuce combines cloud-native issuing, embedded compliance and fraud intelligence to deliver velocity with control. Its modular technology and in-house expertise enable customers to create tailored payment solutions that are flexible, scalable and secure.
* As a regulated payments partner, Enfuce holds Electronic Money Institution licences from both the Finnish Financial Supervisory Authority and the UK Financial Conduct Authority and is a principal member of Visa and Mastercard. Its PCI-DSS-certified, cloud-native platform is designed for enterprise-grade reliability and global scalability, with 99.999% platform uptime.
* Enfuce has raised €73.5 million in funding and has received industry recognition including Fintech of the Year and Best ESG Campaign at the 2024 European Fintech Awards.

**About the role:**

* At Enfuce, we're on a mission to reshape the future of payments. We're building the most sustainable and scalable issuer processing platform in Europe, and our people are the foundation of that.
* This role sits in our People Team and reports to our Chief People Officer. We build our people experience the same way you'd build a product. We look at what people actually need, we build it, we measure it and we improve it. To do that well we need good data, and right now ours needs work. That's where you come in.
* You'll take our people data from where it is today to something we can genuinely rely on: clean, structured, and connected properly into Enfuce's central data platform. From there you'll turn it into the insights that shape what we build next, and the evidence that tells us whether it worked.
* The role will evolve over time. To begin with it's roughly 90% foundation work, getting our data into shape. Once that's solid, more of your time will go into feeding real data into the agents and AI-powered people products we're building. It's a data role the whole way through, the focus just shifts as we go.
* You won't be doing this on your own. You'll work day to day with the People Team, and you'll be connected to our central Data & AI team for platform, standards and your own development. You'll also work closely with our People Product Lead, who builds our People Products and AI automations and will rely on your data to do it.

**What you'll be doing:**

* Build a data foundation we can trust. Get our people data clean and reliable, own the quality across our systems, and move our reporting to ThoughtSpot together with the central Data & AI team. Very few People teams have ever done this properly.
* Turn data into direction. Dig into where we lose time, what causes friction, and what really drives engagement and retention. Bring us ideas that come out of what you've found, and give our leaders something they can act on.
* Connect people's data to the business. Linked up with Finance it makes headcount planning and forecasting much sharper. Built into our leading and lagging indicators, it shows how our people connect to what the business is trying to achieve.
* Prove what we build works. Set the success measures before we build something, then go back afterwards and check whether it was delivered. We'd rather find out quickly and change course than be right slowly.
* Power the AI builds. Work with the People Product Lead on agents, automations and AI-powered people products. You'll build the data layer they run on and measure what they're worth. This part of the role grows as we go.

**What you'll bring:**

* 3+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, taking messy raw data through to a clear insight and a recommendation. Experience embedded in a business function is even better.
* Strong SQL skills and experience with modern cloud data platforms, such as Snowflake (preferred), BigQuery, or Databricks. You're comfortable working with large datasets and understanding how data moves from source systems into analytical models.
* Hands-on experience with dbt or similar analytics engineering practices. You know how to build maintainable transformation pipelines, structure models, test and document data, and manage dependencies between datasets.
* Comfort with Git-based development workflows. Version control, branches, pull or merge requests, code review, and collaborative development are a normal part of how you work.
* Strong experience with modern BI and analytics platforms, such as ThoughtSpot (preferred), Looker, or Omni. You've built dashboards and analytical experiences that people genuinely use, and you understand how the BI layer connects to the underlying data models and sources.
* Experience working with sensitive data and analytics access controls. You understand concepts such as role-based access, row-level security, column-level security, data masking, and least-privilege access, and can apply them pragmatically when working with sensitive People data.

**Why You’ll Love Working At Enfuce:**

* High autonomy & ownership: We give you the freedom to own your work and trust you to make the best decisions for your projects.
* Top-tier talent: Join a team of industry experts and highly skilled professionals who are as passionate as you are about innovation.
* Unlimited growth potential: We support your ambition with plenty of room for personal and professional growth within the company.

The TRD QC Analyst supports the start-up of new laboratories by implementing analytical capabilities, qualifying equipment and systems, and supporting method validation and transfer activities. After start-up, the role performs analytical testing for method validation and routine QC, ensuring compliance with cGMP, GLP, and Novartis quality standards. During routine operations, the role may require shift-based work according to manufacturing and testing needs.
  
  
#LI-Onsite

The TRD QC Analyst plays a key role in establishing and operating Quality Control laboratories that support pharmaceutical development and manufacturing activities. During the laboratory start-up phase, the position supports the implementation of analytical capabilities, laboratory systems, equipment qualification, and method transfer activities. Once operations are established, the role is responsible for executing analytical testing, supporting method validation and verification, and ensuring compliance with cGMP, GLP, and internal quality standards. The TRD QC Analyst also serves as a Super User for laboratory software platforms, providing technical expertise, troubleshooting support, and contributing to system optimization and continuous improvement initiatives.

* Collaborate on the validation / verification / transfer / troubleshooting.
* Support the qualification of new equipment according to Novartis and regulatory standards.
* Execute the required analysis in the QC department based on the plans and needs.
* Contribute on investigations of deviations and out of specifications.
* Keep the laboratory cleanliness and order and actively collaborate to maintain the laboratory and related instruments and auxiliaries in the best possible status.
* Support the safety objective of laboratory personnel and propose improvements to avoid accidents.
* Keep the analytical material stock with the aim of guaranteeing business continuity.
* Ensure proper compliance with Good Laboratory Practices and documentation in the inspection tests used.
* Identify problems, needs and areas for improvement of the laboratory. In accordance with this, design, develop and implement projects that allow improvements in quality, safety and performance of the analysis process in the laboratory.

* Oversight of external laboratories activities
* Support for inspections preparation.
* Review of SOPs

* Degree in Pharmacy, Biology, Chemistry, or equivalent
  

  

**Languages:**

In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.

jobs.title: Post-Doc Researcher for bioinformatics and multi-omics data analysis in Biomedical research
jobs.description:
Bozen/Bolzano
  
  
Institute for Biomedicine
  
  
The Eurac Research Institute for Biomedicine (IfB) located at Bolzano's NOI Techpark, is dedicated to improving human health through precision prevention research. The interdisciplinary work is focused on the investigation of genetic, biological, environmental and lifestyle factors in order to predict, slow or prevent human disease. The institute established the CHRIS population study [1], a decade-long collaboration with the South Tyrolean Healthcare Service, providing extensive data and biological materials suitable for such research. The IfB employs state-of-the-art labs, scientific computing resources and interdisciplinary expertise dedicated to the investigation of neurological, cardiovascular, and metabolic health. Within the HEALTH3P initiative, conducted jointly with Charité – Universitätsmedizin Berlin (Prof. Dr. Markus Ralser, Biochemistry and Systems Biology of Metabolism Group and Prof. Dr. Britta Siegmund, Department of Gastroenterology, Infectious Diseases and Rheumatology) we are investigating molecular markers for health in the population, with a focus on cardiovascular, kidney and metabolic health. HEALTH3P represents a foundational step in a broader partnership dedicated to investigate the active processes maintaining health and to develop precision-based approaches for disease prevention.
  
  
The successful candidate will join the HEALTH3P team, and will process and analyze large-scale mass spectrometry-based proteomics datasets [2,3] to investigate molecular signatures for health and health trajectories and to develop predictive models for health outcomes. The work is a close collaboration with Charité – Universitätsmedizin Berlin. The candidate will work together with senior researchers at both IfB and Charité.
  
  
[1] https://doi.org/10.1093/ije/dyaf064
  
  
[2] https://doi.org/10.1038/s41587-021-00860-4
  
  
[3] https://doi.org/10.1038/s43856-025-00856-0
  
  
**Tasks:**  
Data preprocessing of a large proteomics data set generated by high-throughput mass spectrometry.
  
  
Exploratory data analysis and data normalization.
  
  
Perform statistical data analysis and apply machine learning to identify protein markers characteristic of health states and trajectories.
  
  
Dissemination of scientific results through scientific publications and contributions to scientific events.
  
  
**Requirements:**  
PhD in a relevant field of research (Bioinformatics, Biostatistics, or Computational Biology), with typically 0–3 years of relevant postdoctoral experience at the time of appointment.
  
  
Experience in the analysis, quality assessment and normalization of quantitative omics data, preferentially mass spectrometry proteomics.
  
  
Extensive experience in data analysis with R and/or Python.
  
  
Experience in reproducible research.
  
  
Knowledge in statistical data modeling, multiple regression analysis and machine learning.
  
  
Proactivity and the ability to solve problems independently.
  
  
Ability to work in a distributed, multidisciplinary research environment.
  
  
Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.
  
  
**We offer:**  
Up to three-year full-time position.
  
  
Gross annual salary ranging from 44.914,14 € to 47.272,98 €.
  
  
**Workplace location:** Eurac Research, NOI Techpark, Via A. Volta 21, 39100 Bolzano, Italy.
  
  
**Benefits and work-life balance:** Eurac Research offers a welfare package designed to support employees’ well-being and work-life balance, contributing to a positive and inclusive working experience in an international research environment. The full and regularly updated list of benefits is available here .
  
  
Access to unique health and omics data from the CHRIS population study.
  
  
Collaboration with multidisciplinary international scientists.
  
  
Close collaboration and regular interactions with partners at Charité – Universitätsmedizin Berlin.
  
  
**Employment conditions:**  
**Employment classification and applicable collective agreement:** II level of the Italian National Collective Labour Agreement for the Tertiary/Commerce Sector
  
  
**Gross Annual Salary range:** the gross annual salary range is primarily linked to the advertised position, its requirements and expected level, and is defined according to Eurac Research’s internal remuneration framework. The candidate’s highest academic degree and any relevant professional experience documented in the CV are taken into account where applicable, but always within the salary range defined for the advertised position. The range also reflects whether the position is full-time or part-time.
  
  
**How to apply:**  
Interested candidates should submit their application (CV, cover letter and further relevant documents) by 30.11.2026.
  
  
**Company :** Eurac Research
  
  
Location
  
: Bozen/Bolzano
  
  
**Contact person :** Francisco Domingues
  
  
**E-mail address :** francisco.domingues@eurac.edu

jobs.title: Junior Laboratory Technician Positions - TIGET Clinical Lab
QUALITY CONTROL SPECIALIST
jobs.description:
**Chi siamo**

Grissitalia Srl è una realtà solida e in continua evoluzione nel settore della panificazione. Crediamo fermamente che il nostro successo passi attraverso il valore delle persone e l’efficienza dei nostri processi. Per questo, siamo alla ricerca di professionisti motivati e competenti che vogliano unirsi al nostro team e contribuire alla gestione quotidiana dell’azienda.

**Il tuo ruolo in azienda**

All’interno del dipartimento Qualità, sarai il garante degli standard di eccellenza dei nostri prodotti. Il tuo compito sarà monitorare ogni fase del processo produttivo, assicurandoti che ogni prodotto finito rispetti rigorosamente i parametri di sicurezza alimentare e le specifiche qualitative che contraddistinguono il brand Grissitalia.

**Le tue attività principali:**

* **Controllo Processo:** Monitoraggio costante dei parametri di produzione sulle linee e verifica del rispetto delle procedure HACCP.
* **Gestione Non Conformità:** Identificazione di eventuali anomalie, gestione dei blocchi merce e supporto nella definizione delle azioni correttive.
* **Documentazione:** Compilazione della modulistica di controllo e aggiornamento dei registri di qualità.
* **Audit e Standard:** Supporto nella preparazione dei controlli per il mantenimento delle certificazioni aziendali (es. IFS, BRC, ISO…).

**Profilo ricercato**

Cerchiamo una figura attenta ai dettagli, con un forte senso di responsabilità e la capacità di intervenire con prontezza in ambiente produttivo.

* **Background:** Laurea in Scienze e Tecnologie Alimentari, Biologia, Chimica o Diploma tecnico (es. Perito Chimico/Agrario).
* **Esperienza:** Gradita esperienza pregressa (anche breve) nel controllo qualità, preferibilmente nel settore alimentare o chimico-farmaceutico.
* **Skill tecniche:** Conoscenza delle normative HACCP e degli standard di igiene e sicurezza alimentare.
* **Attitudini:** Precisione metodica, capacità di lavorare in team e spiccata attitudine al problem solving operativo.

**Cosa offriamo**

* **Contratto:** Tempo Indeterminato/Apprendistato (commisurato all’effettiva esperienza).
* **Range RAL:** € 22.000 – € 28.000 (commisurata all’effettiva esperienza).
* **Sede di lavoro:** Prato Sesia (NO)

Pensi di essere la persona giusta? Se vuoi portare il tuo valore nel nostro team, inviaci il tuo CV a: lavoro@grissitalia.it

*La selezione rispetta il principio delle pari opportunità (L. 903/77).*

jobs.title: Quality Control Technician - Meldola, Italy (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
**Job Requirements**  

**Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.**

At Siemens Healthineers (SHS) Radiopharma, we are committed to driving sustainable progress through cutting-edge technology. We empower our customers by bridging the physical and digital worlds—enhancing the way we live, work, and move, today and for future generations.

We believe that business success begins with our people. That’s why we prioritize a culture where individuals thrive. Our diverse team is ready to support, inspire, and challenge you to grow in new and meaningful ways. Together, there are limitless possibilities of where our shared journey may lead.

As the global leader in the supply of positron emission tomography (PET) radiopharmaceuticals, SHS Radiopharma pioneered the commercial PET radiopharmacy model over 30 years ago—and continues to shape the future of molecular imaging.

Join us as a **Quality Control Technician**, based in **Meldola, Italy** and help us shape the future of precision theranostics while advancing patient care.

Your responsibility within the Quality Control Laboratory will be to ensure analytical activities, processes, and equipment comply with established quality standards, internal procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.

**Location** : Meldola

**Type of contract:** Permanent

**Your role :**

* Conduct batch analyses following approved SOPs.
* Manage the preparation of solutions, reagents, standards, and routine lab materials.
* Partner with the QC Manager on CAPA implementation and follow-up for lab areas and equipment.
* Assist external technicians with onsite maintenance, calibration, and qualification activities.
* Run routine calibration and validation protocols for QC processes and equipment in line with regulatory requirements.

**The position involves rotating morning and night shifts.**

 **Work Experience**  

**Your profile:**

  

* Technical diploma or degree in Chemistry, Biology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related field.
* 1–3 years in Quality Control or Analytical laboratory roles within GMP-regulated environments.
* Previous experience in radiopharmaceutical companies and proficiency in both the local language and English (written and spoken).

 **Benefits**  

**Who we are:**

We are a team of more than 74,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.

**How we work:**

When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably. Check our Careers Site at Jobs at Siemens Healthineers AG

As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.

We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. Please create a profile within our talent community and subscribe to personalized job alert that will keep you posted about new opportunities.

**To all recruitment agencies:**

Siemens Healthineers' recruitment is internally managed, with external support permitted only when a qualified supplier has established a formal contract with us. Unsolicited candidate submissions and referrals, absent a current supplier contract, do not establish consent and are ineligible for fees. We delete and destroy unsolicited information, thus, would recommend you refrain from any such practices. Your adherence to our policies is appreciated.
